title: Disability Program Coordinator
location: Corporate Office - 250 E Pilot Rd. - Las Vegas, NV 89119
description:
ESSENTIAL EXPECTATIONSESSENTIAL EXPECTATIONS

Diversity, Equity, And Inclusion Expectations

Goodwill is committed to fostering a culture of dignity and trust where all individuals feel respected and valued. The sum of individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, background, education, unique capabilities, and talent converge to create an environment of inclusivity, equity, and excellence.

Safety Expectations

At Goodwill, safety is everyone’s job. Ensuring a workplace where people can grow and enrich themselves and others by giving can only happen if our environment is secure and safe. Being compliant with safety rules, policies, procedures, and regulations, while assessing and eliminating workplace hazards, is essential to our business and delivering our mission.

POSITION EXPECTATIONS

​​To assist the Mission Services Department by coordinating the activities of the Community Based Training (CBT) program and to help as needed with the Student Work Experience Program (SWEP). This position also conducts all intakes for the CBT program as well as helps the Director of Disability and Volunteer Programs with the day-to-day administrative duties for the CBT program. The Disability Program Coordinator also assists Mission Services in meeting annual goals and meeting CARF (Commission on the Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities) and all other GII (Goodwill Industries International) Certification Standards and expectations.​

Responsibilities

  • ​​Conducts intakes for all adult clients referred by Vocational Rehabilitation (VR) and the Department of Veteran Affairs (VA) for participation in Goodwill’s various CBT Programs.

  • ​Schedules weekly intakes with clients, completes of all CBT Intake related paperwork in an accurate and timely manner and works collaboratively with the finance department on billing related inquires, meets a set weekly intake goal, and communicates with management as needed.

  • ​Conducts quarterly quality case file reviews to ensure that all CBT case files are properly maintained in accordance with GII’s standards for Certification and CARF Accreditation in collaboration with the Mission Services Corporate Receptionist and Program Assistant.

  • ​Serves as the backup for the Director of Disability and Volunteer Programs as needed and/or directed.

  • ​Oversees weekly payroll preparation for all CBT Clients.

  • ​Maintains the collection of new referrals, statistical, and billing data on excel spreadsheets or case management databases for all clients receiving services.

  • ​Assists with tracking and evaluation projects (i.e., submits weekly/monthly reports to management, collect data for periodic institutional reviews, etc.).

  • ​Assists in any other projects or tasks as determined by management. ​

Core Competencies

Job Knowledge

Possesses comprehensive, functional and technical knowledge and skills to perform at a high level of accomplishment. Discerns how the job relates to other functions within the department and Goodwill operations. Follows policies, procedures, and safety protocols.

Dependability

Meets deadlines and works autonomously. Focused, punctual, and maintains consistent

attendance. Accountable and can be relied upon during challenging and unexpected

situations.

Service Oriented

Supports, assists, and advises internal and external customers in a timely manner displaying proactive and reactive behaviors. Demonstrates productive verbal and listening skills. Establishes and maintains effective relationships. Meets quality standards and evaluates customer satisfaction and results.

Teamwork

Works collaboratively and respectively with others and is sensitive to team member

engagement. Communicates openly seeking and providing support. Shares knowledge,

provides assistance, and contributes well as a leader, facilitator, or participant. Accountable

to team.

Job Specific Competencies

Quality Focused

Strives for excellence. Organized, methodical, accurate and thorough. Understands scope of responsibility. Improves performance and outcomes. Problem solves and manages time restraints. Maintains the highest level of product and customer experience. Develops and implements best practices and accreditation standards.

Organization and Planning

Establishes and prioritizes tasks and objectives. Maintains focus on multiple tasks while effectively utilizing time, energy, strengths and workspace. Information and work product is logical, consistent, and accessible.

Patience

Accepts or tolerates delays or problems without becoming anxious or unprofessional. Steadfast despite opposition, difficulty or adversity. Maintains ability to meet goals, sustain services, collaborate with coworkers, and overcome obstacles.

Judgement

Innate ability to combine personal qualities with relevant knowledge and experiences to form opinions and reach conclusions. Makes sound choices in the absence of clear-cut, relevant data or an obvious path. Applies decisions considering goals, risks, constraints, resources, and scope of authority.

Environmental Factors

  • ​​Majority of duties performed in an office environment with regulated temperatures​

Physical Factors

  • ​​Able to lift, carry, push, and pull a minimum of 25 pounds.

  • ​Prolonged standing, walking, reaching, stooping, lifting, pulling, carrying, sitting at a desk, and working on a computer.​

title: Systems Administrator 3 (On-Call) - Linux/Bash/Python/Ansible/SaltStack/Docker
description:
Build to something to be proud of.

Captivation has built a reputation on providing customers exactly what is needed in a timely manner. Our team of engineers take pride in what they develop and constantly innovate to provide the best solution. Captivation is looking for software developers who can get stuff done while making a difference in support of the mission to protect our country.

Description

Captivation Software is looking for a senior level systems administrator who shall be responsible for providing support for a large-scale Linux system including installation of COTS/GOTS/FOSS software, day-to-day operations, monitoring, and problem resolution for all the compute, network, memory, and storage system components. In addition, the System Administrator shall maintain the system security integrity and configure network components, along with implementing operating systems enhancements to improve reliability and performance.

Requirements

Security Clearance:

  • Must currently hold a Top Secret/SCI U.S. Government security clearance with a favorable Polygraph, therefore all candidates must be a U.S. citizen

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Fifteen (15) years' experience as a Systems Administrator in programs and contracts of similar scope, type, and complexity is required
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited college or university is required
  • Five (5) years of additional Systems Administration experience may be substituted for a bachelor's degree.
  • A Security+ Certification is required

Required Skills:

  • Experience using the Linux CLI
  • Experience developing scripts using Bash/Python
  • Experience in performing System Administration including installation, configuration, and support of COTS/GOTS/FOSS software in a large-scale Linux cluster environment
  • General technical knowledge regarding compute, network, memory, and storage system components
  • Experience with Red Hat Satellite systems management solution
  • Familiarity using Splunk for ingesting, indexing, searching, monitoring, and analyzing big data
  • Experience with the sustainment and support of large Linux clusters including day-to-day operations, monitoring and problem resolution
  • Experience configuring and sustaining VMware ESXi/Virtualization environments
  • Experience with IaC (Infrastructure as Code) principles and automation tools such as SaltStack and Ansible
  • Experience with corporate STE/STN security compliance policies and procedures
  • Experience using system monitoring tools such as HPE One View and Nagios
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes
  • Experience with distributed files systems such as Weka, CEPH, GPFS, and HDFS
  • Experience with the Atlassian Suite of Tools such as Jira and Confluence

This position is open for direct hires only. We will not consider candidates from third party staffing/recruiting firms.

Benefits

  • Annual Salary: $130,000 - $270,000 (Depends on the Years of Experience)
  • Up to 20% 401k contribution (No Matching Required and Vested from Day 1)
  • Above Market Hourly Rates
  • $3,600 HSA Contribution
  • 6 Weeks Paid Time Off
  • Company Paid Employee Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance/Life Insurance/Short-Term & Long-Term Disability/AD&D

title: QC Inspection Belt
description:
DESCRIPTION OF JOB SCOPE

Quality Control belt inspection employee is a critical member to our QC team and provide assistance with ensuring quality is held to the highest standards by following inspection protocols and sorting out foreign objects to ensure compliance with GMP, (Good Manufacturing Processes) Federal, State, and local food protection standards.

DESCRIPTION OF JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Adhere to all Classic Salads Food Safety and GMP Policies, including Basic Policies (TRN-0101, TRN-102, TRN-103. TRN-104. TRN-105. TRN-1061.
  2. Complete Classic Salads Quality Standard Operating Procedure Training
  3. Identify containments and evaluate the risk of continuing to run the line, or put the line on hold and alert a QA supervisor for further guidance.
  4. Communicate routinely with QC Specialist and QA Supervisor on issues related to food safety and product quality.
  5. Ensures that all work activities are performed with attention to the highest standards for quality, safety, and compliance with all appropriate legal and food safety requirements.
  6. Enforce all GMP rules by setting a positive example, coaching co-workers, and appropriate communication of violations.
  7. Maintain work area clean.
  8. Stop the line in the moment as necessary for any issue regarding food safety. Report issue to immediate supervisor.
  9. Report any GMP violations to QA Supervisor.
  10. Maintains a high level of safety awareness for an accident-free workplace.
  11. Reports any unsafe or hazardous work conditions or safety-related issues to Management.
  12. Other duties as assigned by QA Supervisor.
  13. Wear required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): bump cap, hearing protection, hair net, beard net, eye protection (goggles), face shield, gloves, slip-resistant shoes, wet/rain suit, apron, etc.
  14. Work overtime, weekends, and holidays as needed.
  15. Able to work under pressure and time.
  16. Able to work in a cold/wet environment (34 - 36 °F Degrees).
  17. Report all injuries and incidents big or small

EDUCATION AND/OR WORK EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or equivalent is preferred. Ability to speak, read, and write in Spanish. Ability to read and comprehend simple English instructions preferred. Ability to manage priorities and workflow within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm. Preferably be able to travel with the Company to Yuma Arizona during winter months (November to end March).

PHYSICAL ACTIVITY REQUIRED OF THE EMPLOYEE TO PERFORM THE JOB CONSTANTLY FOR 8 OR MORE HOURS

WALKING, STANDING, BENDING NECK, BENDING WAIST, SQUATTING, CLIMBING, TWISTING NECK, TWISTING WAIST, BOTH HANDS USE (SIMPLE GRASPING, POWER GRASPING, FINE MANIPULATION, PUSHING AND PULLING, REACHING BELOW AND ABOVE SHOULDER LEVEL)

DAILY LIFTING AND CARRYING REQUIREMENTS FOR 8 OR MORE HOURS

FREQUENTLY CARRY AND LIFT 1-25 LBS 100 FEET OR LESS CONSTANTLY, TEAM LIFT 25-50 LBS 20 FEET OCCASIONALLY



DESCRIBE THE HEAVIEST ITEM REQUIRED TO CARRY AND THE DISTANCE TO BE CARRIED:

TEAM LIFT 25-50 LBS 55 Gal size garbage barrel 20 FEET OCCASIONALLY

title: ANIOS bij gebiedsteam Woerden
description:
Wil je als ANIOS verder kijken dan alleen wat er in de spreekkamer gebeurt?

Bij Gebiedsteam Woerden werk je volgens de FACT-methodiek ambulant, outreachend en wijkgericht met mensen met ernstige psychiatrische aandoeningen (EPA). Je komt bij mensen thuis en krijgt zo een goed beeld van wat er naast de psychiatrische klachten nog meer speelt. Soms is de zorg planbaar, soms vraagt een situatie om snel schakelen. Je werkt samen met een gezellig, betrokken en professioneel team waarin we elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden.

Wat ga je doen?

Als ANIOS draai je volop mee binnen het gebiedsteam en werk je met cliënten met uiteenlopende psychiatrische problematiek, ieder met een eigen verhaal en zorgvraag.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit psychiatrische diagnostiek, medicamenteuze behandeling, crisisinterventies en het opbouwen van een behandelrelatie. Je voert psychiatrische beoordelingen uit op locatie en bij cliënten thuis en denkt mee over passende behandelroutes bij complexe zorgvragen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de psychiatrische klachten alleen en heb je oog voor het functioneren van de cliënt op verschillende levensgebieden.

Als ANIOS werk je nauw samen met psychiaters, verpleegkundig specialisten, SPV’ers, psychologen, verpleegkundigen, GGZ agogen en ervaringsdeskundigen. Je werkt onder supervisie van een psychiater, met veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en altijd de mogelijkheid om terug te vallen op een betrokken en deskundig team.

Naast je werk in het gebiedsteam, draai je enkele keren per maand mee in de 24-uurs bereikbaarheids- en aanwezigheidsdiensten van Altrecht. (uiteraard gelden hiervoor passende toeslagen en compensatieregelingen).

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Bij Gebiedsteam Woerden krijg je de ruimte om je als ANIOS verder te ontwikkelen binnen de psychiatrie. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar altijd met ervaren collega’s uit verschillende disciplines om je heen. Er is volop ruimte om te leren, vragen te stellen en met elkaar mee te denken.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5.294,- tot € 6.918,- (FWG 65 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (volledige dertiende maand) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar op basis van 36 uur per week. Wil je nog extra tijd voor jezelf? Dan kun je extra verlof bijkopen, tot een maximum van 36 uur, afhankelijk van de omvang van je dienstverband.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Een pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, een collectieve inkomensverzekering bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en korting op aanvullende ziektekostenverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea.

  • Alflex. Ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Hiermee kun je jouw salaris fiscaalvriendelijk inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld een fiets, een sportschoolabonnement of aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding.

  • De Altrecht Academie. Hier vind je een uitgebreid aanbod aan (online) scholingen voor de specialistische GGZ. En dankzij intervisie met je bevlogen collega´s groei je elke dag verder in je werk.

  • Naast een actieve en gezellige ANIOS groep heeft Altrecht ook een intern onderwijsprogramma. Dit is speciaal bedoeld om jou als ANIOS wegwijs te maken in het klinische werk en de organisatie. Zo zorgen we voor een goede ondersteuning voor beginnende artsen.

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent een geregistreerd basisarts met affiniteit voor de psychiatrie en bij voorkeur enige ervaring binnen de GGZ. Je vindt het interessant om te werken met complexe psychiatrische problematiek en bent gemotiveerd om samen met de cliënt te zoeken naar een passende weg richting herstel.

Je houdt van afwisseling, kunt goed omgaan met onverwachte situaties en voelt je prettig in een omgeving waarin je zelfstandig werkt, maar altijd kunt terugvallen op collega's. Je luistert aandachtig, denkt breed en hebt oog voor het hele verhaal van de cliënt.

Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde opleiding Geneeskunde en een geldige BIG-registratie als basisarts.

  • Affiniteit met de psychiatrie en de EPA-doelgroep.

  • Interesse in ambulante en herstelgerichte psychiatrie.

  • Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden.

  • Een flexibele en zelfstandige werkhouding.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Bereidheid om mee te draaien in de bereikbaarheids- en aanwezigheidsdiensten.

  • Een rijbewijs, zodat je ook ambulante zorg buiten de locatie kunt bieden. Voor deze werkzaamheden kan je vanuit onze locatie in Woerden gebruik maken van een leaseauto of een elektrische fiets.

Wie zijn wij?
Wat ons team bijzonder maakt, is de sfeer. We zijn betrokken, helpen elkaar en hebben oog voor elkaar. We sparren over complexe casussen, lunchen iedere dag samen en vinden werkplezier net zo belangrijk als goede zorg. Nieuwe collega’s voelen zich snel welkom en krijgen alle ruimte om mee te denken, zichzelf te ontwikkelen en initiatief te nemen.

Daarnaast zijn we betrokken bij verschillende innovatieve ontwikkelingen, zoals het verkennend gesprek en spraakgericht rapporteren. Ook leiden we met plezier nieuwe collega’s en professionals in opleiding op. We zijn een team dat graag blijft leren en ontwikkelen en staan open voor nieuwe ideeën.

Enthousiast en nu?

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de button! Wil je eerst meer weten? Stuur gerust een berichtje naar Peter Hopman, teammanager via 06-82682157 of p.hopman@altrecht.nl.

Je bent ook van harte welkom voor een oriënterend gesprek, zodat je de sfeer bij ons kunt ervaren. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

  • Solliciteer rechtstreeks via. Zo weten we zeker dat jouw sollicitatie goed bij ons binnenkomt.

title: Systems Navigator (SN)- Ft Bragg, NC
description:
The EFMP is a mandatory enrollment program that works with other military and civilian agencies to provide comprehensive and coordinated community support, housing, educational, medical, and personnel services to Families with special needs. Soldiers on active duty enroll in the program when they have a Family member with special medical and/or education needs requiring specialized services. EFMP ensures that a family member's needs are considered during the military personnel assignment process so their needs can be considered during the military personnel assignment process.

Systems Navigators and ACS Compliance Specialists (SNACS) - Exceptional Family Member Program (EFMP) - Systems Navigator (SN)

System Navigators are responsible for daily coordination to ensure the facilitation of networking between Families who have special needs and the systems of required care. Duties of the position include intake interviews and documentation, identification needs assessment of the Family member, referrals, follow-up care and information, advocacy, and collaboration with providers in both the civilian and military community.

Job Duties

  • Provide home visits for the Soldier and or Family members to offer support as needed and/or requested.
  • Coordinate with Government agencies and civilian service providers to identify the availability of non-EFMP respite care resources.
  • Maintain an information catalog of national, state, and local networks and contacts with military and civilian service providers who offer assistance to families with special needs.
  • Coordinate a support group and/ or workshops monthly.
  • Present EFMP Systems Navigation briefings to provide Soldiers and Family members an overview of available EFMP related services.
  • Provide information and referral services to Families by identifying appropriate resources and helping them make an informed choice of services available.
  • Partners with Families to increase resilience, develop self-advocacy skills, and improve their ability to navigate systems effectively.
  • Manage the Soldiers and Family member records in accordance with all required Army and DoD regulations.
  • Facilitate warm hand off to the appropriate program personnel when transitions occur.
  • Collects and explores data for planning, reporting, and program improvement, completed monthly reports meeting program deadlines.
  • Implements policies, procedures, and practices that connect Families to support services.

Required Skills/Qualifications

  • Knowledge of human service principles and practices, individual Family needs and problems relative to case management.
  • Knowledge of military, state and Federal laws, policies, regulations, and practices regarding medical, educational, and Family support services.
  • Possess skill levels to provide professional non-clinical case management services, facilitating connections between Families who have special needs and the systems of required care.
  • Ability to effectively communicate and interact with others, both in person and/or by telephone to conduct business.
  • Level 1 Life Coach certified through Certified Life Coach Institute (Provided by Patriot).
  • Must be able to travel.
  • Experience with Microsoft Suite programs.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and be a US Citizen.
  • Must be able to pass a background check.

Required Education Level

  • Bachelor's degree in one of the following degree programs (social work, psychology; marriage, family, and child counseling; counseling or behavioral science; education; community health or public health).
  • Two years of experience in family related case management and/or social work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Senior Principal Architect - Enterprise Architecture
description:

  • Establishes reuse-first AI-enabled architecture patterns and governance across practices, ensuring traceability/auditability, resiliency, and architecture.
  • Establish adoptable standards, architecture patterns, and paved paths, using metrics to drive adoption and reuse.
  • Drive alignment across architecture disciplines and partner with engineering, product organizations while identifying opportunities for simplification, modernization, and optimization.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies implementation – platform choices, preferred uses, adoption paths – that stand up to scrutiny.
  • Advise executives on architecture strategy and direction, framing trade-offs across cost, complexity, risk, and business value while mentoring architects for an outcome-focused architecture community.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on architecture concepts and 5 plus years of applied experience in technology architecture, strategy, and engineering.
  • Experience defining and driving architecture strategies across several domains in large, complex organizations.
  • Advanced in one or more programming language(s) and deep expertise in enterprise architecture, applications, and technical processes within one or more technical disciplines (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)

  • Ability to evaluate and integrate AI-enabled capabilities into enterprise-grade architectures while meeting resiliency, security, and auditability requirements.
  • Proven experience guiding enterprise technology adoption, including target states, patterns, paved paths, and scalable integration.
  • Demonstrated depth in a core technical domain (e.g., cloud, app, data/AI, platform architectures) plus enterprise breadth.
  • Strong understanding across business, data, app, and technology architecture domains. Excellent communication skills, translating complex subjects for senior and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence business and technology leaders and drive change across engineering and product organizations.
  • Experience developing implementable standards and paved paths with measurable adoption outcomes. Embedding risk, control, compliance, and resilience considerations into architecture practices.

Preferred Qualifications, Skills, and Expertise

  • Experience with formal architecture governance frameworks (e.g., TOGAF or equivalent).
  • Exposure to modern paradigms including cloud, AI/data, distributed systems, and platform-based architectures.
  • Experience with engineering practices and software development (e.g., CI/CD, IaC, observability).

  • Track record driving enterprise-wide initiatives improving consistency, reuse, and efficiency.
  • Experience working in regulated environments (e.g., operational resilience, third party/concentration risks).

title: Design Associate (Federal)
description:
FEDERAL PLANNING PRACTICE

Michael Baker delivers a multitude of award-winning, innovative planning services nationwide, creating the highest level of value for our federal partners. Since World War II, we have been providing the full range of technical competencies to the U.S. federal government. We are recognized as highly competent, detail oriented and committed to outstanding customer service. Working under multiple, concurrent task order awards, we are called upon again and again to meet urgent deadlines all over the world to satisfy various sustainability, facility management, master planning, emergency management, design and community planning needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Design Associate will join a collaboration of experienced planners, landscape architects, engineers, and project managers dedicated to having a positive impact through effective federal master planning. The ideal candidate will be driven, intellectually curious, committed to excellence, and demonstrate a desire to make a difference in the communities we serve.

The Design Associate will support the project planner or project manager on multi-disciplinary planning projects, concept plans, site plans, and design-build projects and will be responsible for the preparation of master planning documents for Federal, State, and Local Government Clients.

Can you walk me through a typical day of a Federal Design Associate?

As a member of the Federal Planning Practice, the Design Associate will have a number of activities on any given day, which include:

  • Supporting federal master plans and revitalization projects of varying sizes and complexities in diverse Federal and Military communities by utilizing hand-drawing techniques, SketchUp, and other computer-based modeling;
  • Drawing proposed site plans in AutoCAD and rendering plans using Adobe CreativeCloud software
  • Analyzing land conditions, such as drainage and topography to make recommendations on site planning
  • Facilitating small group exercises at on-site workshops to engage stakeholders on long-term development priorities and potential courses of action
  • Collecting and compiling a variety of quantitative and qualitative data to prepare reports, maps, and related graphics
  • Conducting field evaluations and assessments
  • Researching requirements and standards
  • Developing reports under the direction of the project manager
  • Other duties as assigned

What can I expect for a career path, and where might this role take me?

There are numerous career paths for a Design Associate. The typical next level position, as you gain more experience, showing commitment to quality and hard work, can either be a Project Management or Technical Management position.

Job Requirements

  • Four-year degree in Planning, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, or related discipline
  • AICP Candidate or other related professional certification or licensure preferred
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, AutoCAD, SketchUp, or ArcGIS is required
  • Knowledge of one or more planning disciplines, such as master planning, urban planning, community planning, economic development, or land use
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently as well as in multi-disciplinary teams
  • Ability to conduct research and prepare statistical planning reports on land use, physical, social & economic possibilities, and constraints
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills for preparing and presenting planning reports and projects
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to accommodate moderate travel (domestic and international); around 25%
  • Valid driver’s license
  • This role requires U.S. Citizenship

How do I apply?

Select the Apply Online button at the top or bottom of this ad, and provide us a cover letter, resume, and work samples or a portfolio.

COMPENSATION

The range for this role is $69,000 – $91,000; this will be dependent on the experience and expertise of the incoming candidate.

Do you want to shape how quality is built into PlayStation® peripherals and firmware, not just verify it at the end? Join the team crafting thoughtful test strategies for PlayStation® Link™ devices. Your work will directly support product performance, stability, and the overall player experience!

We're growing the Quality Engineering team and looking for a senior engineer who enjoys owning test strategy for complex features, bringing clarity to unclear requirements, and helping the engineers around them grow.

title: Head of Partnerships & Alliances
description:
About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

Amperity is seeking a strategic, collaborative, customer-obsessed leader to serve as our Head of Partnerships. This role sits at the critical intersection of our ecosystem strategy, commercialization plan, and sales organization. You will guide our relationships with Global System Integrators, Frontier Model Providers, ISVs, and Cloud Data Warehouses, and Cloud Service Providers – transitioning traditional co-selling into deeply integrated, product-led Go-To-Market (GTM) motions that create measurable customer and commercial value.

In this position, you will combine high-level alliance leadership with a deep understanding of modern product ecosystems and a strong instinct for turning relationships into repeatable growth opportunities. As Amperity enters its most exciting chapter yet and transforms to an AI-first company—putting autonomous agents at the center of customer data to make AI truly trustworthy—you will identify where Amperity and its partners can create differentiated solutions, open new routes to market, and accelerate revenue together. You will serve as a trusted guide spearheading modern data infrastructure: architecting co-innovation frameworks, building repeatable alliance motions, enabling our GSI and cloud partners to deliver transformative, AI-grounded customer experiences on the Amperity platform, and converting our strong existing executive and ecosystem relationships into durable commercial outcomes.

Interesting Problems

  • Product-Led Alliances: Drive shared growth and high-value strategic pipeline by positioning Amperity as the foundational CDP layer within key partners' architecture blueprints across the AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks ecosystems.
  • Commercialize the Ecosystem: Turn strategic relationships into scalable revenue motions. Identify where partner capabilities, customer needs, and Amperity’s platform intersect; develop joint value propositions, routes to market, pipeline-generating programs, and commercial models that produce measurable sourced and influenced revenue.
  • Relationship-Led Growth: Build trusted relationships with senior partner leaders, practitioners, and field teams—and translate those relationships into access, advocacy, customer introductions, joint account strategies, and long-term strategic advantage.
  • Co-Innovation & Framework Design: Collaborate with technical and business leaders to build creative commercial frameworks, including partner-led pilots, OEM opportunities, consumption-based models, and custom service offerings.
  • Ecosystem Alignment: Serve as the strategic and technical bridge driving Amperity’s Product, Engineering, and Solutions Architecture teams with peer leadership across our partner network.
  • Deal Acceleration & Advisory: Offer high-level guidance on strategic deals, empowering account teams and partner leaders with cohesive narratives that resolve legacy data silo challenges.
  • Executive Mentorship & Advocacy: Represent ecosystem partnerships internally—working alongside Legal, Finance, and Product while mentoring cross-functional teams on partner engagement.

About You

  • Executive Leadership Experience: Demonstrated track record of leading complex initiatives, consulting strategy, or strategic alliances at a VP+ level in function (not necessarily title).
  • Working Leader: You are hands-on and enjoy doing the work, being the one in the room with partners and customers, and actively driving the action externally.
  • Commercial Partnership Acumen: You know how to move from relationship-building to monetization. You have developed joint GTM motions, influenced or sourced enterprise pipeline, structured commercial partnerships, and created the operating cadence required to turn strategic alliances into sustained growth.
  • Executive Relationship Builder: You build credibility quickly with senior executives and practitioners alike and maintain relationships that create access, trust, and opportunity over time. You understand that the best partnerships are built through mutual value—not transactional asks.
  • GSI & Cloud Ecosystem Collaboration: Proven ability to navigate the strategic, commercial, and operational dynamics of premier GSIs (e.g., Deloitte, Accenture, Slalom) and hyperscale cloud providers.
  • Outcome-Driven Focus (Relentless to Outcomes): Highly execution-oriented with an unwavering commitment to achieving clear business impact. You set high standards for joint GTM motions and persist through complex enterprise sales cycles to deliver measurable revenue growth and customer success.
  • Strategic Builder Mindset: Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building frameworks from the ground up, with the ability to rally and work cross-functionally with internal teams. Adept at recognizing partner capabilities and designing joint solutions that unlock significant mutual value.
  • AI-Curious Mindset: You demonstrate proficiency in leveraging generative AI for customer- and partner-facing materials to increase effectiveness and scale.

Location

New York, NY

Amperity’s work model operates on four in-office days each week and one designated remote workday on Wednesdays. We value the collaboration, connection, and learning that come from working together in person.

Compensation

Base Salary: $178,000-$245,000. Individual compensation within this range will depend on several factors, including your skills, experience, education/training, geographic location and the level at which you join. We also consider internal equity, market conditions, and overall business needs.

Cash Incentives: Cash incentives are also available.

Stock Options: The opportunity for ownership is an exciting part of Amperity’s total compensation package. Every employee at Amperity receives a new-hire equity grant, commensurate with the scope of their position.

Benefits

We offer all the benefits you'd expect from a great place to work: 100% employee healthcare coverage, transportation subsidies, a comfortable work environment with plenty of snacks, and other employee experience perks like events and activities, both in-person and remote. We also offer self-managed PTO and the flexibility to do your best work in the way that works for you. We provide an inclusive environment where you'll be challenged to find and unlock your full potential, surrounded by a team of world-class people driving for excellence. For more details on our benefits, please see our US Benefits & Perks Guide.

title: Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)
description:
The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

title: Staff Product Manager, Commerce
location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own and drive strategy across a product domain at Flexport. This is not a single-feature role. You will define the vision for how multiple product surfaces work together to serve clients and operators across global logistics, then execute against that vision with a high degree of autonomy.

Flexport's platform powers every stage of global freight, from booking and pricing to visibility, customs, and delivery. The products you shape will be used daily by logistics managers, supply chain leaders, freight operators, and internal teams who keep goods moving around the world. You will work across multiple engineering teams and coordinate with other PMs to ensure your domain delivers cohesive, measurable outcomes. You will also raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship, better frameworks, and sharper thinking on the hardest product problems we face.

This is a role for someone with deep product experience, strong analytical instincts, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and execution level in a complex, data-rich environment.

The team:

The Commerce team owns the end-to-end quality, automation, and profitability of Flexport’s commerce domain. We build intelligent agents to automate critical commerce workflows, including quoting, billing, and invoicing, while driving cost intelligence across every shipment process gate to optimize profitability. Additionally, our team expands the marketplace catalog for new offerings and develops next-generation, client-facing commerce products and payments technology.

You will:

  • Define and drive product strategy across the Commerce domain that spans multiple teams, user types, or workflow stages
  • Build intelligent AI agents to automate core commerce operations, including quoting, billing, and invoicing
  • Own the end-to-end roadmap: identifying the highest-leverage problems, sequencing investment, and making clear trade-off recommendations to leadership
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, and other product teams to align priorities and ship integrated experiences across surfaces
  • Collaborate closely across a global footprint with engineering teams in the West Coast US and China, participating in regular cross-border syncs
  • Use data to set direction, not just measure results. Building metrics frameworks that connect product usage to business outcomes and using them to guide investment decisions across your domain
  • Break down ambiguous, cross-cutting problems into concrete product plans that multiple teams can execute against
  • Represent your domain in leadership forums, influencing resource allocation and strategic direction
  • Mentor PMs on the team: improving how we write specs, prioritize, communicate trade-offs, and ship

You should have:

  • 8+ years of product management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to own a product domain (not just a feature or single product area) and lead product roadmaps spanning 2 to 3 years across multiple engineering teams
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You build metrics frameworks, write your own queries, and use data to settle debates. SQL proficiency required
  • A track record of shipping products in data-dense, complex domains where the user workflow spans multiple steps or systems
  • Experience aligning multiple cross-functional teams (engineering, design, operations, commercial) around a shared roadmap when priorities compete
  • Proven ability to operate at the strategy level (where should we invest, and why) and the execution level (what ships this quarter, and what does "done" look like) in the same week
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, especially the ability to frame trade-offs, present recommendations to senior leadership, and create clarity in ambiguous situations
  • Experience mentoring or leading other PMs, formally or informally
  • Experience with B2B workflow software, supply chain platforms, or logistics technology is a plus

title: DCEO Chief Engineer, Data Center Engineering Operations
description:
Description

Amazon Web Services is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Chief Engineer to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) team. This group is committed to maintaining the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services, ensuring 100% uptime of MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing/Fire Protection) systems, while delivering world-class customer service to the teams operating within the data centers.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers as well as all the servers, storage equipment, networks, power systems, and cooling systems that ensure our customers have continuous access to the innovations they rely on. We work on the most complex problems, with thousands of variables impacting our operations, and we are looking for talent who want to help us tackle these challenges.

You will join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, critical systems specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other essential roles. You will collaborate with colleagues across AWS to maintain the highest safety standards while delivering seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. You will thrive in an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to see them through.

As a DCEO Chief Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the proper operation of all electrical, mechanical, and fire protection/life safety equipment within the data center at optimal efficiency. This encompasses planned preventive maintenance, daily corrective interventions, and response to urgent incidents. You will serve as the single technical point of reference for all facility operations, reporting to the site Facility Manager and interacting with Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) as well as third-party contractors. Data center equipment supporting critical servers must maintain an uptime rate greater than 99.999%.

As a DCEO Chief Engineer, you will lead low-to-medium impact projects from design through delivery. These projects involve a significant amount of independent work as well as close collaboration with cross-functional teams including engineering, automation, operations, and finance, in both local and international environments. You will create and track key milestones, obtain and monitor quotes for all necessary costs, and document project outcomes for future implementation at other facilities. The goal is to drive innovation and resilience while reducing operational costs.

One of the most rewarding aspects of this role is leading, training, and mentoring Engineering Operations Technicians in their mission of troubleshooting and operating electrical and mechanical equipment. Designing and executing site-specific and equipment-specific training exercises is also part of the expected responsibilities. This equipment includes diesel backup generators, switchboards, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), PDUs, air handling units (AHUs), centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, variable frequency drives (VFDs), and building management systems (BMS).

Key job responsibilities

  • Oversee daily operations and maintenance of the data center's mechanical and electrical equipment.
  • Work independently with a limited level of direct supervision.
  • Act as the escalation point for all data center facility-related issues, escalating to the Facility Manager as needed.
  • Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of equipment failures.
  • Troubleshoot and report facility-level and server-level events within internal SLA timelines.
  • Create and deploy new standard practices for EOT Technicians, Chief Engineers, and contractor teams.
  • Provide training and mentoring to Engineering Operations Technicians.
  • Ensure strict compliance with all safety procedures by contractors and Amazon personnel.
  • Use the internal CMMS to manage and track facility workflows.
  • Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.
  • Lead infrastructure improvement projects from design to delivery, tracking milestones, costs, and deliverables.

About The Team

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and have never stopped innovating — which is why customers, from the most successful startups to Global 500 enterprises, trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just beginning, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

At AWS, curiosity and human connection are at the heart of who we are. Our employee-led and company-supported affinity groups foster inclusion and allow everyone to take pride in what makes them unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continuous innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices that our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We continuously raise our performance bar in our quest to become Earth's Best Employer. That is why you will find endless knowledge sharing, mentorship, and other professional development resources here to help you become a more well-rounded professional.

Work-Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Succeeding at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive to offer flexibility in our work culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there is nothing we cannot achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in English (spoken, written, and reading).
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Industrial Technology, or Electrotechnical Engineering.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience in a data center or other critical environment.
  • Proven experience in the management and maintenance of critical infrastructure (UPS, generators, switchboards, HVAC, chilled water/cooling systems).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, or in an industrial or data center-related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in a data center or other critical facility.
  • Intermediate level in French (spoken and written).
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including with non-technical audiences.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and technical team management skills.
  • Experience in multi-site or multi-team technical project management.
  • Knowledge of CMMS, BMS (Building Management Systems), and electrical power monitoring systems (EPMS).

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. Veuillez consulter notre Politique de Confidentialité pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous collectons, utilisons et traitons les données personnelles de nos candidats.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Quality Control
description:
General Summary:

Responsible for working with key medical equipment customers for the cleaning, availability, inspection, and shipping of medical equipment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Level I

  • Alerts and facilitates the coordination of the units needing inspection; provides inspection updates to the Inventory Management System where required by customer requirements.
  • Ensures inbound units needing repair are placed in the proper area and tagged with available information regarding the required repair.
  • Alerts Inventory Control and client on customer equipment that needs to be repaired; coordinates the repair schedule and provides updates to the Inventory Management System.
  • Cleans and maintains medical equipment; performs decontamination on medical equipment, where required by customer requirements.
  • Conducts basic function testing of medical equipment, such as system power-ups (certain function test procedures involve the use of medical grade Air and Oxygen (O2) gasses).
  • Completes the necessary paperwork procedures associated with daily activities.
  • Coordinates daily calls with the TEC office.
  • Ensures all units have their original barcodes and that barcode label is accurate and readable.
  • Ensures that all ship dates are met; follows established shipping and receiving procedures per MedTec Warehouse Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Facilitates physical inventory counts, cycle counts and parts management; verifies actual counts are as indicated in Inventory Management System; ensures that cycle counts are conducted where required by customer requirements.
  • Ensures that units allocated are units used for orders.
  • Ensures warehouse technician check sheets are correct.
  • Establishes, organizes and maintains warehouse area per MedTec policies and procedures.
  • Facilitates and assists with tradeshow staging and training on site as required.
  • Reports any issues or discrepancies to management.
  • Interacts with clients on inventory availability and allocation of inventory as required.
  • May be responsible for track and tracing of small parcel shipments to Sales Representatives or hospital locations.
  • Receives additional instructions and directions from Lead MedTec Technicians, TEC office, MedTec program and/or management.
  • Performs other tasks/projects as requested by management.

Level II

  • Troubleshoots and diagnoses issues with customer devices and equipment; adjusts, maintains and repairs customer devices and equipment; escalates to Lead MedTec Technicians and/or management as necessary.
  • Serves as point of escalation for communications with clients, Sales Representatives and/or hospital representatives as needed.
  • Assists with training junior personnel; provides performance feedback to management.
  • Performs other tasks/projects as requested by management.

Level III

  • Alerts and facilitates the coordination of the units needing inspection; provides inspection updates to the Inventory Management System where required by customer requirements.
  • Ensures inbound units needing repair are placed in the proper area and tagged with available info regarding the required repair.

  • Cleans and maintains medical equipment; performs decontamination on medical equipment, where required by customer requirements.
  • Conducts basic function testing of medical equipment, such as system power-ups(certain function test procedures involve the use of medical grade Air and Oxygen (O2 gasses).
  • Completes the necessary paperwork procedures associated with daily activities.
  • Coordinates daily calls with the TEC office.
  • Ensures all units have their original barcodes and that bar code label is accurate and readable.
  • Ensures that all ship dates are met; follows established shipping and receiving procedures per MedTec Warehouse Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Facilitates physical inventory counts, cycle counts and parts management; verifies actual counts are as indicated in Inventory Management System; ensures that cycle counts are conducted where required by customer requirements.
  • Ensures that units allocated are units used for orders.
  • Ensures warehouse technician check sheets are correct.
  • Establishes, organizes and maintains warehouse area per MedTec policies and procedures; assures cleanliness of warehouse area.
  • Facilitates and assists with tradeshow staging and training on site.
  • Reports any issues or discrepancies to management.
  • Interacts with clients on inventory availability and allocation of inventory as required.
  • May be responsible for track and tracing of small parcel shipments to Sales Representatives or hospital locations.
  • Troubleshoots and diagnoses issues with customer devices and equipment; adjusts, maintains and repairs customer devices and equipment; coordinates with Field Service Engineers (FSEs) for escalated repairs/service.
  • Maintains current familiarity with DPU, IMS and Red NA system functionality as related to MedTec Technician completion of duties.
  • Troubleshoots and diagnoses issues with customer devices and equipment; adjusts, maintains and repairs customer devices and equipment; escalates to Lead MedTec Technicians and/or management as necessary.
  • Serves as point of escalation for communications with clients, Sales Representatives and/or hospital representatives as needed.
  • Assists with training junior personnel; provides performance feedback to management.
  • Performs other tasks/projects as requested by management.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • No direct reports.

description:

We’re a San Francisco lighting design + manufacturing company built for environments that can’t go dark. What You’ll Actually Do

  • Review architectural and electrical drawings to help the team make faster, better decisions
  • Use Revit and Bluebeam for markups, model checks, and fixture coordination
  • Prepare submittals (cut sheets, IES files, technical packages)
  • Dig into manufacturer data and industry resources when we need answers
  • Support basic electrical specification checks and code-related considerations
  • Maintain trackers, spreadsheets, and templates in the Microsoft suite
  • Partner with Engineering, Operations, and Customer Service to knock out technical or logistical blockers
  • Spot process friction and help tighten it

This is mostly internal-facing right now. As we scale, the role can expand into more client-facing work and greater ownership.

Who Thrives Here

  • Basic familiarity with lighting, electrical, AEC, or manufacturing environments
  • Comfortable reading architectural drawings, electrical plans, and project deliverables
  • Working knowledge (or fast ability to get up to speed) with Revit, AGi32, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Office
  • Understanding of basic electrical specs and code principles
  • Experience (or strong interest) with lighting specifications, controls layouts, photometric files, and submittals
  • Natural organizer who actually likes structure and accuracy
  • Clear, professional, respectful communicator
  • High learning speed + “no job is too small” attitude
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through
  • Able to work independently and keep productivity consistent

Nice-to-haves that make you stand out

  • Prior support of program/order management or technical operations
  • ERP/CRM exposure
  • Deeper lighting knowledge (CCT, CRI, optics, drivers, controls)
  • AEC workflow or manufacturing process experience
  • Process improvement or light automation wins
  • Curiosity about how AI can speed up documentation, calculations, or workflows
  • Basic scripting or data skills (Power BI, Python, VBA, etc.)

How We Work

We value respectful communication, reliability, and accountability. We share clear updates, ask clarifying questions, and listen. We approach drawings, calculations, and documentation with care. We handle information accurately and keep what’s confidential confidential. We try to stay ahead of problems instead of reacting to them.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reliable AGi32 calcs and clean documentation
  • Organized, current project folders with consistent structure
  • You flag workflow improvements or time-savers
  • You’re ready with materials before anyone has to ask
  • You pick up new tools and concepts quickly
  • You take feedback and stay curious about AEC + manufacturing
  • Professional, respectful communication with every internal stakeholder
  • Positive attitude and real willingness to support the team
  • Tasks completed on time with minimal hand-holding
  • Timely updates that keep the Director aligned

About You

You bring a positive, solution-oriented approach. You believe no job is too small when it helps the team. You know clarity beats guessing. You’re organized, detail-driven, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment. You like learning technical things. You take pride in accuracy and efficiency. You collaborate well and add the right amount of light humor to the day.

Radiation therapy requires thoughtful evaluation of multidisciplinary treatment options to predict treatment effectiveness and potential acute and long-term toxicities. Advances in tumor profiling and molecular biomarkers increasingly allow clinical outcomes and treatment-related effects to be evaluated alongside patient- and disease-specific factors.

As patterns of care continue to evolve, robust clinical data is essential for assessing current treatment approaches, refining clinical management strategies, developing meaningful quality metrics, and improving the delivery of radiation therapy.

The department is developing a comprehensive research database that includes patient demographics and characteristics, baseline health and medical history, tumor characteristics and staging, treatment details, diagnostic and treatment imaging, clinical outcomes, and treatment-related toxicity data. This repository will support future studies examining survival outcomes, toxicities, late effects, treatment combinations, and the effectiveness of radiation therapy planning and delivery techniques.

Internship Overview

This internship provides an introduction to clinical research in radiation oncology and medical physics. The intern will learn about human-subject protections, HIPAA requirements, research compliance, clinical data management, and the role of informatics in radiation oncology. They will also have opportunities to observe clinical medical physics practices.

The intern will support an approved Institutional Review Board research study by collecting and organizing clinical data, refining anonymization and de-identification processes, assisting with data sharing, and contributing to the implementation of an informatics data-management system.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in departmental orientation, onboarding, and clinical tours.
  • Collaborate with the project team to establish internship milestones and objectives.
  • Expand and refine an existing clinical data repository.
  • Collect, review, organize, and maintain detailed research data.
  • Support data-quality checks and documentation.
  • Refine methods for anonymizing and de-identifying clinical data.
  • Assist with preparing approved data sets for sharing with research collaborators.
  • Contribute to the implementation and evaluation of an informatics data-management system.
  • Support clinical evaluation activities involving the research system and data repository.
  • Develop recommendations and a roadmap for future data-collection efforts and research projects.
  • Follow all applicable requirements related to HIPAA, human-subject protections, research compliance, and institutional data-security standards.

Anticipated Internship Timeline

  • Week 1: Complete onboarding and clinical orientation; discuss internship milestones and objectives.
  • Weeks 2–4: Further develop the existing data repository and prepare it for data collection.
  • Weeks 5–6: Refine anonymization and de-identification methods.
  • Weeks 7–12: Perform data collection and make necessary process and repository refinements.
  • Week 13: Develop a roadmap for future data-collection activities and research projects.
  • Week 14: Prepare approved data for sharing under an established data-sharing agreement and assist with clinical evaluation activities involving the research system.

Learning Objectives

By the end of the internship, the intern will be able to:

  • Explain the importance of human-subject protections, HIPAA, research compliance, and responsible clinical data management.
  • Identify common challenges associated with clinical research data collection.
  • Collect, organize, anonymize, and prepare research data for approved sharing.
  • Describe the technical and informatics systems used in radiation oncology.
  • Discuss the roles of medical physicists and information technology professionals in radiation oncology.
  • Explain how structured clinical data can support quality improvement and future research.

Systems Access

Based on assigned responsibilities and institutional approval, the intern may receive access to:

  • Institutional email
  • Electronic health record systems
  • Research and compliance platforms

  • Approved clinical data-management systems

All access will be limited to the minimum necessary for the intern’s responsibilities and will require completion of applicable training and compliance requirements.

About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to own and drive strategy across a product domain at Flexport. This is not a single-feature role. You will define the vision for how multiple product surfaces work together to serve clients and operators across global logistics, then execute against that vision with a high degree of autonomy.

Flexport's platform powers every stage of global freight, from booking and pricing to visibility, customs, and delivery. The products you shape will be used daily by logistics managers, supply chain leaders, freight operators, and internal teams who keep goods moving around the world. You will work across multiple engineering teams and coordinate with other PMs to ensure your domain delivers cohesive, measurable outcomes. You will also raise the bar for the PM team through mentorship, better frameworks, and sharper thinking on the hardest product problems we face.

This is a role for someone with deep product experience, strong analytical instincts, and the ability to operate at both the strategic and execution level in a complex, data-rich environment.

The team:

The Visibility team owns the end-to-end mapping and tracking of physical goods across global logistics. We solve complex supply chain workflows at the system root-cause level using data, product intuition, and highly structured logic. Our team is responsible for defining the client-facing tracking experience based on real physical execution capabilities, driving operational and system changes across execution, planning, and technology teams.

You will:

  • Define and drive product strategy across the Visibility domain that spans multiple teams, user types, or workflow stages
  • Own the end-to-end mapping, tracking, and visibility of physical goods across the entire shipment lifecycle
  • Drive end-to-end data intelligence to solve complex operational problems and define next-generation client-facing visibility experiences
  • Partner across execution, planning, and technology teams to align priorities and ship integrated systems across surfaces
  • Collaborate closely across a global footprint (Hong Kong, Europe, US) with China engineering teams, participating in regular cross-border syncs
  • Use data to set direction, not just measure results. Building metrics frameworks that connect product usage to business outcomes and using them to guide investment decisions across your domain
  • Break down ambiguous, cross-cutting problems into concrete product plans that multiple teams can execute against
  • Represent your domain in leadership forums, influencing resource allocation and strategic direction
  • Mentor PMs on the team: improving how we write specs, prioritize, communicate trade-offs, and ship

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You build metrics frameworks, write your own queries, and use data to settle debates. SQL proficiency required
  • A track record of shipping products in data-dense, physical, or multi-sided domains where user workflows span multiple systems and operational teams
