title: Identity Security Engineer
description:
The Team

We are seeking an Identity Security Engineer to join American Tower’s Information Security organization. This role strengthens identity security, reduces privileged access risk, and enables secure access to enterprise systems, data, and cloud resources. As an Identity Security Engineer, you will engineer and support identity and privileged access solutions across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. You will help advance Zero Trust through Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP), Just-In-Time (JIT) access, least privilege, Role Based Access Controls (RBAC), Conditional Access, and modern authentication technologies. This role works closely with Security Operations, Governance Risk & Compliance, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application Development, Service Desk, and enterprise identity architecture teams.

What You Can Offer Us

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise Identity Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.
  • Engineer privileged access capabilities including credential vaulting, password rotation, session management, privileged account onboarding, break-glass access, and account lifecycle management.
  • Advance ZSP, JIT access, least privilege, privileged access reduction, and RBAC initiatives.
  • Implement and support Microsoft Entra ID capabilities including Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), Identity Protection, password less authentication, and access security controls.
  • Design and support application access management, single sign-on (SSO), federation, and modern authentication integrations using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Open Authorization version 2.0 (OAuth 2.0), Open ID Connect (OIDC), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), and directory services.
  • Secure privileged users, administrative accounts, service accounts, application identities, machine identities, agentic identities, and other non-human identities.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, application, and platform teams to onboard systems, applications, servers, databases, endpoints, and cloud resources into PAM and identity security platforms.
  • Develop and maintain privileged access standards, administrative access models, engineering runbooks, operational procedures, and Zero Trust access control patterns.
  • Automate identity and privileged access processes using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, workflow orchestration, and platform integrations.
  • Troubleshoot IAM and PAM platform issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to improve reliability and operational stability.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations to investigate identity-related incidents, privileged access risks, control gaps, and suspicious activity involving high-risk identities.
  • Communicate identity security risks, technical recommendations, and remediation plans to cross-functional teams, senior management, and business stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
  • 3+ years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting IAM, PAM, and/or identity security solutions in large enterprise environments required.
  • 2+ years of confident hands-on experience administering CyberArk Privilege Cloud, CyberArk PAM, Delinea, BeyondTrust, and/or comparable PAM platforms highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to own and improve ZSP, JIT access, least privilege, RBAC, break-glass access, and privileged access reduction capabilities.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, MFA, Identity Protection, directory services, and modern authentication controls.
  • Confident understanding of SSO, federation, authentication, and authorization technologies such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, LDAP, Active Directory, and cloud identity platforms.
  • Capable of owning automation or integration work using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, workflow automation, or similar scripting technologies is preferred.
  • Proven ability to assess identity security risks, identify control gaps, recommend practical remediation, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment, ownership mindset, sense of urgency, customer focus, business integrity, and ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Approximately 5% travel may be required in support of the position’s responsibilities.

title: Executive Director
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR

Department: Administration
Reports To: Board of Directors
Revision Date: August 2026
FLSA Status: Exempt

Position Overview

The Executive Director serves as the chief executive officer of the Hyland Hills Park & Recreation District (“District”) and is appointed by and accountable to the Board of Directors (“Board”). The Executive Director is responsible for the overall leadership, administration, strategic direction, and operational performance of the District, including all departments, programs, services, and facilities, subject to Board bylaws, policies, resolutions, and directives.

The Executive Director implements Board-adopted policies and strategic priorities; advises the Board on organizational, financial, and operational matters; and ensures that District services are delivered effectively, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This role is expected to provide forward-looking leadership that supports the District’s mission, long-term sustainability, and service to the community.

Employment in this position is at-will unless otherwise provided in a written Employment Agreement approved by the Board of Directors and subject to applicable federal and state law.

Core Responsibilities

Executive Leadership and Administration

The Executive Director directs and manages all administrative and operational functions of the District. This includes providing leadership to Executive staff and other direct reports; establishing organizational goals and performance expectations; ensuring alignment across departments; and maintaining effective internal systems and processes.

The Executive Director is responsible for advising the Board on strategic initiatives, operational matters, emerging risks, and opportunities, and for implementing Board direction in a timely and effective manner. The Executive Director also ensures the preparation and delivery of accurate and timely information to support Board decision-making.

The Executive Director supports organizational continuity and succession planning by maintaining appropriate documentation of key processes, operational knowledge, and strategic priorities, and by fostering leadership development within the organization.

Legal Compliance and Governance

The Executive Director oversees administrative systems designed to support compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including those governing Colorado special districts. This includes oversight of public meetings, public records, elections, financial reporting, and related statutory obligations.

The Executive Director reviews contracts, agreements, and other legal instruments and provides recommendations to the Board as appropriate. The Executive Director coordinates with legal counsel on matters of compliance, risk management, and litigation, and supports adherence to Board governance practices and adopted policies.

Financial Management

The Executive Director is responsible for the overall financial management of the District, including budget development, financial planning, and oversight of fiscal operations. This includes directing the preparation of the annual budget and any amendments for Board consideration.

The Executive Director keeps the Board informed regarding the District’s financial condition, risks, and long-term funding needs, and ensures the implementation of appropriate internal controls and audit practices. The Executive Director promotes financial sustainability and responsible revenue practices consistent with the District’s public purpose.

Capital Projects and Procurement

The Executive Director oversees capital planning, facility development, and long-range infrastructure investment. This includes recommending financing strategies for capital projects and ensuring that procurement processes are conducted in accordance with District policies and applicable legal requirements.

The Executive Director directs the preparation of bid documents and requests for proposals, evaluates submissions, and makes recommendations to the Board when Board approval is required under established policy. The Executive Director administers approved contracts and monitors project performance, timelines, and expenditures.

Organizational Leadership and Workforce Management

The Executive Director provides executive leadership for workforce management and organizational development. This includes final hiring authority for Executive Staff and other direct reports, oversight of leadership staffing decisions, and evaluation of organizational leadership performance.

The Executive Director oversees compensation administration in accordance with Board-approved policies, salary structures, and budget authority. The Executive Director fosters a professional, accountable, and collaborative organizational culture; supports employee engagement and leadership development; and ensures consistent application of personnel policies and compliance with applicable employment laws.

External Relations and Community Engagement

The Executive Director serves as a principal representative of the District and maintains effective working relationships with community stakeholders, governmental entities, partner organizations, consultants, and the media.

The Executive Director represents the District at public meetings, hearings, and professional forums, and supports community engagement efforts that align with the District’s mission and strategic priorities.

Additional Duties

The Executive Director performs other duties consistent with the position and as assigned by the Board of Directors.

Working Conditions

Work is performed in administrative offices, parks, recreational facilities, construction sites, and other indoor and outdoor environments. The position requires regular travel between District facilities, attendance at meetings and events (including evenings and occasional weekends), and periodic in-state and out-of-state travel for conferences, training, and other professional development or District business activities, as approved and directed in accordance with District policy. The role involves engagement in a variety of operational settings.

The position requires the ability to move throughout District facilities and environments, and to perform tasks associated with site visits, meetings, and presentations. The role may involve exposure to varying weather conditions, construction environments, and periods of elevated mental and emotional demand.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of public sector governance, budgeting, procurement, policy implementation, and legal compliance; knowledge of Colorado special district operations preferred
  • Knowledge of parks and recreation operations, facility management, capital planning, and public service delivery
  • Skill in strategic planning, financial management, executive decision-making, and organizational leadership
  • Skill in communicating clearly and effectively, verbally and in writing, in English as needed to perform essential duties, including Board communications, public presentations, written reports, and stakeholder engagement
  • Skill in building effective working relationships with Board members, employees, community stakeholders, governmental entities, consultants, partner organizations, and the media
  • Ability to manage complex operations, competing priorities, organizational change, and high-level District challenges
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion, confidentiality, political acumen, and ethical decision-making in matters involving public trust

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in public administration, business administration, recreation administration, or a related field preferred
  • Minimum five years of progressively responsible executive or senior leadership experience, preferably in parks and recreation, local government, special district administration, or a comparable public service organization
  • Demonstrated experience in strategic planning, financial management, and organizational leadership
  • Valid driver’s license, or ability to obtain within one month of employment, and ability to meet District insurability requirements

*Please Note: In accordance with Colorado House Bill 21-1051 and applicable open meetings and public records laws, applicant confidentiality may be maintained during portions of the recruitment process. Once finalist(s) are selected, their names will become public, and certain finalist recruitment records may be subject to public disclosure as provided by law. The District will provide at least 14 days’ public notice before the Board appoints the Executive Director.

This job description may be amended from time to time and is established by Hyland Hills Park & Recreation District. The above declarations are not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job described, nor are they intended to be such a listing of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Rather, they are intended only to outline the basic requirements, duties, and general responsibilities of the position. This position is "at will", which means the District may terminate the employment relationship at any time and for any or no reason, subject only to the requirements of Federal and State law. Similarly, the employee may terminate the employment relationship without notice at any time for any or no reason. In addition, all finalists selected for employment with Hyland Hills Parks & Recreation District must undergo a thorough criminal background check.

We're looking for a Global Head of Customer Happiness to lead Clara’s Customer Happiness organization globally, with the mission of delivering an AI-forward and world-class customer experience in every market. You will lead our local Customer Happiness leaders and their teams, setting the strategy, standards, and operating model for the function everywhere that Clara operates, and report directly to the company CEO. This role combines people leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, and a heavy emphasis on data and AI-driven technology to scale our support models as we grow.
  • Lead with example: being involved in building your own solutions using AI coding models (Claude, Codex, Cursor, open source models, etc.) and manage an organization that includes agents and people fully empowered by AI

Who you are

Must haves

  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to turn customer and operational data into clear actions and measurable improvements.
  • Experience with customer service platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or similar tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Adaptability to fast-changing environments and a hands-on, builder's mentality.
Nice to haves
  • Experience in fintech, banking, payments, SaaS, or B2B technology.
  • Experience leading teams across Mexico, Brazil, and/or Colombia.
  • Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Python.
  • A good sense of humor.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

  • We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

  • Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup.

  • Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

  • Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

  • Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

  • Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

  • #Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

  • #Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

  • #Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

  • #Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

  • #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

  • #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one

  • Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

  • Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

  • High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

  • Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

  • Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara’s Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

About the Role:

We build and run the software that our clinicians, coordinators, and back-office teams use every day in a rapidly growing organization that is dominating its marketplace. The system is primarily a .NET web platform with a SQL Server back-end and Kendo front-end, along with a legacy WPF client we're migrating away from.

We're looking for an engineer who has internalized AI-assisted development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) and uses it to ship great software at pace. More than “I've tried Copilot", we’re looking for someone who can execute against multiple DevOps tickets at once, guide the AI coder towards the best design, and spot bad output before it becomes a bug or performance-slayer in production.

Equally important is an ability to work with a business owner who may only half-know what they want. You’ll need to come to understand our business quickly, be able to ask the right questions, and help improve the initial DevOps ticket into something that is ready to feed to the AI to code. You excel when you can deliver the thing that the business owner actually needed, not just a rote implementation of the first idea they had.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with business owners and clinical operations leads to understand a problem, push back where their original DevOps ticket is fuzzy or self-contradictory, and help improve the ticket that makes the work buildable.
  • Build features across the stack: C# / .NET, SQL Server (stored procs, schema changes, query tuning), Kendo/Telerik UI, JavaScript.
  • Use AI coding tools as your primary leverage — running several small tasks in parallel, or a large feature with satellite work cooking alongside it.
  • Review AI output with real skepticism: catch the invented column name, the reinvented helper, the plausible-looking method that quietly breaks an invariant three processes away.
  • Test relentlessly. Unit tests, integration tests, and hands-on-the-app testing of your own work and your teammates' work before it reaches users.
  • Occasional WPF work — bug fixes in the legacy client and migrating functionality out of it into the web platform.
  • Own your changes through deployment and into production support.

What we're looking for

Required

  • 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • C# / .NET and SQL Server experience — enough that you can read a query plan, design a schema, and tell when generated SQL is wrong rather than merely ugly.
  • Demonstrated fluency with an agentic AI coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in real production work. Be ready to talk specifics: how you scope prompts, how you verify output, where these tools fail you.
  • The engineering judgment to know when the AI is confidently wrong. This is the single most important thing on this list.
  • Excellent requirements skills — comfortable in the room with non-technical stakeholders, good at surfacing the unstated assumption before it becomes rework.
  • A testing instinct that borders on adversarial. You look for the edge case, the null, the concurrent user, the bad data already sitting in the table.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and short feedback loops.

Nice to have

  • Kendo / Telerik UI for ASP.NET.
  • WPF or another desktop XAML stack.
  • Healthcare, EMR/EHR, or other regulated-domain experience.
  • Azure (Functions, Service Bus / RabbitMQ-style messaging, App Service).
  • Experience working with LLM-backed features in a product, not just as a dev tool.

How we work — read this part carefully

We move fast and we finish things. That means:

  • Rework is part of the job. Sometimes the business owner sees it and realizes it's not right. We redo it without drama.
  • There are occasional long days and occasional weekends. Not as a lifestyle, but they happen — around releases, production issues, and hard deadlines. If that's a dealbreaker, we'd rather know now, and there's no hard feelings.
  • You'll test other people's code. Quality is a team output, not an individual one.
  • You'll be trusted with a lot. Small team, direct access to decisionmakers, very little ceremony between you and shipping.
  • The people who thrive here love building software — the craft of it, not just the paycheck — and would rather own an outcome than a ticket queue.

Salary Range: $120,000- $140,000 + 10% Bonus Target

Location: Fully remote.

Travel: Up to 10% annual domestic travel

Full-time employees qualify for the following benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision and supplementary benefits such as Life Insurance, Short Term and Long Term Disability, Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Dependent Care, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity.
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Office Holidays

All employees qualify for these benefits:

  • Paid Sick Time
  • 401(k) with up to 3% company match
  • Referral Program
  • Payactiv: pay-on-demand. Cash out earned money when and where you need it!

Candidates must disclose any current or future need for employment-based immigration sponsorship (including, but not limited to, OPT, STEM OPT, or visa sponsorship) before an offer of employment is extended.

Ennoble Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to hiring the best team possible, and does not discriminate against protected characteristics including but not limited to - race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, disability, and veteran status.

title: Badging Access Control Lead
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Technical Security (TechSec) team within Anduril's Corporate Security Program is dedicated to protecting our people, physical assets, and proprietary innovations. We design, procure, and deploy robust technical security infrastructure and systems across our global footprint. Our mission is to create a secure built environment that enables Anduril's transformative work in defense technology. We focus on anticipating and addressing technical security challenges, ensuring Anduril's continued growth and innovation in a complex global landscape.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Badging Access Control Team Lead will oversee the management and maintenance of physical access control systems for all Anduril sites while delivering world-class customer service to employees, contractors, and guests. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with team leadership, ensuring the protection of Anduril's employees, facilities, and assets across all locations. The Team Lead will be responsible for managing access control operations, leading team members, and driving continuous improvement of policies and procedures.
Reports to: Technical Security Access Control Manager

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead and mentor Security Access Control team members, providing training on badge printing, visitor management hardware, and system operations with Standard operating procedures documentation.
  • Serve as escalation point for regional access control needs and complex technical issues.
  • Coordinate team workflow and ensure consistent service delivery across all sites.
  • Monitor team performance and provide ongoing coaching and development.
  • Issue credentials to all Anduril employees, contractors, and guests.
  • Create, assign, maintain, revoke, and audit access within the enterprise access control system (Genetec ClearID).
  • Process all physical access requests using the enterprise ticketing system.
  • Manage and maintain visitor access within the enterprise visitor management system.
  • Maintain appropriate site supply inventory and ensure adequate resources for operations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to define space ownership and appropriate area approvers.
  • Lead the continuous development of access control policies, procedures, and systems with documentation.
  • Create and maintain access control documentation using proper change management and process controls.
  • Maintain access control system datasets, including compiling reports, assisting with requests from internal teams, and reporting key metrics to senior leadership.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience managing physical access control in a corporate environment.
  • 3+ years of experience creating and modifying access credentials in Genetec and ClearID enterprise access control systems.
  • Proven experience in a customer service-oriented office environment.
  • Experience working in the Physical Security industry with exposure to global operations and projects.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, ticketing systems (Jira), and collaboration tools.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with a diverse team.
  • Strong leadership abilities with experience training and mentoring team members.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment with rapidly changing priorities and peak periods.
  • Strong work ethic and high level of discretion with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to serve as escalation point for complex issues.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of progressive security experience, preferably within a multi-national corporation or Federal entity.
  • Strong project management skills and extensive experience with large-scale technical security system implementations and upgrades.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and technologies to improve operational efficiency.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite, ticketing systems (Jira), and collaboration tools .
US Salary Range
$126,000—$167,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Seasonal Learning Trainer, Seasonal Learning Trainer

title: Controls / Governance Lead Technical Program Manager

title: Aeronautical Information Specialist
description:
At OAS, we deliver innovative solutions that advance mission success for federal agencies. Our team combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to collaboration, integrity, and excellence. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, professional development opportunities, and the ability to contribute to critical aviation modernization efforts that impact the National Airspace System.

Join Objective Area Solutions

Objective Area Solutions (OAS) is seeking an experienced Aeronautical Information Specialist to support the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Airports Data and Information Program (ADIP). This position serves as the airport data and aeronautical information subject matter expert, supporting both sustainment and modernization efforts across the ADIP portfolio while providing advisory and regulatory guidance support. The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in airport data management, aeronautical information systems, FAA airport standards, and ICAO Annex 15 / Aeronautical Information Management (AIM) requirements. This role bridges FAA airport domain expertise with system modernization initiatives, ensuring ADIP remains the authoritative source for airport data collection, validation, dissemination, and regulatory compliance.

Primary Responsibilities

Airport Data & Aeronautical Information Support

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for the collection, verification, management, and dissemination of airport data across the ADIP application portfolio, including:
    • Airport Geographic Information System (AGIS)
    • Airport Master Record (AMR)
    • Digital 7480
    • Airport Data Manager (ADM)
    • Management of Survey (MOS)
    • Runway Analysis Management (RAM)
    • Runway Information Management (RIM)
    • Runway Safety Area (RSA)
    • Program Management Tool (PMT)
  • Support airport data quality management activities, ensuring:
    • Accuracy
    • Integrity
    • Traceability
    • Timeliness
    • Completeness
    • Resolution
    • Format compliance
  • Ensure adherence to ICAO Annex 15/AIM requirements and FAA Order 5010.4 standards.
  • Provide requirements analysis, validation, and technical recommendations for ADIP enhancements and modernization activities, including digital Airport Layout Plan (ALP) capabilities.

Advisory & Regulatory Support

  • Provide technical writing support for the development, revision, and maintenance of FAA airport guidance documents.
  • Draft and update technical content supporting:
    • AC 150/5300-16
    • AC 150/5300-17
    • AC 150/5300-18
    • AC 150/5300-19
    • FAA Order 5010.4
    • Engineering Briefs
    • Engineering Memorandums
  • Support FAA advisory, regulatory, programmatic, and technical activities associated with airport data and ADIP-related guidance.
  • Coordinate document reviews and ensure all deliverables receive COR approval prior to publication or implementation.

Standards, Quality, and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Support alignment of the ADIP Quality Management System with:
    • ICAO Annex 15
    • Aeronautical Information Management (AIM) standards

title: Investigative Analyst
description:

Position Title: Investigative Analyst

Salary Range: $56,942 - $60,410

Job Description:

The New York County District Attorney’s Office has an immediate opening for an Investigative Analyst in its Crime Strategies Unit (CSU). The Crime Strategies Unit proactively gathers and analyzes crime data and intelligence to drive the Office’s strategies on crime reduction and public safety. Members of CSU work closely with the New York City Police Department to identify and study crime trends, as well as groups and individuals most responsible for driving crimes that impact our communities, including violent crime, theft, and fraud. CSU also supports the mission of the Gun Violence Strategic Partnership, which brings together both state and federal law enforcement agencies to combat gun violence throughout New York City.

Investigative analysts are responsible for providing CSU with investigative, analytical, and data manipulation support. The position requires a critical thinker with a strong combination of data skills and technological savvy. Candidates should also possess strong organizational and communication skills, as CSU relies on analysts’ work product in presentations to the highest levels of the District Attorney’s Office as well as law enforcement and community partners.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Gather, analyze, and process data using industry-current and in-house proprietary applications to produce a complete model of crime trends in Manhattan neighborhoods.
  • Assist in developing and implementing intelligence-driven prosecution strategies targeting priority offenders.
  • Analyze intelligence to identify gun violence drivers in conjunction with local, state, and federal partners.
  • Gather, organize, and analyze firearm traces and ballistic comparison reports and data.
  • Support day-to-day unit functions as needed.
  • Create descriptive presentations and reports using statistical analysis, including cleaning and synthesizing data, and reconciling qualitative and quantitative data sources.
  • Perform a full range of administrative and paralegal duties as needed.

In addition to the Minimum Qualification Requirements, all candidates must possess the following:

  • Level 1 – Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college and one (1) year of experience either as a paralegal in the criminal justice field or equivalent.
  • Level 2 - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college and two (2) years of experience either as a paralegal in the criminal justice field or equivalent.
  • Level 3 - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college and three (3) years of experience either as a paralegal in the criminal justice field or equivalent.

*Master’s degree can be substituted for years of experience. *

Preferred Requirements/Skills:

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products. Excel experience (pivot tables; charts; functions; etc.) preferred.
  • Familiarity with data mapping, including geocoding preferred; and a fast learner regarding new technology tools and software. Experience using Photoshop; ArcGIS; i2 Analyst Notebook; etc. a plus.
  • Superior organizational, time management, writing, and communication skills are essential.
  • Capable of building institutional relationships with community residents and organizations, police, and other law enforcement agencies.
  • Ability to effectively communicate investigative results to other team members, and to testify in court if necessary.
  • Experience in the Criminal Justice System preferred.
  • An understanding of general practices related to legal records management, data protection, and privacy/confidentiality.

How to Apply:

  • Apply with a Cover Letter, Resume and Unofficial Transcript.

Hours/Shift:

  • Monday – Friday, 9:00 am – 5:00 pm.

Minimum Qualification Requirements:

  1. High school graduation or equivalent and three years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to duties described above; or
  2. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" above.

Additional Information:

  • Current office employees: To be eligible for a transfer or promotion, staff must have already served at least 1 year in their current position and be in good standing. In addition, must meet the minimum qualifications of the position.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test, Creative Apps
description:
What if your automation code was the last line of defense before a feature reached a billion devices? This role sits at the convergence of engineering rigor and product quality across Apple's iOS and macOS platforms — where the frameworks you build determine whether releases ship with confidence or not. The team operates end-to-end across the SDLC, and the bar for what 'good' looks like here resets what you thought quality engineering could be.

You'll architect and own test automation frameworks that run inside live CI/CD pipelines, catching regressions before they ever reach a human reviewer. Every sprint, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with software engineers and product managers who expect quality to be a design input, not an afterthought. The tools you write will compress release cycles, the gaps you find will shape roadmap decisions, and the standards you set will outlast any single product cycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in SDET, QA automation, or software engineering with a testing focus
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and Swift, specifically for building automated test frameworks and test tooling — not just scripting
  • Practical command of the full SDLC with clear experience embedding quality gates at multiple phases, from design review through release
  • Proven track record designing and executing multi-layered test strategies spanning functional, integration, regression, and exploratory methodologies
  • Direct experience building UI automation with XCUITest or XUI frameworks against real Apple platform targets
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and maintain them as living infrastructure
  • Applied LLMs or GenAI tooling to test generation, failure analysis, or coverage gap identification in a real engineering workflow
  • Built prompt engineering techniques into QA or developer tooling that measurably improved output quality or throughput
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or we may consider an equivalent depth demonstrated through industry work

Preferred Qualifications

  • Shipped quality automation across both iOS and macOS across multiple full release cycles — not just one platform or one cycle
  • Drove infrastructure improvements — framework refactors, pipeline optimizations, coverage initiatives — with documented impact on defect escape rates or release velocity
  • Extended automation scope beyond functional testing into performance, accessibility, or localization validation
  • Familiarity with photo and video editing applications or media-processing workflows, including experience testing or validating complex media-related features

title: Engine Lead
description:
Cowboy Space Corp. is building the infrastructure to power and connect the orbital economy. Our satellites operate in Low Earth Orbit to collect sunlight and enable a new class of capabilities—from powering on-orbit compute, to transmitting energy via infrared lasers (space-to-earth and space-to-space), to delivering secure, high-bandwidth optical data. By rethinking how energy and data are generated and distributed in space, we’re unlocking entirely new ways to operate both in orbit and on Earth.

Founded in 2024 by Baiju Bhatt (co-founder of Robinhood), Cowboy Space Corp. is backed by leading investors and built by a team from top aerospace and defense organizations. We’re moving quickly to solve complex technical challenges and build a new category of space infrastructure.

About the Role:

As the Engine Lead you will own the execution of this entire engine program lifecycle: from architecture and design through production, test, flight, and refurbishment. You will serve as chief engineer, program manager, technical lead, and lead systems engineer. You will lead a multi-disciplinary team of propulsion, structural, mechanical, avionics, software, and test engineers to deliver a flight-proven, reusable engine. You will work closely with vehicle integration, manufacturing, test, and launch operations teams as the engine integrates with the rest of the launch system and its lifecycle. You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly. This role reports to the Head of Launch & Propulsion.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the engine program from development through flight

  • Develop engine operation procedures and operational limits in coordination with vehicle, test stand, and launch operations teams

  • Define and manage schedule and budget for the engine program

  • Define the verification and qualification plan for engine requirements and manage its execution

  • Participate in test and launch operations to make real-time engineering decisions on technical risks

  • Own the engine's upgrade plan for improved reliability, rapid reusability, and faster production rate; derive upgrade scope and timelines to achieve these goals

  • Drive design-for-reuse decisions: inspection intervals, life-limited parts, refurbishment procedures, and acceptance criteria for reflown hardware

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in design, build, or test of rocket engines, combustion devices, turbopumps, or valves

  • Demonstrated experience on one or more development engine programs through a significant portion of the lifecycle (concept through development, qualification, or sustained operations)

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate a team of technical contributors spanning propulsion, mechanical, electrical, avionics and software disciplines

  • Strong knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals applied practically in a fast-paced development program

  • Exceptional command of fundamentals: compressible flow, thermodynamics, combustion, control systems, cryogenics, and instrumentation

  • Proficiency with fluid analysis tools (Python, NPSS, AMESim, Thermal Desktop, EES, REFPROP, or equivalent)

  • Strong data analysis and data reduction skills (test data to engine health/performance)

  • Proficiency with aerospace fasteners, seals, tubing, fittings, and COTS hardware

  • Hands-on experience with fabrication and assembly of engine hardware

  • Demonstrated history of excellent communication and team-building

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical or aerospace engineering, or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with gas-generator cycle engines or LNG/methane propulsion systems

  • Experience with engine reuse: inspection, refurbishment, and recertification processes

  • Experience with CAD tools and configuration management (Siemens NX/Teamcenter or equivalent)

  • Proficiency in GD&T, tolerance stackups, and material selection

  • Experience with various welding approaches (GTAW, laser, EB)

  • Familiarity with engine start/shutdown transient modeling and engine control system design



Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $250,000 - $285,000 annually. The actual base salary offered will depend on factors such as job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and internal equity.

  • Equity in Cowboy Space Corp.

  • Employees and their eligible dependents may enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year

  • Paid parental leave

  • Relocation assistance if applicable

  • Daily lunch in the office and a fully stocked kitchen with beverages and snacks

In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Handle heterogeneous APIs

Adhere to data protection and security standards (DSGVO-compliant encryption)

Experience in software architecture and quality management for containerized systems

Experience handling heterogeneous APIs and integrating HPC scheduler systems (e.g., SLURM)

Knowledge of encryption and data protection standards

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

title: Programme Analyst, Public Policy and Participation, NOA, FTA, La Havana, Cuba
description:
The Position:

The Programme Analyst, Public Policy and Participation is located in the UNFPA CUBA Country Office (CO) and reports to the Head of Office. The incumbent works closely with other programme and operations officers and contributes with strategic guidance to ensure efficient, effective, and timely design and delivery of UNFPA CO’s country programme results.

The main purpose of the Programme Analyst for Public Policy and Participation position is to provide technical and operational support in the design, implementation, and monitoring of interventions that strengthen public policies and promote citizen participation within the framework of the UNFPA Country Programme in Cuba. The Analyst will contribute to mainstreaming Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) actions—with a special emphasis on the prevention of adolescent pregnancy—and Population and Development dynamics into local and national normative frameworks. Through this role, the incumbent will facilitate social and youth participation mechanisms, ensuring that programmatic strategies actively engage the population, respond to their real needs, and enhance the impact of public policies within the national context.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead United Nations agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is intended, every childbirth is safe, and every young person's potential is fulfilled. The UNFPA Strategic Plan for 2026-2029 articulates the organization’s response to a complex global environment, providing a roadmap for resilience and renewal. It is designed to accelerate the implementation of the Programme of Action of the International Conference on Population and Development (ICPD) and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals by 2030. This mandate is pursued through a focus on four interconnected outcomes: ending the unmet need for family planning; ending preventable maternal deaths; ending gender-based violence and harmful practices; and adapting to demographic change through evidence and rights-based policies.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. We need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them, and who commit to delivering excellence in programme results

Job Purpose:

The Programme Analyst for Public Policy and Participation provides technical and operational support to strengthen national and local capacities for the design, execution, and oversight of policies and regulatory frameworks within the UNFPA Country Programme in Cuba. S/he prioritizes social and youth participation to advance Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH), with a specific emphasis on the prevention of adolescent pregnancy and the exercise of their rights, ensuring these efforts are deeply integrated with Population and Development dynamics. Additionally, the Analyst is responsible for providing operational assistance, facilitating collaboration with government counterparts, civil society organizations, and academic institutions, and ensuring that project monitoring and reporting strictly adhere to the results-based management approach and quality standards.

You would be responsible for:

  • Analyzes political, socio-economic, population and health situation relevant to UNFPA mandate and identifies strategic areas/opportunities and entry points for UNFPA's interventions, with particular attention to the set priorities as well as targeted groups (with due attention to adolescents, youth and women).
  • In collaboration with a wide range of partners and stakeholders,the incumbent significantly contributes to the conceptualization, formulation and design of the SRH and P&D programs component's projects/activities including through innovative approaches and models, with particular focus on projects in priority selected areas.
  • Guides and oversees the timely and efficient implementation and delivery of the SRH and P&D programs/projects/results including regular coordination meetings internally as well as externally.
  • Analyzes and reports on implementation/bottlenecks of the assigned programme activities, provides recommendations for corrective measures, monitors programme expenditures and disbursement to ensure delivery is in line with approved budgets.
  • Identifies, assesses, and engages strategic partners in support of the implementation of the projects.
  • Facilitates and guides the work of consultants, advisors and experts involved in the implementation of the program under her/his responsibility.
  • Maintains close working relationships with national and international counterparts involved in the implementation of the assigned programme/project activities.
  • Contributes to monitoring and evaluation of projects/activities through applying existing procedures and mechanisms as well as through development of new approaches and tools and ensures creation and regular documentation of knowledge about current trends, patterns, gaps in SRH to be used in different platforms (i.e. advocacy, media, policy, technical, planning. etc).
  • Identifies research gaps/needs and contributes to defining research priorities, objectives and scope and follows up on initiating and undertaking research work.
  • Provides expertise and facilitates advocacy activities relevant to SRH through preparation and dissemination of relevant information for evidence-based advocacy.
  • Supports communication, advocacy and resource mobilization through the compilation, presentation and synthesis of documents to be positioned in debates, dialogues and public events. Establishes and maintains the network of donors, civil society organizations, decision makers and the public to support the implementation of public policies.
  • Provides input into various reports/documents namely annual, progress, donor, technical, strategies, policies, etc.

Carry out any other tasks required by your supervisor.

Qualifications and Experience:

Education:


Master’s degree in Social Sciences, Law, Public Policy, Public Administration, or other related fields relevant to the UNFPA mandate.

Knowledge and Experience:

  • Progressively relevant experience in project coordination and/or research within UNFPA's mandate areas;
  • Specialized knowledge of international and national development policies, populations and related activities;
  • Background in planning implementing and reporting work experiences at the UN System will be considered an advantage;
  • Strong analytical ability and professional experience in representing an organization;
  • Excellent writing and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills.
  • Advanced computer skills are mandatory.

Languages:

Fluency in Spanish is required. English working knowledge is required.

Required Competencies:

Values:

  • Exemplifying integrity,
  • Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,
  • Embracing cultural diversity,
  • Embracing change

Core Competencies:

  • Achieving results,
  • Being accountable,
  • Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,
  • Thinking analytically and strategically,
  • Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,
  • Communicating for impact.

Functional Competencies:

  • Advocacy/advancing a policy-oriented agenda
  • Leveraging the resources of national governments and partners/building strategic alliances & partnerships
  • Delivering Results Based Programmes
  • Leading Global Advocacy for organizational priorities
  • Creating visibility for the organization.

Managerial Competencies:

  • Providing strategic focus
  • Engaging in internal/external partners and stakeholders
  • Leading, developing and empowering people, creating a culture of performance
  • Making decisions and exercising judgment.

Compensation and Benefits:

This position offers an attractive remuneration package including a competitive net salary plus health insurance and other benefits as applicable.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. title: Construction Project Coordinator
description:
Construction Project Coordinator

Twin Cities Siding & Roofing | Eden Prairie, MN
$50,000–$70,000 per year | Full-Time
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM
Approximately 70% Office / 30% Field
Bilingual English/Spanish Required

Know Construction but Ready to Get Off the Tools?

If you have experience working in roofing, siding, remodeling, residential construction, or with a subcontracting crew and are ready to take the next step in your career, this could be a great fit.

Twin Cities Siding & Roofing is hiring a Construction Project Coordinator to support our Project Management team and help keep residential exterior projects organized and moving from scheduling through completion.

This is a hands-on coordination role, not a traditional desk job. You'll spend most of your time working with our Project Managers from the office, while also visiting jobsites throughout the Twin Cities metro as needed.

You'll work directly with homeowners, subcontractors, crews, vendors, and our internal team, making fluent English and Spanish communication a requirement for this position.

What You'll Do

You'll support three Project Managers with the day-to-day coordination of active roofing, siding, and exterior remodeling projects.

Responsibilities include:

  • Coordinate project schedules and help keep active jobs moving on time
  • Assemble and review project packets, scopes, measurements, photos, material information, and job details
  • Communicate project information and scheduling with subcontractors and crews
  • Serve as a key point of communication with Spanish-speaking subcontractors and crew members
  • Communicate with homeowners regarding scheduling, project updates, questions, and next steps
  • Review invoices and project documentation for accuracy
  • Maintain accurate job information, notes, photos, and documentation in company systems
  • Coordinate materials, project requirements, and outstanding job items
  • Visit residential jobsites throughout the Twin Cities metro when field support is needed
  • Take jobsite photos and document project conditions
  • Assist with warranty inspections, project completion, and quality-control needs
  • Identify missing information or potential problems before they delay a project

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Fluent/bilingual English and Spanish communication
  • Some previous construction experience
  • Understanding of how a residential construction project or jobsite operates
  • Strong organization and attention to detail
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities
  • Comfortable communicating with homeowners, subcontractors, crews, and internal team members
  • Comfortable using computers, smartphones, and project-management technology
  • Willing and able to work approximately 30% of the role in the field
  • Comfortable visiting active residential construction sites
  • Willing to work occasional Saturdays during peak season, typically June through October
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record

Construction Experience Can Come From Several Backgrounds

You do not need to already be a Project Manager.

We'd like to hear from candidates who have worked in areas such as:

  • Roofing or siding
  • Residential remodeling
  • Exterior construction
  • Construction labor
  • Subcontracting or installation crews
  • Field supervision
  • Construction coordination
  • Production coordination
  • Roofing or exterior sales
  • Assistant Project Management

If you understand what it takes to get a construction project completed and want to move into a more stable, salaried coordination role, we encourage you to apply.

Office + Field Expectations

This position is approximately 70% office-based and 30% field-based.

Most days will be spent supporting project operations from our Eden Prairie office. Field responsibilities may include meeting with homeowners or subcontractors, taking jobsite photos, checking project conditions, and assisting with warranty or inspection needs.

Occasional ladder and roof access may be required for warranty or inspection purposes.

Company vehicles are available for business-related field visits. Vehicles are shared and are not individually assigned or taken home.

Schedule

  • Monday–Friday
  • 8:00 AM–4:00 PM
  • Occasional Saturdays may be required during peak production season, generally June through October

We want candidates to understand the schedule and field expectations upfront so you can determine whether this is the right fit before applying.

Compensation

$50,000–$70,000 annually, based on relevant construction experience, coordination experience, and overall qualifications.

This is a salaried opportunity for someone who wants to combine their construction knowledge with organization, communication, customer service, and project coordination.

Career Growth

This role offers the opportunity to learn more of the project-management side of residential exterior construction while working directly alongside an experienced Project Management team.

For someone who performs well and wants to continue developing, there is opportunity to grow toward increased project-management responsibility as the company and team continue to expand.

Benefits

Eligible full-time employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Employee assistance and additional voluntary benefit programs
  • Training and opportunities for advancement

About Twin Cities Siding & Roofing

Twin Cities Siding & Roofing has been serving homeowners throughout the Twin Cities and Central Minnesota since 1995.

We specialize in residential roofing, siding, windows, doors, and exterior remodeling and have built our reputation around quality craftsmanship and a strong homeowner experience.

We're continuing to grow and are looking for someone who can help our Project Management team stay organized, communicate effectively with our crews and customers, and keep projects moving.

If you're bilingual in English and Spanish, understand construction, and are ready to turn your field experience into a long-term career in construction operations and project management, we'd like to hear from you.

Twin Cities Siding & Roofing / Allstar Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description:
About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.

About Emplifi

Emplifi is the only Autonomous CX platform unifying social marketing, commerce, and customer care for more than 20,000 brands worldwide. Powered by Fuel AI, built on more than 5T of data, and recognized as a leader by leading industry analysts, Emplifi helps enterprise teams orchestrate connected customer journeys and deliver personalized experiences at scale, turning every customer touchpoint into a competitive advantage.


About the Product Team

At Emplifi, our mission is to transform how digital marketing—especially on social—is done, and how consumers connect with brands in the 21st century.

Our Product team sits at the heart of this mission. We build and evolve a data-driven SaaS platform that helps global enterprises market smarter. By bridging customer needs, business goals, and technical innovation, we break down silos, foster collaboration, and use insights to guide smart, impactful decisions.


About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape the future of Emplifi’s Data Insights capabilities — a core product area that enables brands to understand conversations, uncover emerging topics, and act on market signals that matter most.

This is about building intelligence that helps brands understand what people care about, how perceptions evolve, and where opportunities arise across digital channels. You’ll be leading a product area that helps marketers and strategists collect the right data and turn them into actionable insight—at scale.

You’ll own the roadmap, vision, and execution for this strategic capability, partnering closely with design, engineering, data science, and go-to-market teams to create powerful, intuitive experiences for enterprise users. This includes managing integrations with external data providers to ensure scalable, high-quality access to insights.

This position is remote/hybrid from within the Czech Republic, the UK, France, or Germany.



Why This Role Matters

In today’s world, tracking discourse, sentiment, and context across digital sources gives brands a competitive edge. Organizations that move fast to uncover trends, surface risks, and respond to emergent feedback win. You’ll lead a product at the intersection of data, AI, and strategy helping the world’s leading brands stay in tune with conversations, perceptions, and signals that shape their markets.

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Is passionate about turning complex, unstructured data into clear insight and action.
  • Understands how enterprise marketers, analysts, and strategists use insights to guide decisions.
  • Can translate business challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions powered by AI and analytics.
  • Thrives in a space where technology, storytelling, and customer empathy meet.

What You’ll Do Here

  • Own the vision and roadmap for one of the Data Insights product line — setting direction based on customer needs, market dynamics, and company goals.

  • Partner cross-functionally - collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Leadership to position the product for success across the customer lifecycle.
  • Measure what matters - define success metrics, analyze outcomes, and refine based on learnings to ensure continuous improvement and customer value.


What You’ll Bring to Us

  • Track record of product impact – You’ve successfully led products through key stages of their lifecycle, whether taking over complex existing solutions or driving new launches, and can demonstrate how you improved outcomes and measured results.
  • Deep familiarity with AI in practice — you actively use AI tools to enhance your workflow and have experience defining, delivering, and iterating on AI-powered features that create tangible value for users.
  • High autonomy & maturity – You’re ready to own a product stream within your first 90 days, defining strategy, uncovering new problems, and driving delivery without hand-holding.
  • Global mindset – Comfortable collaborating with colleagues and customers across time zones and cultures.
  • Agile mindset – Experienced in iterative releases, and data-driven optimisation.
  • Technical fluency & AI awareness – You can talk architecture with engineers, understand how complex distributed systems fit together, and spot opportunities to apply the latest AI/ML advances to solve customer problems.
  • Fluent, persuasive communicator – You write, present, and negotiate confidently in English while actively listening, distilling insights, persuading stakeholders, and selling product value.
  • Proactive problem-solver – You spot issues, rally the right people, and deliver solutions. No waiting for task lists.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with managing products that rely on external or third-party data sources. Comfortable analyzing ROI, negotiating data costs, and adapting quickly to changes in API availability or pricing.
  • Experience with analytics, data visualization, or insight-generation tools
  • Background in social media, audience research, or digital strategy

title: Senior Program Manager, Voice of the Customer , Leo Global Customer Operations
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the Voice of the Customer (VoC) program for Amazon Leo — a greenfield build spanning both consumer (B2C) and enterprise (B2B) customer segments. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role responsible for designing and operating the systems that transform customer feedback into actionable business intelligence, driving continuous improvement across the full customer journey from purchase through active service. This role is the architect of tools, systems, and customer connections — someone with a strong appetite for big data, technical depth to build and operate analytics infrastructure, and marketing acumen to translate customer signals into compelling narratives that drive action across the organization.
You will set the strategy, build the operational infrastructure, and run the day-to-day program, working across product, engineering, customer service, field service, marketing, legal, and data science to close the loop on customer feedback at scale.


Key job responsibilities
• Own end-to-end VoC program design and operations across B2C and B2B segments, including survey strategy, feedback touchpoint mapping, and escalation frameworks
• Partner with third-party vendors and internal engineering teams to integrate survey delivery across web, in-app, email, and field service channels
• Define and maintain VoC metrics, including CSAT, NPS, and operational proxy metrics, and establish escalation thresholds that trigger cross-functional action
• Build and operate real-time monitoring mechanisms, including flash reports, dashboards, and daily standup cadences, especially during high-intensity launch windows
• Lead cross-functional triage for customer-reported issues, routing signals to the appropriate owning teams (product, network engineering, hardware, CS, field service) and tracking resolution
• Design and operate business review cadences (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly) that connect customer feedback to leadership decision-making
• Collaborate with legal, privacy, and security teams to ensure survey and data handling practices meet compliance requirements
• Define go/no-go quality gates for new market launches using VoC-derived customer satisfaction and service reliability metrics
• Build and maintain the VoC analytics infrastructure in partnership with BI engineers, ensuring data from multiple feedback channels feeds a single source of truth

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
