title: Oracle Fusion ERP Technical Analyst
location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

We are looking for a seasoned Oracle Fusion ERP Technical Analyst to join our Financial Systems team and accelerate a portfolio of Order-to-Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R) and Procure to Pay (P2P) transformation initiatives. In this role you will own the design, development, and delivery of custom reports, data integration interfaces, document templates, and REST/SOAP API solutions within Oracle Fusion Cloud — enabling finance and cross-functional stakeholders to operate with greater speed and accuracy.

The Financial Systems team owns the technology backbone for Instacart's finance operations, managing Oracle Fusion, Zip, Billing Platform, OIC, HighRadius, Workiva, and FloQast. We partner closely with Finance, Platform Engineering, and the CTO organization to drive transformation initiatives that scale with the business. You'll work on meaningful projects, see your contributions in production quickly, and have a direct line to executive stakeholders.

What you'll cook up in your first year

Reporting & Analytics

  • Finance reporting requirements are met through a production-ready Oracle BIP library: data models, RTF templates, and scheduled bursting jobs are built and maintained, and parameterized BIP reports are exposed as REST endpoints for programmatic access by external systems and dashboards.
  • Business Intelligence Cloud Connector (BICC) extracts are configured and maintained for data warehouse integration and downstream analytics, giving finance stakeholders scalable, reusable access to financial data.

Document Customization

  • External-facing document templates, including Invoices, Credit Memos, Statements, and Purchase Orders, are designed and customized using RTF and XML Publisher, with corporate branding, conditional logic, and dynamic data sections applied to meet audit and customer experience standards.
  • Sub-templates and style templates are built and maintained to enforce consistent formatting across the full document library, reducing one-off customization work.

Data Integration & FBDI

  • File-Based Data Import (FBDI) templates and automation scripts are production-ready for bulk data loads across AR, AP, GL, and other Fusion modules, and inbound/outbound interface files (CSV, XML, JSON) are built and maintained for integrations with billing platforms, collections tools, and third-party financial applications, with load errors troubleshot, data mappings validated, and interface specs documented.

API & Systems Integration

  • REST and SOAP API integrations are live between Oracle Fusion and systems including Billing Platform, HighRadius, Workiva, and FloQast, designed and implemented using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and BIP-generated endpoints, with reusable integration patterns for inbound and outbound data flows aligned to CTO org architecture and API governance standards.

Transformation Project Support

  • O2C, R2R, and P2P transformation workstreams have clear technical specifications, with solutions documented in Confluence, development tasks tracked in Jira, and accurate status updates delivered to executive stakeholders through steerco and roadmap planning cycles.




The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud technical development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Oracle BIP: data models, RTF templates, XML Publisher, parameter-driven reports, and bursting.
  • Proven experience building FBDI templates across multiple Fusion modules (AR, AP, GL, FA, or similar).
  • Strong BICC configuration and data extraction experience for analytics and data warehouse use cases.
  • Experience designing and customizing Oracle Fusion invoice templates and other external-facing transactional documents using RTF and XML.
  • Proficiency with XML, XSLT, and XPath for document and data transformation.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or equivalent middleware for REST/SOAP API development.
  • Strong written communication skills — comfortable producing technical specs, interface docs, and steerco-ready summaries.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Oracle Fusion Cloud certification (Technical or Financials track).
  • Experience integrating Oracle Fusion with Workday, HighRadius, Workiva, FloQast, or billing/collections platforms.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and solution design documentation.
  • Exposure to BI Catalog management and OTBI reporting.
  • Experience with Oracle Smart View for Office for ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Financial Reporting Studio (FRS) for building formatted financial statements.
  • Familiarity with Financial Data Integration (FDI) for managing data load rules, mappings, and data management workflows (nice to have).
  • Exposure to Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) for building lightweight web UIs or extending Oracle Fusion applications.
  • Experience in a high-growth, fast-paced technology company.
  • Prior involvement in large-scale ERP transformation, module implementation, or re-platforming projects.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. title: Cage Shift Supervisor
description:
Cage Shift Supervisor

Position Summary
As a Team Member of the Cage team, the Cage Shift Supervisor is a CRCR Ambassador and takes personal ownership to ensure all of their actions are in the best interest of the business. The Cage Shift Supervisor oversees the daily operations of the Cage: monitoring and safeguarding CRCR assets and ensuring compliance with internal controls, Title 31, and all other business policies and procedures.

Position Functions
Essential Functions
• Provide exceptional internal and external Guest service, treating each with courtesy and consideration.
• Support and motivate Team Members while ensuring team responsibilities are being performed according to established departmental standards.
• Cooperate and communicate with all Team Members, always showing respect and consistently projecting a positive, helpful attitude.
• Monitor Cage Cashiers and Main Bankers to ensure transactions are properly completed, ensuring adherence to all MICS, Title 31, and departmental policies and procedures, and providing feedback to Management.
• Assist Cage Cashiers in buys and even exchanges.
• Closely supervise all cash flow and accompanying transactions into and out of the Cage; ensuring tight security is maintained in the Cage.
• Resolve Guest concerns and/or complaints in order to maintain positive Guest relations, expediting any issues to the appropriate departments, as necessary.
• Complete daily deposits and review internal audit documentation for accuracy and completion.
• Ensure balancing of all cash banks.
• Verify daily drop/count to the main bank when the Cage Cashier is unavailable.
• Monitor and maintain kiosk and ATM status and balances.
• Service kiosks and ATMs to include full balancing midpoint adjustments, adding or decreasing currency, and the overall upkeep of supplies and maintenance.
• Verify Cage Cashier’s banks and, if a variance exists, initiate an investigation, as necessary.
• Troubleshoot coin and currency counting equipment problems.
• Complete end-of-month cash inventory counts, reporting and submitting in a timely manner to management and Accounting.
• Document and inform management of all incidents or disputes relating to Guests, Team Members, and inter-departmental situations.
• Perform Cage Cashier and Main Banker duties as necessary.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Shift Supervisor Competencies
• Leads and manages people and processes while overseeing and directing daily department operations.
• Serves as the subject matter expert on departmental processes and procedures.
• Assist in recruitment, hiring, training, and Team Member engagement.
• Lead coaching, corrective counseling, and performance evaluations to Leads and Team Members.
• Set and oversee objectives and development for Leads and Team Members.
• Develop and adjust schedules to align with business requirements.
• Assists with employment terminations exclusively under the guidance and oversight of department management.

Skills
• Strong listening and communication skills.
• Problem-solving and critical thinking.
• Must be able to work independently and maintain a high level of performance.
• Must be able to complete tasks in a timely and efficient manner while maintaining business standards.
• Demonstrates a flock mentality, focused on teamwork and collaboration with others.
• Provides exceptional service to internal and external Guests while leveraging the knowledge of the position and the business, ensuring a clucktastic experience for all.
• Stays engaged and motivated with the business, department, and all Team Members at all levels while encouraging growth and development of self and others.
• Builds lasting relationships by demonstrating honesty, integrity, and effective communication.
• Driven to exceed expectations while remaining accountable and fair.
• Count and sort eggs blindfolded while only listening to smooth jazz.

Qualifications
Minimum requirements:
• Must be at least 21 years of age.
• High School Diploma (or GED or High School Equivalence Certificate).
• 2+ years in a Casino banking Lead or Supervisory role.
• Familiarity with training Team Members.
• Familiarity with cash handling with large volumes of cash and its policy and procedures.
• Basic math skills.
• Proficient in Windows and Microsoft Office Suite.

Preferred qualifications:
• 3+ years in a Casino banking Lead or Supervisory role.

title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Maintenance Coordinator who will help ensure our facilities are safe, clean, functional, and well-maintained every day. This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, responds quickly to practical problems, and enjoys supporting a high-quality workplace experience across multiple office locations. If you love keeping things running smoothly, solving facility challenges, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Maintenance Coordinator your key area of responsibility will be the daily upkeep, maintenance, and readiness of Geotab's office facilities. You will perform routine building maintenance and minor repairs across assigned locations, support ongoing, emergency, and preventive maintenance activities, and coordinate with property management and external vendors to resolve facility issues. You will use Jira to manage facilities requests, document issues and updates, track work through to resolution, and support clear communication with internal stakeholders. You will set up and relocate furniture for office moves, events, and workspace changes; monitor cleaning and maintenance supplies; maintain tools and equipment; and assist with the Pool Car program. You will serve as a first responder for facility issues, track outstanding work, and provide on-call and after-hours support as needed.

You will work closely with the Manager, Office Experience, property management, vendors, and colleagues across Geotab to keep facilities safe, functional, and ready for use. To be successful, you will be practical, organized, service-oriented, and comfortable working independently while contributing to a team. This fully on-site role includes routine travel between Oakville, Waterloo, Toronto, and other Geotab offices.

How you'll make an impact:

• Perform upkeep and maintenance of all interior and exterior spaces across assigned Geotab locations.

• Complete minor adjustments and repairs to building equipment, systems, fixtures, and infrastructure.

• Travel to satellite offices, including Waterloo and Toronto, to perform maintenance, inspections, and minor repairs.

• Support scheduling of ongoing, emergency, and preventive building maintenance activities.

• Coordinate with external vendors and property management for facility maintenance, repairs, and service delivery.

• Set up, arrange, relocate, or remove furniture and decorations to support office moves, events, and workspace changes.

• Respond to facility emergencies and urgent maintenance requests during and outside business hours.

What you'll bring to this role:

• High school diploma or equivalent experience.

• One to three years of experience in janitorial services, building maintenance, facilities coordination, or a related field.

• Working knowledge of building maintenance procedures, cleaning equipment, products, techniques, and safe operating practices.

• Ability to perform minor repairs to building systems, fixtures, and equipment.

• Strong organization, prioritization, communication, problem-solving, and service-oriented teamwork skills.

• Valid driver's license for travel between office locations and Pool Car program support.

• Trade certifications or WHMIS training are assets; willingness to provide on-call and after-hours support as needed.

title: Senior Product Designer - Customer (B2B)
description:
Who We Are

Zoopla is a leading UK property website and trusted consumer brand, empowering movers to make better property decisions with over nine million monthly users generating over one billion annual property searches.

Zoopla is more than a property portal. Over 5 million homeowners are subscribers, tracking their property values and providing a pipeline of movers for Zoopla’s customers (estate agents and housebuilders). The business is investing in leveraging its scale and reach to build new, AI-driven experiences that engage movers and unlock value and a strong return on investment for customers.

Our guiding behaviours define how we work together and what we expect from one another. These behaviours are to keep it simple, take ownership, make it better and win together. We strive for progress not perfection and have no doubt that we can achieve our ambitions if we focus on the right things, give it our all and do it together.

About the role

This is a full-time, permanent position.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the experience of Zoopla’s commercial marketplace: the platforms, tools and workflows that agents, developers and property professionals, plus the consumer-facing surfaces and advertising products tied to those businesses. This is a significant part of Zoopla’s business, generating real revenue and shaping how professionals and their clients experience our brand.

This is a hands-on role with real scope to shape both what we build and how we build it. You’ll work across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems through to delivery and optimisation, designing experiences that are intuitive, useful and deliver real business impact. You won’t just respond to briefs; you’ll help define opportunity areas, connect work to broader product and business goals, and ensure what we build delivers measurable results.

This role suits someone who moves comfortably between feature and product-level craft and the wider systems and workflows they sit within, is comfortable when the buyer isn’t the user, and balances improving what exists today with shaping what comes next.

What you’ll do

Ownership and Impact

  • Own design within your team from problem framing through to delivery and optimisation, taking responsibility for outcomes not just outputs
  • Translate customer behaviour and insight into clear opportunities, prioritising work based on impact, effort and business value
  • Balance user needs, buyer needs, technical constraints and commercial priorities when shaping solutions

Designing across the commercial marketplace

  • Design across the marketplace, from the workflows professionals rely on to the consumer-facing and advertising experiences that support those businesses
  • Design intuitive, high-quality tools and platform experiences for frequent, high-volume use by expert users, accounting for the roles, permissions and operational complexity
  • Connect workflows across the full customer lifecycle, from trial and onboarding through to adoption, expansion and renewal

Data, Experimentation and Growth

  • Define clear success metrics for your work through measurable outcomes
  • Use data, research and behavioural insight to identify opportunities and inform decisions
  • Design and iterate through experimentation, working with Product, Engineering and Data to test, learn and optimise journeys over time
  • Continuously refine experiences based on performance, contributing to a culture of learning and optimisation

Exploration and Craft

  • Look beyond the current roadmap to identify new opportunities that drive customer and business value
  • Rapidly explore and validate ideas through prototyping and testing
  • Use modern tools and approaches, including AI-assisted design, to improve speed and quality of output
  • Contribute to design systems and ways of working that improve quality, consistency and speed across a complex product suite

Collaboration & Influence

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to align on goals and shape problems, not just solutions
  • Influence prioritisation and decision-making by clearly articulating customer value, business impact and trade-offs
  • Facilitate workshops and communicate ideas, rationale and outcomes clearly to stakeholders at different levels
  • Act as a strong design voice within your team, raising the quality of thinking and execution

What we’re looking for

Please include a portfolio (with ease of access) showing end-to-end work on complex, workflow-heavy problems.

  • Proven experience designing B2B, SaaS, platform or marketplace products end-to-end.
  • Experience designing complex, workflow-heavy interfaces, including multi-step processes, roles and permissions
  • Strong product thinking, with the ability to connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes
  • Fluent in qualitative and quantitative research methods, and comfortable working with experimentation and performance data
  • Experience working directly with customers and with the internal teams who represent them
  • Confident collaborating across disciplines, facilitating workshops and influencing decisions without authority
  • Curious about emerging technologies (including AI) and how they can be applied to improve customer experience, decision-making and product capability
  • Proficiency in design tools such as Figma or similar, and can adapt your approach to the needs of the project.

The kind of designer who thrives here

  • You think strategically and look beyond immediate tasks to identify opportunities and drive impact
  • You take ownership from problem through to measurable outcome
  • You’re comfortable when the buyer isn’t the user, and can design for both
  • You understand how design contributes to business success, not just user experience
  • You’re pragmatic about legacy, improving products incrementally while holding a clear long-term view
  • You’re proactive, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

Where You’ll Be

At Zoopla we embrace hybrid working but emphasise the importance of also spending time together. You’ll have the opportunity to work remotely (at home) for two days per week with Mondays and Thursdays as all-Zoopla days in the office together plus a third in-office day of your choosing.

Our home in Tower Bridge is a wonderful hub for collaborative and individual working, with space to socialise and exercise. On our doorstep you’ll find buzzing Borough, Bankside and Bermondsey, not to mention soaring river views.

Benefits

  • Our hybrid setup means you’ll join us in the Tower Bridge office 3 days each week
  • 25 days annual leave + additional leave benefits Including extra days for length of service, plus other leave perks
  • Cycle to work and electric car schemes
  • Free Calm App membership
  • Enhanced Parental leave
  • Fertility Treatment Financial Support
  • Group Income Protection and private medical insurance
  • Gym on-site in London
  • 7.5% pension contribution by the company
  • Discretionary annual bonus up to 10% of base salary

title: Sr. SAP Commerce Platform Engineer
description:
Legrand North America has a remote opportunity for a Senior SAP Commerce Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Digital Systems team. This is a deep platform engineering role (not a maintenance role).
You will build and extend the SAP Commerce backend, integrate it with upstream enterprise systems through middleware, and own problems end to end — from the storefront request down through the service and persistence layers to the integration boundary. The platform serves multiple brands and storefronts and is evolving toward a composable, headless architecture, so your work at the core is consumed by every team that builds on top of it.
We are seeking engineer who can operate independently inside the platform: reason through the full stack, diagnose production issues by working directly through SAP Commerce and Dynatrace logs, and resolve them at the root.
At a Glance
  • Work inside a centralized SAP Commerce backend that powers multiple brand storefronts. Some storefronts are owned by the platform team; others are owned by business-unit teams who consume what you build. Decisions you make in the core propagate outward to all of them.
  • Hands-on backend engineering: building and maintaining custom SAP Commerce extensions — type system, service layer, interceptors, cron jobs, ImpEx, integration logic — and on the integrations that connect commerce to upstream enterprise systems (ERP, PIM/Stibo, CRM) through middleware.
  • Independent troubleshooting through SAP Commerce Cloud and Dynatrace is a daily expectation. You should be the person who can take an ambiguous production symptom and trace it through logs, traces, and code to a root cause without escalation.
  • The platform is moving toward headless / composable (OCC APIs, headless content, search). Sound API and contract judgment matters and is valued — but it sits on top of, and depends on, real depth in the backend itself.
  • This role reports into Platform Engineering and partners with the platform architect on design and estimate validation. You'll be expected to operate with independent technical direction and full ownership of outcomes in your domain.
Build and extend the SAP Commerce backend
  • Design, build, and maintain custom SAP Commerce extensions — data models, service layer, facades, interceptors, cron jobs, and platform logic — following sound architecture for a multi-brand, multi-storefront environment.
  • Work fluently across the SAP Commerce stack: type system and persistence, the Spring-based service layer, ImpEx, FlexibleSearch, and the build/deploy model on Commerce Cloud.
  • Develop new platform capabilities against business requirements, and maintain and refactor the existing codebase, including the accelerator-based storefront that runs today.
Integrate with upstream systems
  • Build and maintain integrations between SAP Commerce and upstream enterprise systems (ERP, PIM/Stibo, CRM) — through middleware where appropriate — using standard, resilient integration patterns.
  • Reason clearly about data ownership and authority: which system is the source of truth under which conditions, and how the platform behaves when an upstream system is slow, stale, or unavailable.
  • Where the architecture calls for it, design and build OCC / commerce APIs with consistent semantics and stable versioning so downstream storefronts can integrate without bespoke work.
Diagnose and resolve — independently
  • Take ownership of production issues and drive them to permanent resolution: reproduce, isolate, root-cause, fix, and verify.
  • Work directly through SAP Commerce Cloud logs and the Dynatrace observability stack — traces, service flow, log analysis, performance metrics — to diagnose issues across a multi-layered, integrated architecture. This is a core, daily skill, not an occasional one.
  • Communicate root cause and impact clearly to the team and to stakeholders and follow through on action items to closure.
Raise the floor of the team
  • Conduct PR reviews for domain correctness and architectural adherence — and use review as a mechanism to grow other developers, not just to gate merges.
  • Produce documentation that is ahead of the team's needs. Knowledge, you hold must be transferable, not tribal — the platform should not stall when any one person is unavailable.
  • Be present at the solutioning and design stage, catching design risks before they enter a sprint as defects.
Operate in delivery
  • Participate in requirements and scope definition, providing credible estimates grounded in real platform constraints.
  • Work in an Agile delivery model (Kanban / sprint-based) with disciplined feature flagging, fallback logic, error handling, and test coverage on all new code.
Required:
  • Backend depth: strong, demonstrable SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) backend experience — typically 6+ years — with full, independent ownership of non-trivial extension and platform work. Evaluated on the scope you have owned.
  • Extension development: you build extensions confidently across the type system, persistence layer, Spring service layer, interceptors, ImpEx, and FlexibleSearch, and apply sound design patterns and OOD principles in a layered architecture.
  • Full-stack reasoning: you can reason through the full stack — from a storefront or API request, through the service and persistence layers, to the integration boundary — and locate a problem without being walked to it.
  • Observability & troubleshooting: you are highly comfortable diagnosing issues directly through SAP Commerce Cloud logs and Dynatrace. Given an ambiguous production symptom, you can trace it to root cause independently.
  • Integration: you have built and maintained integrations between SAP Commerce and upstream systems (ERP, PIM, CRM), including through middleware, and can reason about authority, resilience, and failure behavior across system boundaries.
  • Independence: you own outcomes end to end can work idependently while making consistent progress. You communicate root cause and impact clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred:
  • Data & search: strong SQL and Solr; comfort with the data and search layers underneath commerce.
  • Headless mindset: experience with, or clear ability to reason about, a headless / composable model where the storefront is decoupled from the backend (OCC consumed by Spartacus/Composable Storefront or a custom React frontend).
  • Engineering leadership: a track record of making the engineers around you more capable through documentation, design input, and review.
    Familiarity with composable / MACH architecture, Contentful (or another headless CMS), Algolia, and Cloudinary.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience.

title: Crisis Management Program Manager
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Global Security plays a critical role in protecting Axon's people, facilities, operations, and reputation. As the Crisis Management Program Manager, you will build and lead the programs that enable the organization to prepare for, respond to, and recover from disruptive events.

Serving as the operational heartbeat and connective tissue across Global Security and key business partners; including Legal, HR, Workplace, Communications, IT, Manufacturing, and Executive Leadership, you will establish the frameworks, governance, and relationships that transform crisis management from a reactive function into a strategic enterprise capability.

This is a unique opportunity to build a program from the ground up, influence executive decision-making, and help shape the future of Global Security at one of the world's most innovative technology companies.

What You'll Do

Build Axon's Preparedness Program

This role offers a unique opportunity to build a capability that will shape how Axon prepares for and responds to critical events around the world. Working across Global Security and key business partners, you will design and mature the frameworks, governance, and operational standards that enable coordinated, confident decision-making when it matters most. Success in this role will be measured not only by how effectively crises are managed, but by how well the organization is prepared before they occur.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for Axon's Crisis Management Program, ensuring it evolves alongside the company's global growth and operational complexity.
  • Design and maintain enterprise crisis management frameworks, governance, standards, and response methodologies that promote consistency across the organization.
  • Build and continuously refine crisis playbooks, decision support tools, and operational procedures that enable rapid, coordinated responses to a broad range of scenarios.
  • Champion a culture of preparedness by establishing sustainable processes that improve organizational readiness and strengthen enterprise resilience over time.

Lead Enterprise Crisis Coordination

When critical events occur, effective coordination becomes just as important as the response itself. In this role, you will provide the structure, leadership, and operational discipline that enable cross-functional teams to respond as one. By establishing clear decision-making frameworks, escalation protocols, and communication pathways, you will help ensure the right people are engaged at the right time with the information they need to make informed decisions.

Working alongside the GSOC, Physical Security, Threat Intelligence, Workplace, HR, Legal, Communications, IT, Manufacturing, and Executive Leadership, you will help orchestrate coordinated responses that minimize operational disruption, protect our people, and strengthen confidence across the organization.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the coordination of cross-functional crisis response activities during significant security incidents and disruptive events.
  • Develop and maintain crisis activation procedures, escalation matrices, and decision-support frameworks that enable timely, consistent responses.
  • Facilitate Crisis Management Team (CMT) meetings, ensuring clear accountability, actionable decisions, and effective follow-through.
  • Prepare executive situation reports and operational updates that provide leaders with timely, accurate, and actionable information.
  • Coordinate post-incident reviews, capturing lessons learned and driving measurable improvements across the Crisis Management Program.

Strengthen Executive Decision-Making

During rapidly evolving situations, timely information and thoughtful coordination can significantly influence business outcomes. In this role, you will help transform complex, fast-moving events into clear, actionable intelligence that enables leaders to make informed decisions with confidence. Working closely with the Crisis Management Team (CMT), GSOC, Threat Intelligence, and executive stakeholders, you will ensure decision-makers have the right information, at the right time, in the right format.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop executive briefing templates, situation reports, and decision-support tools that provide clarity during complex events.
  • Coordinate executive notification and escalation processes for significant incidents affecting people, operations, facilities, or reputation.
  • Partner with Global Security leadership to ensure executive communications remain timely, accurate, and aligned throughout an incident.
  • Support executive travel, strategic events, and other high-profile activities by integrating preparedness planning into broader security operations.
  • Continuously improve executive crisis support processes based on lessons learned and evolving business needs.

Build Trusted Partnerships Across Axon

Effective crisis management begins long before an incident occurs. Success in this role will depend on your ability to build trusted relationships across the organization, creating alignment before critical decisions need to be made. You'll become a recognized partner to leaders throughout Axon, helping departments understand how preparedness strengthens business continuity, supports operational excellence, and enables the company to respond with confidence during times of uncertainty.

Through collaboration, influence, and credibility, you'll strengthen Global Security's position as a trusted business partner while fostering a shared culture of preparedness across the enterprise.

You will:

  • Build trusted partnerships with leaders across Legal, HR, Workplace, IT, Manufacturing, Communications, GRC, Physical Security, GSOC, Threat Intelligence, and other business functions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions that align roles, responsibilities, and response expectations before incidents occur.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for enterprise crisis preparedness initiatives, ensuring stakeholders remain informed, engaged, and aligned.
  • Promote preparedness through education, consultation, and relationship-building across the organization.
  • Represent Global Security in cross-functional meetings, projects, and strategic initiatives where crisis preparedness and organizational resilience are key considerations.

Advance Preparedness Through Technology & Innovation

Technology plays a critical role in enabling effective crisis management, but its true value lies in how it simplifies decision-making, strengthens situational awareness, and enhances organizational preparedness. In this role, you will continuously evaluate and improve the tools, processes, and technologies that support Axon's Crisis Management Program, ensuring they evolve alongside the company's growth and operational needs.

You'll help shape the future of crisis management by identifying opportunities to leverage automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and emerging technologies that improve readiness, reduce complexity, and enable faster, more informed decision-making across the enterprise.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the evolution of technology and digital capabilities that support Axon's Crisis Management Program.
  • Develop meaningful dashboards, reporting, and performance metrics that provide visibility into organizational preparedness and program maturity.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and data-driven insights to improve crisis management processes and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain the digital resources, documentation, and information systems that support rapid activation and coordinated response.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices to continuously strengthen Axon's preparedness capability.

Champion Continuous Learning & Organizational Resilience

The strongest crisis management programs are built on continuous learning, not perfect execution. Every exercise, incident, and emerging threat presents an opportunity to strengthen Axon's preparedness and improve how we operate. In this role, you will foster a culture of learning by capturing insights, challenging existing assumptions, and translating experience into meaningful improvements that increase organizational resilience over time.

You'll help ensure that preparedness is never static; continuously evolving our frameworks, processes, and capabilities as Axon grows, technology advances, and the global risk landscape changes.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead enterprise tabletop exercises, functional drills, and preparedness assessments that validate plans and strengthen organizational readiness.
  • Conduct after-action reviews that identify opportunities for improvement and translate lessons learned into measurable enhancements.
  • Develop readiness metrics that help leaders understand program maturity, preparedness trends, and opportunities for continued investment.
  • Monitor emerging risks, industry best practices, and evolving threats to ensure Axon's preparedness program remains modern, relevant, and effective.
  • Champion a mindset of continuous improvement by encouraging innovation, collaboration, and organizational learning across Global Security and enterprise partners.

What You Bring

The Leader We're Looking For

Building an enterprise crisis management capability requires more than technical expertise. We're looking for a builder; someone who thrives in ambiguity, earns trust through relationships, and sees opportunities where others see obstacles. You'll be equally comfortable briefing executives, facilitating cross-functional planning sessions, improving operational processes, and leading the organization through complex events with confidence and composure.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, understanding that the strongest crisis management programs are built long before they're needed.

Experience That Will Help You Thrive

Building an enterprise crisis management capability requires a unique combination of strategic thinking, operational excellence, and relationship leadership. While no candidate will possess every experience listed below, the most successful leaders will bring a demonstrated ability to build programs, influence across organizations, and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments where ambiguity is an opportunity rather than a barrier.

Experience that will help you thrive includes:

  • Building or maturing enterprise crisis management, emergency management, business continuity, resilience, or related programs.
  • Leading complex, cross-functional initiatives that require influence rather than direct authority.
  • Developing executive briefings, governance frameworks, operational playbooks, or strategic response plans.
  • Partnering effectively with senior leaders and diverse business functions to solve complex organizational challenges.
  • Leveraging technology, data, and innovation to improve operational effectiveness and organizational preparedness.
  • Translating lessons learned into sustainable improvements that strengthen long-term organizational capability.

Education & Core Qualifications

Rather than treating qualifications as a checklist, we value demonstrated leadership, sound judgment, and a proven ability to build and influence enterprise programs. If your experience aligns with the mission of this role, we encourage you to apply—even if your background doesn't match every qualification exactly.

Core qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • Experience leading or supporting crisis management, emergency management, enterprise security, business continuity, resilience, or related operational programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated project and program management experience.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment.

Certifications & Experience That Differentiate You

Experience in any of the following areas will help accelerate your success in this role:

  • Crisis Management
  • Emergency Management
  • Business Continuity
  • Corporate Security
  • Enterprise Risk
  • Threat Intelligence
  • Executive Protection
  • FEMA / ICS
  • CPP
  • CBCP
  • MBCI
  • PMP

How You Lead

The most successful leaders in this role combine humility with confidence, strategy with execution, and preparation with action. They build trust through relationships, remain composed under pressure, and inspire confidence by bringing clarity to complexity.

You don't need to have all the answers—you need to know how to bring the right people together to solve the right problems.

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Lead with integrity and sound judgment.
  • Build trust across teams and functions.
  • Communicate with clarity, confidence, and empathy.
  • Stay calm and decisive during periods of uncertainty.
  • Continuously seek opportunities to improve people, processes, and technology.
  • Think strategically while executing with operational discipline.
  • Embrace innovation and challenge conventional thinking.
  • Take ownership, inspire confidence, and leave programs stronger than you found them.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn't measured by the number of incidents you manage—it's measured by how prepared Axon becomes because of the capability you've built.

Within your first 12 to 18 months, you'll establish the foundation of a world-class Crisis Management Program that strengthens executive decision-making, improves organizational preparedness, and reinforces Global Security as a trusted enterprise partner.

You'll know you're successful when:

  • Axon has a mature, scalable Crisis Management Program that supports the company's continued global growth.
  • Executive leaders have confidence in the processes, tools, and information available during significant events.
  • Cross-functional partners view Global Security as a trusted advisor in preparedness planning and crisis coordination.
  • Crisis playbooks, exercises, and governance become embedded into the organization's operating rhythm.
  • Technology, automation, and innovation simplify crisis management while improving organizational visibility and readiness.
  • Every significant event results in measurable improvements that leave the organization stronger than before.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

title: Sr. Program Manager, IQ SST Product Manager
description:
Enphase Energy is a global energy technology company and a leading provider of solar, battery, and electric vehicle charging products. Founded in 2006, our innovative microinverter technology revolutionized solar power, making it a safer, more reliable, and scalable energy source. Today, the Enphase Energy System enables users to make, use, save, and sell their own power. Enphase is also one of the most successful and innovative clean energy companies in the world, with more than 87 million products shipped across 160 countries.

Enphase is now extending its proven distributed power architecture beyond residential and commercial solar into large-scale infrastructure with the IQ Solid-State Transformer (IQ SST) — a GaN-based, semiconductor- and software-defined power platform purpose-built for AI and hyperscale data centers. Each IQ SST rack combines hundreds of intelligent power modules operating in a coordinated series/parallel configuration to convert medium-voltage grid power directly to 800V DC, and the platform is designed to scale to gigawatt-level deployments. Join us in bringing this next-generation product from engineering validation to full-scale manufacturing.

The Role

The Senior Program Manager, IQ SST Product Development is a mission-critical role responsible for driving the IQ SST program from engineering development through New Product Introduction (NPI) and into high-volume manufacturing. This role sits at the center of the program, bringing together Engineering, Procurement, and Manufacturing/Operations to ensure a technically complex, large-scale hardware system is delivered on time, at quality, and at cost. This role requires exceptional cross-functional coordination to translate engineering designs into a manufacturable, sourceable, and scalable production plan. You will be the person who ensures that all functional groups stay in lockstep.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end program execution for IQ SST, driving the product through the complete development lifecycle — design, validation, pilot builds, and volume ramp — on schedule and within budget.
  • Serve as the primary bridge between Engineering (HW/SW/firmware), Procurement, and Manufacturing, translating technical requirements into sourcing and production plans and surfacing manufacturing/supply constraints back into design decisions early.
  • Build and maintain the integrated program schedule across engineering milestones, component qualification, supplier lead times, tooling, and production ramp.
  • Partner with Procurement to drive component sourcing strategy, supplier selection, and qualification for a high-volume, semiconductor-heavy bill of materials, including domestic/US manufacturing considerations.
  • Partner with Manufacturing/Operations to plan and execute pilot and production line readiness, including line balancing, yield ramp, and capacity planning for large-scale module production.
  • Identify, track, and drive resolution of cross-functional risks and dependencies (design changes, part shortages, tooling delays, compliance/regulatory holds) before they impact schedule.
  • Provide regular program status, dashboards, and executive-level updates, clearly communicating trade-offs, risks, and decisions to senior leadership.
  • Facilitate cross-functional design reviews, build readiness reviews, and change management processes to keep Engineering, Procurement, and Manufacturing aligned on scope and timing.
  • Ensure compliance, quality, and regulatory requirements (including relevant grid, safety, and data center standards) are integrated into the program plan from the outset.
  • Champion process improvements and tooling (dashboards, automation) to scale program execution as IQ SST moves from pilot to gigawatt-scale volume.
  • Drive productive uses of AI within the project to reduce overhead on the team

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of experience as a Program Manager or Technical Program Manager delivering complex, high-quality hardware/software products from development through volume manufacturing, ideally in power electronics, energy storage, solar, or other high-volume hardware systems.
  • Proven experience managing programs through the full product lifecycle, including NPI and the transition from engineering prototypes to high-volume production.
  • Direct experience bridging Engineering and Operations/Procurement — you're equally comfortable in a design review and a supplier negotiation, and you know how to translate between the two.
  • Strong working knowledge of hardware development lifecycles, embedded systems/firmware development, and electro-mechanical product introduction.
  • Experience with supply chain and procurement fundamentals: supplier qualification, sourcing strategy, component lead times, and BOM cost management for complex, high-volume hardware.
  • Familiarity with manufacturing ramp planning: line readiness, yield management, and capacity scaling for large-scale production.
  • Familiarity with compliance, quality, and regulatory requirements relevant to power electronics and/or data center infrastructure.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills — written, verbal, and via dashboards/status reporting — with the ability to drive clarity and alignment across technical and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead high-velocity, cross-functional programs with significant external dependencies (suppliers, contract manufacturers, customers/partners) and to drive decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Strong knowledge of program management tools and methodologies (PMP certification or equivalent a plus); comfortable operating in both waterfall and Agile/hybrid environments.

title: Modeling & Simulation Engineer
description:
Modeling & Simulation Engineer

Location: Redstone Arsenal (Huntsville, Alabama)

Position Overview:

Crossflow Technologies seeks an engineer to support the development, integration, and application of modeling and simulation (M&S) capabilities for hypersonic systems. This role will focus on integrating disparate engineering models and simulation tools into efficient analytical workflows, conducting hypersonic trajectory and aerothermal analyses, and developing software to automate simulation setup, execution, and post-processing. The engineer will work across software development and aerospace engineering disciplines to evaluate vehicle performance throughout hypersonic flight environments and improve the tools and processes used to perform multidisciplinary analysis.

Key Responsibilities

  • Integrate, maintain, and enhance M&S tools by connecting standalone engineering models and simulation applications into unified analytical workflows.
  • Develop Python-based software, scripts, and automation for simulation setup, execution, data processing, and analysis.
  • Generate, evaluate, and optimize hypersonic vehicle trajectories across relevant mission and flight conditions.
  • Perform aerothermal analyses to characterize vehicle and system performance throughout hypersonic flight.
  • Develop and maintain pre-processing and post-processing workflows for structural, thermal, and aerothermal models.
  • Extract, process, visualize, and interpret simulation results to support engineering assessments and design decisions.
  • Support finite element analysis (FEA) workflows, including preparation and generation of computational meshes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, repeatability, and robustness of multidisciplinary analysis pipelines.
  • Troubleshoot integration, execution, and data-interface issues across engineering models and simulation tools.
  • Develop and maintain software using GitLab, version control, code review, testing, documentation, and other software development best practices.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to integrate trajectory, aerothermal, structural, and other analysis capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering or technical discipline.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, particularly for scientific computing, engineering analysis, scripting, or workflow automation.
  • Experience developing or integrating modeling and simulation tools or engineering analysis software.
  • Experience automating simulation workflows, including model configuration, execution, and processing of simulation outputs.
  • Understanding of hypersonic flight mechanics and trajectory analysis.
  • Understanding of aerodynamics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, and aerothermal effects relevant to high-speed flight.
  • Experience analyzing engineering or simulation data and communicating results to technical stakeholders.
  • Experience using Git/GitLab or comparable configuration-management and collaborative software-development tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues spanning software, simulation models, inputs, outputs, and computational environments.
  • Active Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience generating, analyzing, or optimizing hypersonic vehicle trajectories.
  • Experience conducting aerothermal analysis of hypersonic vehicles across varying flight conditions.
  • Familiarity with finite element analysis (FEA) and structural or thermal modeling.
  • Experience with mesh generation and preparation of models for numerical analysis.
  • Experience coupling or integrating multidisciplinary engineering models, such as trajectory, aerodynamics, aerothermal, thermal, and structural models.
  • Familiarity with scientific Python libraries and numerical methods used for engineering analysis.
  • Experience developing pre-processing and post-processing tools for large or complex simulation datasets.
  • Experience creating reproducible and automated engineering analysis pipelines.
  • Familiarity with high-performance or distributed computing environments used for computational engineering analysis.

title: Video Production Specialist
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

OPSWAT Academy is looking for a Video Production Specialist to own the full video production lifecycle: filming, editing, post-production, and studio management for our educational and marketing content.
You will be the on-the-ground production lead at our Tampa office. You run recording sessions with executives and subject matter experts, and travel to events and conferences to capture content in the field.
This is a hands-on role. You are the primary creator, owning production from setup to final delivery.

What you will be do:

Studio Production

  • Operate camera (dual-angle setup), lighting, and audio equipment for every recording session
  • Direct speakers on framing, pacing, and delivery
  • Manage studio setup, teardown, and equipment maintenance
  • Ensure consistent, professional output across all content formats (explainer videos, podcasts, interviews)

Video Editing & Post-Production

  • Edit raw footage into polished final videos (multi-camera sync, jump cuts, transitions, text overlays)
  • Add graphics, lower thirds, motion design, and branded elements
  • Sound design: background music, SFX, audio leveling, noise reduction
  • Color grading for visual consistency across all content
  • Export in multiple formats (YouTube 4K, social media 1080p, 15-second promos)
  • Target turnaround: 5 business days from recording to published video

Event Coverage & Field Production

  • Travel to training bootcamps, conferences, and partner events (domestic and occasional international)
  • Capture event footage: speaker sessions, hands-on labs, attendee interviews, b-roll
  • Produce event highlight reels, recap videos, and testimonial clips
  • Manage portable production gear for on-location shoots

Social Media Content (Supporting)

  • Edit short-form video content for LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and social channels
  • Create social promos and teasers from longer-form content
  • Support the Academy team with ad-hoc content requests

What we need from you:

Must Have

  • 2-5 years of hands-on video production experience (filming + editing)
  • Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro (primary editing tool)
  • Experience operating DSLR/mirrorless cameras (Sony A7 series or equivalent)
  • Working knowledge of lighting setups (3-4 point lighting, LED panels)
  • Working knowledge of audio (wireless lavalier mics, podcast recording, audio leveling)
  • Ability to work independently and manage a full shoot from setup to delivery
  • Portfolio or reel demonstrating talking-head videos, interviews, or corporate content
  • Willingness to travel (estimated 15-20% of time)
  • Based in or willing to relocate to the Tampa/Orlando area

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Adobe After Effects for motion graphics
  • Experience with DaVinci Resolve or CapCut
  • Experience with Descript for transcript-based editing
  • Familiarity with YouTube optimization (thumbnails, descriptions, end screens)
  • Experience in cybersecurity, technology, or B2B SaaS (not required but helpful)
  • Drone operation certification (FAA Part 107)
  • Photography skills for event coverage

What You Get

  • Be part of a global cybersecurity company trusted by critical infrastructure worldwide
  • Own the video production function for a growing education platform
  • Work directly with company executives and technical leaders
  • Travel to cybersecurity events and training bootcamps globally
  • Your work is public-facing on OPSWAT Academy and YouTube

title: Supply Chain Management Specialist
description:
WHY HILLPOINTE? Hillpointe is a fully integrated real estate development and investment management firm focused on developing market-rate workforce housing across the Sun Belt. Ranked at the top of NMHC's list of Builders and Developers, our team ensures best-in-class execution.

Built on its long and proven track record of real estate development, the firm’s investment approach is centered around its in-house general contracting expertise, enabling direct control of cost and delivery timeframe. For each project, Hillpointe directly controls land acquisition, land development, construction, procurement of building materials, asset management, and capital markets. This is more than just a job - it's a career-defining opportunity! At Hillpointe, you'll be part of a dynamic, innovative team that has tangible impacts on day-to-day operations and contributes directly to overall success.

Supply Chain Management Specialist

As a Supply Chain Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in managing procurement, supplier relationships, inventory, and logistics to support efficient project operations. You’ll analyze costs, negotiate with vendors, monitor performance, and identify opportunities to improve processes and supply chain outcomes. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can balance competing priorities while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and strong supplier partnerships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supplier and Stakeholder Management
    • Manage relationships with suppliers and internal project leads, ensuring clear communication and collaboration.
    • Document stakeholder feedback, resolve performance or delivery issues, and escalate complex issues as needed.
  • Procurement and Contract Administration
    • Execute purchasing workflows, including preparing requisitions, gathering quotes or bids, and verifying compliance with policies and project specifications.
    • Draft and maintain scopes of work, pricing schedules, and contract summaries in coordination with the procurement director.
    • Maintain organized records and ensure complete contract documentation.
  • Cost and Process Optimization
    • Analyze purchasing data to identify inefficiencies and recommend process improvements.
    • Benchmark prices, logistics costs, and supplier terms to ensure competitiveness, supporting continuous improvement across procurement operations.
  • Inventory and Material Management
    • Monitor inventory levels, forecast material needs, and coordinate delivery schedules.
    • Inspect incoming goods for quality and accuracy, reconcile invoices and shipping documents, and maintain up-to-date inventory records in tracking systems.
  • Supplier Negotiation and Performance Oversight
    • Negotiate pricing, terms, and delivery schedules to achieve best-value outcomes.
    • Evaluate vendor performance against KPIs and SLAs, document nonconformance or delays, and define corrective actions to maintain service standards.
  • Reporting, Forecasting, and Supply Chain Management
    • Maintain pricing databases, cost comparison tools, and procurement performance dashboards.
    • Generate analytical reports on cost trends, vendor performance, and fulfillment metrics. Support demand forecasting, supply chain risk assessment, and logistics optimization strategies.
  • Ethics and Compliance
    • Uphold integrity and transparency in procurement practices, ensure equitable vendor treatment, audit for policy compliance, and report conflicts of interest or irregularities promptly.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of (2) years relevant supply chain experience.
  • High school degree or equivalent required. Business or related college degrees are preferred.
  • Bilingual Spanish language and writing skills are preferred.
  • Solid written and verbal communication and organizational skills to meet strict timelines.
  • Proficient in Word, Excel, Access, and Outlook.
  • Ability to remain calm, focused, and effective under time-sensitive circumstances.
  • Strong time management, leadership, project management, and decision-making skills.
  • A valid Driver's License is required.

Physical Requirements:

  • Primarily sedentary work is performed in an office and/or hybrid environment.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a computer and using standard office equipment (e.g., keyboard, mouse, monitors, telephone).
  • Frequent hand and finger dexterity is required for data entry, document preparation, and electronic communications.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and via email or virtual meeting platforms.
  • May require occasional standing, walking, bending, or reaching, particularly when reviewing inventory, receiving deliveries, or participating in site visits.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally (e.g., samples, documents, or small packages), with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Visual ability sufficient to read contracts, reports, and data on screens and in print.

Work Environment:

  • Work is typically performed in a professional office environment, with periodic exposure to warehouses, supplier sites, or project locations.
  • Occasional exposure to warehouse or logistics settings, including temperature variations, noise, or moving equipment, during inventory inspections or supplier visits.
  • Standard business hours are expected, with occasional extended hours required to meet project deadlines, support audits, or address urgent procurement or supply chain issues.
  • May require limited local or regional travel for supplier meetings, facility reviews, or contract negotiations.
  • Work involves regular interaction with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and vendors, requiring professionalism and collaboration.
  • Must be able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and compliance.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - Cybersecurity
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager with deep cybersecurity experience to help define how our products are positioned, communicated, and brought to market. This individual will translate complex product capabilities and cybersecurity concepts into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with customers, prospects, partners, analysts, and sales teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong cybersecurity domain knowledge with expertise in product marketing, competitive intelligence, content development, and sales enablement. This person must be comfortable working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and the broader Marketing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Product Positioning and Messaging

  • Develop compelling positioning, messaging, and value propositions for our cybersecurity platform and solutions.
  • Translate technical features and capabilities into clear customer benefits and business outcomes.
  • Create marketing narratives tailored to security executives, security operations teams, technical practitioners, and business leaders.
  • Maintain consistency of product messaging across campaigns, presentations, web content, videos, events, and sales materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to understand the roadmap, customer use cases, product differentiation, and market opportunities.

Competitive and Market Intelligence

  • Monitor cybersecurity market trends, customer needs, emerging technologies, and changes in the competitive landscape.
  • Conduct detailed competitive analysis covering product capabilities, positioning, pricing, strengths, weaknesses, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Develop and maintain competitive battlecards, comparison guides, objection-handling materials, and win/loss insights.
  • Equip Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly articulate our competitive advantages.
  • Share actionable market intelligence with Product, Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership.

Sales Enablement and Training

  • Develop and deliver product and cybersecurity training for sales representatives, sales engineers, channel partners, and customer-facing teams.
  • Build sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, solution briefs, talk tracks, FAQs, playbooks, battlecards, and customer presentations.
  • Ensure that sales teams have a strong understanding of the product, cybersecurity domain, target buyers, use cases, and competitive differentiation.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to identify knowledge gaps and develop ongoing enablement programs.
  • Support strategic customer meetings, field events, webinars, and partner training when needed.

Content and Storytelling

  • Develop high-impact content such as solution briefs, white papers, presentations, blogs, web copy, thought-leadership pieces, and customer-facing materials.
  • Create scripts, storyboards, and messaging for product videos, demonstrations, webinars, and multimedia campaigns.
  • Collaborate with creative, digital, communications, and demand-generation teams to turn product narratives into engaging campaigns.
  • Work with customers and internal teams to develop case studies, testimonials, and proof points.

Go-to-Market Strategy

  • Lead product launches and go-to-market programs in partnership with Product, Sales, Demand Generation, Communications, and Customer Success.
  • Define target audiences, buyer personas, use cases, launch plans, messaging, content requirements, and success metrics.
  • Support industry analysts, media briefings, events, conferences, and other market-facing activities.
  • Measure the effectiveness of product marketing and sales-enablement programs and recommend improvements.

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by the candidate’s ability to:

  • Create clear and differentiated product positioning.
  • Strengthen the sales team’s product and cybersecurity knowledge.
  • Improve competitive readiness and objection handling.
  • Produce compelling content and multimedia narratives.

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity buyers, market dynamics, enterprise sales cycles, and security operations.

  • Demonstrated experience developing product positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and go-to-market strategies.

  • Experience developing video scripts, webinars, product demonstrations, and multimedia content.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
About Numan
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values:
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The Role

We build and operate a regulated digital health platform. Patients trust us with clinical data, identity documents and payment details, and our clinicians trust our systems to be correct. That makes application security a patient safety concern, not just a compliance one.

We are shipping quickly, adopting AI and agentic systems across clinical operations and patient-facing products, and running a lean security function that scales through engineering leverage rather than headcount. We need a senior engineer who can go deep on design and code, then bring the rest of the business along with them.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with genuine influence over how the platform is built.

The Team

You will work within the Cyber Security function, collaborating directly with Engineering, Product, Clinical, Legal, and the executive team. Security at Numan is not a gatekeeping function — it scales through influence, credibility, and being useful early.


You'll be:

  • Running threat modelling sessions with product and engineering teams on new features and architectural changes — STRIDE-based, with clinical safety, abuse, and business-logic threats kept in mind alongside the technical ones.

  • Owning and evolving our Secure by Design process: self-evaluation screening, secure design review, and the threat modelling pathway, including our use of automated tooling against technical artefacts.

  • Turning threat models into tracked, prioritised controls that engineering teams actually implement.

  • Pushing design decisions upstream so the cheap fix is designed in rather than the expensive one retrofitted.

  • Assessing and securing AI systems in production: LLM-backed features, retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, tool-calling integrations, and the MCP and API surfaces that connect them.

  • Building practical threat models and controls for agent-specific failure modes — prompt injection, tool misuse, excessive agency, data exfiltration through context, unsafe autonomy, and supply chain risk in model and plugin ecosystems.

  • Performing automated application and API penetration testing against our own products — web, mobile backends, cloud-native services on GCP, internal tooling, and AI features.

  • Leading penetration engagements with third parties and working on the fix with engineering.

  • Chaining findings into realistic attack paths and demonstrating impact, rather than delivering a list of scanner output.

  • Embedding security into our pipelines: SAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container and dependency hygiene — tuned so signal beats noise and engineers trust the gates.

  • Working with platform and engineering to raise baseline standards: authentication and authorisation patterns, secrets management, tenancy isolation, and logging and detection coverage.

  • Actively participating in the security community — OWASP chapters or projects, local meetups, CTFs, research groups — and publishing research, write-ups, or blog posts under your own name.


We're looking for someone who:

  • Brings substantial hands-on application security experience in a product engineering environment, at senior level.

  • Has demonstrable threat modelling practice — not just familiarity with the theory.

  • Has practical offensive skills against modern web and API stacks, with an appropriate certification or equivalent demonstrable experience (OSCP, OSWE, CREST, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner or similar).

  • Is comfortable reading and reasoning about code in at least one language used in production systems, and can review a pull request meaningfully.

  • Has working knowledge of cloud-native architecture and its security model — ideally GCP, but AWS or Azure experience transfers.

  • Has experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD, and the scars to know what makes engineers ignore it.

  • Has a track record of shipping security improvements through other teams.

  • Has experience securing AI or agentic systems in production.

  • Has hands-on experience securing Kubernetes environments and managing cloud security posture using CNAPP and CSPM solutions, with a primary focus on GCP but AWS and Azure experience is translatable.

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Regulated environment experience — healthcare, fintech, or similar — and comfort with frameworks such as ISO 27001 without treating compliance as the goal.

  • Detection engineering or incident response exposure for incidents related to application attacks.

  • An existing community footprint: talks, published research, maintained projects.

At Numan, people are at the heart of who we are. We recognise and value the unique perspectives and experiences that individuals from all backgrounds bring.

title: AI Engineer, GTM Claudification
