title: Revenue Management Lead
description:
3 Day Blinds is a national retailer and manufacturer of quality, custom-made blinds, shades, draperies, and shutters. We are proud to be part of the Hunter Douglas family of brands. Over the last 40 years we’ve successfully helped transform our clients' homes and workplaces by offering a wide variety of products that add beauty and comfort to every space. It takes a talented group of individuals to do what we do, and we do it together as One Team. We strive to create a culture of learning and opportunity, and most importantly, an environment where you can feel passionate and connected to your work every day.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours?

Position Overview

The Revenue Management Lead sits within the Commercial Finance & Analytics team, partnering with Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance to help the business make better commercial decisions through data, analysis and strategic thinking.

You will own the Revenue Management agenda for the Shop-at-Home business, identifying opportunities to accelerate growth, improve profitability and strengthen commercial decision-making. From pricing and discount strategy to conversion performance, customer behavior and marketing effectiveness, you will turn data into practical recommendations that drive measurable business impact.

This is a highly cross-functional role. Success comes from understanding how the business operates, asking the right questions and influencing decisions through insight rather than authority.

You will report to the Head of Commercial Finance & Analytics and work closely with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance.

What you'll do

Commercial Performance

  • Identify opportunities to improve revenue, gross margin and profitability across the business.
  • Analyze pricing, discounting, product mix, conversion, customer behavior and commercial performance to uncover actionable opportunities.
  • Develop recommendations that balance growth, profitability and customer experience.

Business Partnership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance to evaluate initiatives, challenge assumptions and support better decision-making.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by providing data-driven insights that inform commercial strategy and prioritization.

Insights & Analytics

  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that support business decisions.
  • Develop analyses that answer critical business questions and identify opportunities for growth and operational improvement.

Reporting & Performance Visibility

  • Own key commercial reporting and performance dashboards, continuously improving the quality, accessibility and relevance of business insights.
  • Automate recurring analyses where appropriate, allowing more time to focus on high-value commercial work.

How You Work

  • You are naturally curious and enjoy solving complex commercial problems.
  • You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, tailoring your approach to the stakeholder.
  • You balance analytical rigor with pragmatism, knowing when deeper analysis creates value and when speed matters.
  • You build strong cross-functional relationships and influence through credibility, insight and collaboration rather than authority.
  • You embrace AI as part of your everyday toolkit, continuously exploring new ways to improve efficiency, deepen analysis and increase business impact.

What This Role Offers

  • This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership and meaningful influence over how the business grows. You will work on some of the company's most important commercial decisions, helping shape pricing, profitability, customer acquisition and overall business performance.
  • For the right candidate, this is an opportunity to develop broad commercial expertise, build strong executive relationships and grow into a broader commercial finance or analytics leadership role as the function evolves.

Who you are

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Analytics or a related field (MBA or advanced degree is a plus).
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in Revenue Management, Commercial Finance, Pricing, Strategy, Business Analytics, Consulting, Investment Banking or a related commercial function.
  • Experience in a consumer-facing, retail, direct-to-consumer, home services or similarly commercial environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated success influencing cross-functional business decisions through data, analysis and commercial insight.
  • Experience partnering with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Operations and Finance.
  • Advanced Excel skills with experience using BI tools and large datasets. SQL and Python are a plus but not required.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools and modern analytics platforms to improve productivity, accelerate analysis and improve business decision-making.

What's in it for you?

  • Annual base salary range: $122,000 - $165,000
  • Bonus target range: 25 - 35%
  • Generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development and professional growth
  • Time off with pay
  • 401(k) plan with a degree of employer matching
  • Paid parental leave
  • Wellness programs and product discounts

title: Building Automation Systems (BAS) Controls Technician (Union)
description:
Honeywell International is seeking an experienced and motivated Building Management Systems (BMS) Field Service Technician to join our Building Automation team supporting customers throughout New York City, Queens, The Bronx, and Brooklyn, NY. This is a Union position (Local 3) responsible for the installation, commissioning, programming, troubleshooting, optimization, and lifecycle support of advanced Building Automation Systems (BAS) utilizing Honeywell and Tridium Niagara platforms.

In this role, you will support high-profile projects and customer sites by delivering reliable, integrated building management solutions that enhance operational efficiency, occupant comfort, energy performance, and system reliability. You will work with a variety of building systems, including HVAC controls, lighting controls, energy management, alarming, trending, and third-party system integrations in commercial facilities such as high-rise office buildings, healthcare campuses, educational institutions, and other mission-critical environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technician with strong experience in networked building automation systems, controls integration, system diagnostics, and customer-facing service delivery. Success in this role requires technical expertise, strong problem-solving skills, a collaborative approach, and a commitment to delivering exceptional customer outcomes.

You will report to the Senior Field Service Supervisor in Lake Success, NY. This position follows a 35-hour work week, Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM. Overtime opportunities are available after 7 hours worked on weekdays.

Honeywell provides a company vehicle, gas card, laptop, mobile phone, and all necessary tools to perform your work. A company purchasing card (P-Card) is also provided for parking expenses and approved customer material purchases.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, configure, program, and troubleshoot Building Automation Systems (BAS)
  • Develop system databases, map points, and configure front‑end workstations and graphics
  • Interpret and implement sequences of operation
  • Commission and start up HVAC control systems
  • Work with industry protocols including BACnet, LonWorks, and Modbus (HTML/Java experience a plus)
  • Review and interpret project plans, specifications, and control drawings
  • Collaborate with internal project teams, subcontractors, and customers to ensure successful project execution

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 3+ years of experience in building automation or controls industry
  • 1+ year experience working with DDC controls, BAS architecture, and system networking
  • If not already a member, must be willing to join Union Local 3
  • Valid driver’s license with a driving record acceptable to Honeywell

WE VALUE

  • Niagara Tridium (N4/Optimizer) experience
  • Familiarity with platforms such as Honeywell, Andover, JCI, and Tridium
  • Controls experience in large commercial or institutional facilities
  • Experience working with commercial HVAC systems
  • Background in HVAC, electrical, or electronics
  • Customer‑focused, self‑motivated, and able to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven track record of delivering high levels of customer satisfaction
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, interpersonal, and documentation skills

UNION BENEFITS – The Honeywell Advantage

  • Competitive union compensation based on experience
  • Local 3 Union membership
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Union Annuity Plan
  • 401(k) plan
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick time
  • Company‑provided vehicle, cell phone, laptop, and tools

The hourly rate range for this position is $67,400 to $84,200. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

ABOUT HONEYWELL

Honeywell International Inc. (Nasdaq: HON) invents and commercializes technologies that address some of the world's most critical challenges around energy, safety, security, air travel, productivity, and global urbanization. We are a leading software-industrial company committed to introducing state-of-the-art technology solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, sustainability, and safety in high-growth businesses in broad-based, attractive industrial-end markets. Our products and solutions enable a safer, more comfortable, and more productive world, enhancing the quality of life of people around the globe. Learn more about Honeywell: click here ()

THE BUSINESS UNIT

Honeywell Building Automation (BA) is a leading global provider of products, software, solutions, and technologies that enable building owners and occupants to ensure their facilities are safe, energy efficient, sustainable, and productive. BA products and services include advanced software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and upgrades of systems. Revenues in 2022 for BA were $6B and there are approximately 18,000 employees globally. To learn more, please visit https://buildings.honeywell.com/ (https://buildings.honeywell.com/)

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date: August 25, 2026.

title: eCommerce Product Solutions Director-Payments-Executive Director
description:
Unlock your potential as a leader in product solutions, where you will guide sales advisory, optimize complex problem-solving, and shape customer-centric strategies. Leverage your expertise to make a lasting impact in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

As a Product Solutions Director for eCommerce Payments Products and Solutions, within the Merchant Services division of JPMorgan Payments, you are an expert in a cluster of products and the sales cycle. As a leader on the team, you leverage your advanced capabilities to craft complex solutions, partner with Sales to identify and capture market opportunities, and create new ways for teams to continuously deliver value to customers.

Your focus will be on developing merchant payments solutions for the eRetail | B2B Solutions | Technology sector, ensuring that our offerings help our clients in this sector to be competitive. Using your expertise in online payments for eRetailers, you will tailor our existing offerings for these clients, design new ones, and help bring all of these to market.

Job responsibilities

  • Advises the Product Solutions teams on solutioning and adopting new and existing client-facing products and capabilities while crafting complex solutions and assessing risk to enhance the customer experience
  • Bring expertise of the eRetail | B2B Solutions | Technology sector to our merchant payments solutioning work, and partner with our Sales and Relationship Management teams to position and sell to clients in these sectors.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert on a defined set of products and capabilities in the realm of merchant payments for the the eRetail | B2B Solutions | Technology industry with a deep understanding of our clients’ needs and current industry trends
  • Leverages extensive knowledge of a cluster of products and capabilities to manage the strategic development of end-to-end product solution strategies and processes
  • Partners with Sales to advise on strategic pricing for deals, contributes to the development of sales training and collateral, and oversees Request for Proposal (RFP) responses; is sought out by Sales to (selectively) participate in client pitches and meetings
  • Manages the collection of client feedback and oversees the delivery of feedback to Product teams
  • Partners with Product Management to create a compelling Product vision and roadmap
  • Monitors market trends, conducts competitive analysis, and identifies opportunities for product differentiation
  • Designs and helps to develop and scale best-in-class, digital-first payments products & solutions for clients needing to conduct eCommerce
  • Leads, inspires, develops, & recruits a talented team of direct and matrixed team members

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • 8+ years of experience or equivalent expertise leading and developing solutions across multiple teams and a cluster of products

  • eRetail: Experience with, deep knowledge of and passion for eCommerce and retailing including merchandising, logistics, returns, endless-aisle, and/or omnichannel selling (B2C and/or B2B and/or Direct-to-Consumer)

  • B2B Solutions: Experience with, deep knowledge of and passion for the B2B solutions and professional services realm. Knowledge of how to optimize payments and billing for B2B and professional services companies, to automate and improve their billing and reconciliation needs, and how they leverage ERPs and other tools that our solutions must complement

  • Tech: Experience with, deep knowledge of and passion for a range of technology sub-sectors, such as Consumer Tech, Gig Economy, Marketplaces, Social Media & Video Gaming, and others. Understanding of how payments, subscription billing, and profile management enable these sectors to grow and thrive, and ability to adapt our merchant payments solutions for these clients.

  • Extensive experience facilitating sales cycle activities and developing and optimizing strategies and processes
  • Demonstrable experience structuring and handling complex solutions for business problems to meet clients’ needs
  • Experience with, deep knowledge of and passion for eCommerce and retailing including merchandising, logistics, returns, endless-aisle, and/or omnichannel selling (B2C and/or B2B and/or Direct-to-Consumer)
  • Commercially savvy, with aptitude with managing a P&L
  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative and accountability to join an ambitious fintech environment
  • Bridge-builder who can inspire confidence and between business & technical teams, and also across business units including marketing, risk, finance, servicing and other functions
  • Strong executive presence, very capable and comfortable communicator, confident in interacting with and presenting to all levels of management

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Recognized thought leader within a related field
  • Bachelor’s degree; MBA preferred
  • Experience in strategy consulting
  • Familiarity with software product development life cycle
  • Familiarity with payments, merchant services, merchant acquiring, payment processing, and fintech payments products

This position is subject to Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act. As such, an employment offer for this position is contingent on JPMorganChase’s review of criminal conviction history, including pretrial diversions or program entries.

title: Software Development Engineer, Lambda - Experience
description:
Software Development Engineer — AWS Lambda Control Plane (Dublin)

When millions of builders ship their Lambda functions, it all just works — in seconds, anywhere in the world. The machinery that makes that possible is the control plane: the systems that validate, orchestrate, and propagate every function's state so the data plane can execute it flawlessly at any scale.

As part of the team you'll design, build, and operate the distributed systems that sit between customers and the Lambda data plane:

You'll own the full path from API request to running function. The APIs you build are the public surface of Lambda — high-throughput, strictly consistent, globally available — serving customers and CloudFormation alike. Behind those APIs, you'll design the asynchronous workflows that orchestrate a function's lifecycle: taking a customer's intent — a new function, a code deploy, a version publish — and propagating it safely to the systems that actually execute functions. That means solving metadata propagation at global scale: ensuring every configuration change reaches the right compute fleet, in the right region, with the right ordering guarantees, even under partial failures.

We operate at the scale of one of the largest services in AWS. Availability is a first-class design constraint, not an afterthought.

What we're looking for

Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production — the kind where "retry" isn't a strategy, it's a starting point.
Comfort with ambiguity: you'll own problems end-to-end, from API contract through data-plane handoff.
Strong fundamentals in at least one of: Java, Python, or TypeScript (our stack spans all three).
A bias toward simple, operable solutions — systems that are easy to reason about at 3 AM.

Key job responsibilities
What does it take to succeed in this role?

You should be comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. You should be intellectually curious, always looking to learn and be dedicated to turning the software developers that use Lambda to build modern applications into fans of the service. You should be somebody who aspires to make the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

About the team

title: Senior Solution Engineer (SLED & Water Treatment)
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

Are you purpose-driven? We are. At OPSWAT, our purpose is to secure the way of life we all enjoy. We focus our innovations on protecting Critical Infrastructure, and few sectors carry higher public stakes than the state, local, and education (SLED) agencies and water/wastewater utilities that keep communities running. You've probably done some interesting things in your career, but how often can you say your work directly protects the water supply and public services your neighbors depend on?

This role focuses on SLED customers and water treatment facilities, where OT/ICS security, regulatory compliance, and public-sector procurement all intersect. As threats against water utility PLCs and SCADA systems escalate and states move from voluntary to mandatory cybersecurity requirements, you'll be the technical guide helping these organizations close the gap.

As a Solution Engineer, you'll uncover customer challenges, show how OPSWAT solves them, and guide customers through operationalizing the solution. You'll maintain proficiency in OT/ICS and public-sector security domains, expertise in our products, and the disposition that makes customers want to partner with you for their success. You'll also have a voice with the product team, feeding back field insight that shapes future capabilities.

What You Will be Doing

  • Work with AEs and partners to grow OPSWAT's business across SLED agencies and water/wastewater utilities
  • Manage customer requirements, expectations, and solution buy-in across IT, OT, and compliance stakeholders
  • Maintain and frequently deliver high-impact demos of OPSWAT's OT and public-sector security solutions
  • Manage, deliver, and present detailed responses to RFPs and public-sector procurement processes, including state/local contract vehicles
  • Nurture partner relationships and their technical understanding of OPSWAT's SLED and water sector portfolio
  • Speak at conferences and seminars focused on public-sector and water/wastewater cybersecurity
  • Conduct workshops, proof of value, and post-sale transitions with municipal, state, and utility customers

What We Need from You

  • Experience supporting sales into state, local, or education government accounts, or water/wastewater utilities
  • A history of developing new and expansion business with public-sector or utility customers
  • Comfort leading discussions with all customer levels, from agency leadership to plant operators and IT/OT administrators
  • Strong presentation and demo skills
  • Working knowledge of OT/ICS/SCADA environments, and awareness of regulatory frameworks affecting water utilities (e.g., EPA and state cybersecurity requirements)
  • Familiarity with public-sector procurement and contract vehicles (e.g., GSA Schedule, SEWP, state/local contracts) a plus
  • Experience installing and troubleshooting enterprise or industrial applications
  • Problem-solving abilities; skilled at identifying and resolving customer pain points

We Value Our Differences

  • We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

If this sounds like you, or close to you, I’d love to meet and perhaps build something great together.

OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Director, Patient Reported Outcomes
description:
Revolution Medicines is a late-stage clinical oncology company developing novel targeted therapies for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins. The company’s RAS(ON) inhibitors daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), a RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor; elironrasib (RMC-6291), a RAS(ON) G12C-selective inhibitor; zoldonrasib (RMC-9805), a RAS(ON) G12D-selective inhibitor; and RMC-5127, a RAS(ON) G12V-selective inhibitor, are currently in clinical development. As a new member of the Revolution Medicines team, you will join other outstanding professionals in a tireless commitment to patients with cancers harboring mutations in the RAS signaling pathway.

The Opportunity:

The Senior Director, Patient-Reported Outcomes (PRO) provides scientific and strategic expertise for the integration of patient-centered outcomes into clinical development programs. This individual serves as a key PRO subject matter expert and leads the development and execution of PRO strategies for assigned programs in support of clinical development, regulatory, market access, and scientific communication objectives. Working closely with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, and other cross-functional partners, the Senior Director will translate patient-centered evidence needs into practical study plans and deliverables from development through registration and lifecycle management. This role is initially an individual contributor position with the opportunity to assume people-management responsibilities as the organization grows.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and lead PRO strategy for assigned clinical development programs, ensuring alignment with clinical, regulatory, and market access objectives.

  • Recommend and support the selection, implementation, validation, and interpretation of PRO measures and patient-centered endpoints, including fit-for-purpose assessment of existing instruments.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to incorporate PRO objectives and assessments into study designs, protocols, schedules of assessments, statistical analysis plans, regulatory documents, and publications.

  • Plan and oversee qualitative and quantitative research activities supporting PRO evidence generation, including vendor and external expert management as appropriate.

  • Provide methodological guidance on endpoint definitions, meaningful change thresholds, responder analyses, missing data, interpretation of results, and integration of PRO findings into benefit-risk assessment.

  • Contribute PRO expertise to interactions with regulatory authorities and health technology assessment agencies and to regulatory submissions, briefing documents, and product-labeling discussions; engage external experts and patient stakeholders as needed.

  • Support the analysis, interpretation, and dissemination of PRO evidence through study reports, publications, presentations, and other scientific communications.

  • Contribute to the development of fit-for-purpose processes, standards, and best practices for patient-focused drug development, and provide coaching or mentoring to colleagues as appropriate.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Advanced degree (eg, Ph.D., Sc.D., Dr.P.H., Psy.D., M.D., Pharm.D., M.P.H., M.S., or equivalent) in psychology, psychometrics, epidemiology, public health, health outcomes research, behavioral science, or a related discipline.

  • Candidate should possesses a minimum of 13 years of relevant experience in patient-reported outcomes, patient-focused drug development, health outcomes research, or a related field within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, consulting, or academic environment; level will be commensurate with experience.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing PRO strategies for clinical development programs, preferably including late-stage studies and support for regulatory interactions or submissions.

  • Strong expertise in qualitative and quantitative PRO methodologies, including instrument selection and development, content validity, psychometric evaluation, meaningful change, and interpretation of treatment benefit.

  • Working knowledge of global regulatory expectations related to patient-focused drug development and clinical outcome assessments, with the ability to apply guidance pragmatically to development programs.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, manage multiple priorities, and influence decisions through clear scientific rationale and collaborative partnership.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with experience translating technical PRO concepts for clinical, statistical, regulatory, and business audiences.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience developing or implementing PRO strategy in oncology clinical development; experience in solid tumors, including lung cancer (particularly NSCLC), pancreatic cancer, or other RAS-driven malignancies is preferred.

  • Experience supporting Phase 2 and/or Phase 3 development programs and working with clinical trial teams on PRO operationalization, analysis, interpretation, and reporting.

  • Experience working with external research vendors, consultants, academic collaborators, patient organizations, or other partners involved in patient-centered outcomes research.

  • Experience contributing to regulatory or HTA interactions, scientific publications, or cross-functional capability-building activities related to PROs or clinical outcome assessments.

title: Quantitative Trading & Research – Prime Finance Quantitative Research – Vice President
description:
The Prime Finance Quantitative Trading and Research (QTR) team in London develops and maintains advanced mathematical models, innovative methodologies, and robust infrastructure to support and grow the Prime Financial Services business. Our mission is to optimize decision-making, automate processes, and manage and hedge risk.

Prime Financial Services provides financing and securities lending to institutional investors, optimizes the bank’s inventory and balance sheet, and delivers strategic solutions to clients. The QTR team partners closely with trading, technology, and risk teams to deliver impactful tools and analytics.

The team specializes in building models that leverage Machine Learning, Statistics, and Operations Research to solve complex business challenges. As a Vice President in QTR Prime Finance, you will collaborate with senior stakeholders to design and implement those models and help drive business revenue, enhance risk management, and automate workflows. Typical projects include predicting changes in borrow rates or forecasting market demand, unraveling patterns and causality in the data, researching alpha signals and optimizing pricing and inventory allocation to maximize our revenue and profits.

As Vice President in the team you will be involved in regular collaboration with the trading desk. In addition to strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills are essential for effectively engaging with stakeholders and translating complex quantitative concepts into actionable business solutions.

Experience in Prime Finance is preferred but not required. We provide on-job training, and through the diversity of the businesses it supports and the variety of functions that it is responsible for, the QTR group provides unique growth opportunities for you to develop your abilities and your career.

Job responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement mathematical, statistical, and machine learning models to optimize revenue and profitability for stock borrow-loan, cash, and synthetic financing books, as well as predictive analytics to forecast borrow rates, product demand, and other key business drivers.
  • Apply operations research and optimization techniques to automate and enhance traders’ decision-making and inventory management.
  • Analyse market data to uncover patterns, causality and inform business strategy.
  • Research and develop alpha signals and automated hedging strategies, both to assist in the systematic trading efforts of the firm and to contribute to the suite of commercialised datasets of the business
  • Collaborate with trading, technology, and risk teams to deliver quantitative tools and solutions.
  • Build and maintain robust infrastructure for model deployment and analytics delivery.
  • Ensure models and analytics meet rigorous control and risk management standards.
  • Continuously improve existing models and methodologies in response to evolving business needs.
  • Communicate complex quantitative concepts to senior stakeholders and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to a collaborative team environment.
  • Document models, methodologies, and processes for transparency and knowledge sharing.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills

  • Advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in Statistics, AI/ML, Computer Science, Operations Research, or related quantitative field.
  • Significant experience in quantitative modelling, analytics, or related roles.
  • Strong background in AI, machine learning, operations research, or revenue/yield management.
  • Proficiency in Python for data analysis, modelling, and software development.
  • Deep understanding of statistics, AI, and optimization techniques.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex quantitative problems and deliver business impact.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, especially with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience with large-scale data analysis and visualization tools.

Preferred Qualifications Capabilities and Skills

  • Experience with systematic trading and alpha signal research
  • Experience in Prime Finance, securities lending, or inventory management.
  • Familiarity with revenue and yield management strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Knowledge of optimization libraries and techniques (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, linear/nonlinear programming).
  • Track record of publishing research or presenting at industry conferences.
  • Experience mentoring or leading junior researchers.

Paula’s Choice, a global skincare leader founded in 1995, empowers individuals to define beauty on their own terms through science-backed products. Our mission comes to life through four core values that guide our actions, decisions, and impact:

  • Build Trust: We set the standard for skincare, transparency, and shared knowledge.
  • Be Bold: We lead through innovation and by challenging the status quo.
  • Act with Kindness: We operate with respect and care—for our customers, colleagues, and the planet.
  • Create Community: We believe in the power of connection—whether educating customers, supporting each other, or giving back, we grow stronger together.

Our team spans North America, Australia/New Zealand, Europe, and the broader APAC region, collaborating globally to drive innovation. We offer space to thrive—personally, professionally, and through our comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being at every stage:

  • Generous paid time off, including time off to volunteer
  • Learning and development resources to support personal and professional growth
  • Wellness benefits like meditation app memberships, product discounts, and free samples of our amazing products
  • Most roles are fully remote (roles that are required to be at our Seattle HQ can be found in the details section of this job post)
  • Great location – for roles that are hybrid or fully onsite, we’re in the heart of Seattle’s beautiful International District
  • Did we mention we’re a dog-friendly office?

Our culture encourages continuous learning and is fueled by connection, curiosity, and cross-functional collaboration. Whether onsite, remote, or hybrid, we stay connected through shared initiatives that bring our teams together. If you’re inspired by transparency, driven to make an impact, and eager to help foster community—we’d love to have you join us.

How you’ll have an impact at Paula’s Choice: As the Director, Creative Operations, you’ll play a pivotal dual role in owning both the operational execution of brand promotions & campaigns and overseeing the end-to-end production of photoshoot & video shoots. You’ll be responsible for managing creative workflows, leading project timelines, and bringing visual content to life through studio and lifestyle shoots. You will drive operational excellence and accountability across the organization, leading high-impact cross-functional teams to deliver complex projects on time, within budget, and aligned with company goals. This role is essential to scaling our project management engine and driving operational excellence. It’s perfect for someone who’s passionate about storytelling in the beauty and skincare space—and equally at home managing timelines as they are on a shoot set.

As the Director, Creative Operations, a typical day might include a mix of the following:

Creative Project Management

  • Lead multiple concurrent campaigns, including new product launches, seasonal collections, digital assets, email/social campaigns, and ecommerce updates
  • Translate creative briefs into clear scopes, timelines, and deliverables using PM tools like Jira, Monday.com, or Smartsheet
  • Drive project kickoffs, milestone reviews, approvals, and delivery across creative and marketing teams
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, ecommerce, product development, and external vendors to ensure creative alignment with brand objectives
  • Own weekly reporting, status updates, and flag risks or blockers early

Photoshoot Production (Editorial, Product, Lifestyle)

  • Oversee freelancer who will produce photo and video shoots from concept to completion (in-studio and on-location)
  • Manage casting and coordinate with talent agencies to ensure inclusivity and representation that aligns with brand values
  • Oversee pre-production planning: call sheets, schedules, creative decks, shot lists, crew hiring, equipment booking, and studio/location logistics
  • Ensure freelance producer will lead on-set operations to ensure smooth execution, creative integrity, and efficiency
  • Manage post-production workflows including file handoffs, image selections, retouching, and asset delivery

Budget & Vendor Oversight

  • Build and manage production and creative budgets; track spend and reconcile invoices
  • Vet and manage external partners, including stylists, photographers, production vendors, and retouchers
  • Negotiate contracts and maintain clear usage rights, licensing, and release documentation

Tool & Workflow Optimization

  • Leverage project management software to increase transparency across creative deliverables
  • Own digital asset organization, file versioning, and content management systems (e.g., Dropbox, Airtable)
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of creative operations and production processes

The Details:

  • Location: We're a Seattle based company and prefer candidates who are local to Seattle. However, we're open to remote candidates on the West Coast.
  • Hours: Typical PST Business Hours, some flexibility
  • Physical requirements: Ability to handle both sitting and screen time for long periods of time

What you’ll bring to the table:

  • 7–10 years’ experience in creative project management and/or photo production within the beauty, skincare, or lifestyle industries
  • Demonstrated success in leading large-scale project portfolios from concept to launch with full accountability for scope, time, and budget
  • Deep understanding of content needs across ecommerce, social, retail, and influencer platforms
  • Hands-on production expertise with both product and talent shoots
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including vendors, agencies, and freelancers
  • Experience using tools such as Jira, Monday.com, Smartsheet, Dropbox, Adobe Creative Suite, and Capture One
  • Passion for the beauty/skincare industry and a keen eye for detail, aesthetics, and process

What we offer you*:

  • A robust benefits package including health, vision, dental, retirement and more
  • Flexible spending account, Employee assistance program
  • Fitness perks, meditation app membership, and more
  • Product samples and discounts
  • Generous PTO
  • Most roles are fully remote (roles that are required to be at our Seattle HQ can be found in the details section of this job post)

*Please note these benefits are only available to full-time Paula's Choice employees.

Note: At any time, with or without notice, Paula’s Choice reserves the right to add/delete/change the position’s requirements.

Approximate Salary Range Based on Experience and Location:

$145,000 - $160,000 USD/annually

#LI-MS1

Paula’s Choice Skincare determines the pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external and internal equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living.

For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. The exact base salary is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, and budget. title: Head of AI Acceleration
description:
Are you ready to join the winning team at The Lottery Corporation?

We power Australia’s biggest lottery games – and we’re one of the world’s top-performing lottery businesses.

As the home of The Lott and Keno, we’re building on decades of excitement and life-changing wins, bringing our games to every state and territory except WA.

For more than a century, we’ve been playing our role in creating positive impacts by delivering winning moments every day to our people, our customers, retailers, partners and our community.

But we’re not standing still. We’re evolving into an entertainment company – more customer-obsessed, more agile and driven by real outcomes.

Because at our core, it’s simple: we create winning moments – and we’re building the next chapter as the team behind Where Australia Comes to Play.

Join us!

Digital is one of the fastest growing parts of our business, and we're looking for a Head of AI Acceleration to lead our transformation into an AI-native organisation. This role is about far more than experimentation. It's about embedding AI, machine learning, automation and agentic capabilities into the way we create products, build technology, operate services and deliver customer experiences.

This is a delivery-focused leadership role for someone who has successfully taken AI initiatives from concept through to production adoption and measurable business outcomes. We're looking for a leader who knows how to identify high-value opportunities, rapidly experiment, build scalable solutions and drive adoption at scale.

You'll act as an acceleration layer across Digital, helping teams fundamentally rethink how work gets done through AI while lifting productivity, engineering velocity, customer outcomes and commercial performance.

What you’ll do

  • Lead Digital's transition to becoming an AI-native organisation
  • Build and scale AI, machine learning, automation and agentic capabilities across the Digital value chain
  • Identify high-value AI opportunities and lead delivery from ideation to production adoption
  • Transform products and business processes through AI-native design principles
  • Industrialise AI and automation solutions that improve productivity, speed and quality
  • Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns and delivery frameworks for AI at scale
  • Lead responsible AI governance, risk and compliance practices
  • Build organisational capability and drive adoption of AI-enabled ways of working
  • Build and lead a high-performing team of AI specialists

What you’ll bring

  • A leader who has moved beyond AI strategy and into successful implementation
  • Proven experience delivering and scaling AI, machine learning and automation solutions in complex environments
  • Demonstrated success taking AI initiatives from concept through to production adoption and value realisation
  • Experience implementing Generative AI, LLM, machine learning or intelligent automation capabilities in production environments
  • Strong software engineering and solution architecture expertise
  • Experience establishing enterprise AI standards, governance and architecture patterns
  • Deep understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation and emerging technologies
  • The ability to translate emerging technologies into measurable productivity, customer and commercial outcomes
  • Experience leading high-performing engineering, AI or architecture teams`

What you’ll get
Not only will you receive an awesome candidate experience from our caring Talent team, but you’ll get a genuine feel for who we are and what it’s like to be part of our team.

The benefits of working with The Lottery Corporation are pretty good. Just to name a few:

  • Balance work and life with our ‘flex for great outcomes’ approach – hybrid working, plus a range of generous leave options.
  • Reward and recognition programs at all levels. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
  • Ignite your potential with our dedicated learning and development platform to support your bright future.
  • We empower careers to grow from within. 50% of all roles in 2025 were filled by our own people, proving that your next opportunity is already here!
  • A true sense of belonging. We’re committed to Inclusion & Diversity with a range of initiatives such as our Gender Affirmation Support, employee inclusion networks and diversity memberships and celebrations.
  • Make positive impacts with opportunities to volunteer with our community partners. We'll also dollar match fundraising efforts of our employees lending their support to registered charities.

We’re committed to providing a safe, respectful and supportive work environment. We encourage you to let us know if we can make any accommodations, so the process can be more user friendly for you.

We acknowledge and pay respect to the traditional custodians of the lands on which our offices, retail outlets and venues operate. We acknowledge the inextricable link First Peoples of Australia have with the land past and present.

Your online safety is important to us. We'll never request payment or credit card details from you to apply for a position. If you're uncertain whether a job ad is legitimate, verify via our website before providing any details.

title: Battery Cell Technician
description:
About the Job

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Battery Cell Technician to support the development, testing, and manufacturing of battery cells. The ideal candidate will work hands-on with battery materials, assembly processes, and testing to ensure product quality and performance. This role is critical for Anthro to deliver on our internal technical milestones and external customer projects.

What you will do

  • Build and test battery cells following standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Conduct performance evaluations, including capacity, cycle life, and thermal tests.
  • Handle battery materials, cells, and electrolytes while maintaining safety protocols.
  • Safely operate lab equipment such as cell testers, cyclers, and environmental chambers.
  • Collect and document test data, generating reports for engineering and R&D teams.
  • Work closely with engineers and scientists to optimize battery performance and manufacturing processes.
  • Follow safety guidelines for handling lithium-ion and other battery chemistries.
  • Maintain lab cleanliness and ensure proper disposal of hazardous materials.

Requirements

  • Education: HS Diploma or GED
  • Experience: 1-3 years of experience in a laboratory setting. Relevant technical experience may be considered in place of direct battery experience.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Hands-on experience measuring and handling chemicals in small, precise quantities
    • Familiarity with assembling fixtures and running tests on analytical equipment
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
    • Ability to work in a team and follow technical instructions.
    • Good written and verbal communication skills for reporting and documentation.
  • Other Requirements:
    • May occasionally be required to lift objects up to 30 lbs. and work with chemicals following written safety protocols.
    • Ability to lift, squat, kneel, use step ladders, manipulate hand, and power tools.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity compensation commensurate with experience. Expected salary range is $32-45 / hour.
  • 15 Vacation Days, 10+ Holidays, Sick time off
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for team members, 60% coverage for dependents
  • 401k with match
  • Paid parental leave with flexible return-to-work policy
  • Diverse and inclusive work environment

title: Tower Technician
description:
Exceptional. No Exceptions.

Timberline Communications Inc. (TCI) is a leading provider of wireless infrastructure and telecommunications construction services. Headquartered in Canton, MA, we've built a reputation for delivering precision, safety, and professionalism on every project-from complex rooftop installations to small cell networks and everything in between.

With a team of highly skilled professionals and a laser focus on client success, TCI has become one of the region's premier wireless infrastructure partners. Whether executing rooftop builds, small cell integrations, or DAS upgrades, we bring clarity, collaboration, and consistent results. Every site. Every time.

Climb Higher (About the Job)

TCI is seeking motivated individuals ready to gain hands-on experience installing cable and antenna systems on towers and rooftops. You'll work as part of a dedicated crew in a high-demand industry. This is a great opportunity to start or grow your career in telecom infrastructure. You'll work outdoors, often at heights, building critical communications systems while developing valuable technical skills.

Your Work that Keeps us Connected (Job Responsibilities)

  • Assist with installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of wireless equipment on towers and rooftops (up to 200'+)
  • Learn to climb safely using proper fall protection systems
  • Install and route coaxial, fiber, and grounding cables
  • Operate hand tools, power tools, lifts, and job-specific equipment
  • Follow daily safety protocols and complete job hazard analysis (JHA) forms
  • Maintain company-issued PPE and gear
  • Support project completion by working collaboratively with foremen and senior technicians

Signal Strength (Qualifications)

  • Safety-first mindset with willingness to follow all procedures
  • Ability to climb and work at heights of 100'+ daily
  • Reliable transportation and valid driver's license with clean driving record
  • Strong attendance, punctuality, and attention to detail
  • Ability to work outdoors in various weather conditions
  • Basic knowledge of hand and battery-operated power tools
  • Willingness to learn in a fast-paced, physically demanding environment
  • Willingness to travel regionally

You'll Rise Above if (additional skillset)

  • Previous construction experience is highly recommended
  • Previous telecom tower work (not required but nice to have)

Why TCI - What You'll Gain (Benefits)

  • Competitive salary with performance-based incentives
  • Robust benefits: health, dental, vision, and 401(k) with company match
  • Tuition and education reimbursement
  • Career advancement and leadership development opportunities (Specialty roles: Foreman, RF Tech, DAS Tech)
  • Wellness programs
  • Culture club-team events

Timberline Communications Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy to assure equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants by prohibiting discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Business Enterprise Coordinator (700592)
description:
About the role

As the Business Enterprise Coordinator, you’ll lead the day-to-day operations of the Mount Field Visitor Centre, ensuring exceptional visitor experiences in one of Tasmania's most iconic national parks.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, including tour operators, local businesses and café staff.
  • Lead and support a team to deliver high-quality visitor services, information and experiences.
  • Manage business operations, including budgeting, rostering, recruitment and retail activities.

Based at one of Tasmania’s oldest National Parks and the gateway to Tasmania’s jewel heritage reserve, the Western Arthurs, you’ll enjoy engaging, educating, and providing detailed advice to visitors on attractions, weather conditions, and safety. This role will experience all the exciting seasons at the park, including the changing of the Fagus, winter snowfall, and summer days perfect for hiking.

This is a permanent position working 73.50 hours (minimum 58.80 hours by negotiation).

Our ideal candidate

  • Has knowledge of and passion for the natural values and attractions of Mount Field and Southwest National Park.
  • Builds positive relationships and communicates effectively with a diverse range of stakeholders.
  • Is a capable people leader who can develop, motivate and support a high-performing team.
  • Works proactively and confidently with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Demonstrates strong communication, organisational and customer service skills.

We offer

  • Competitive salary, 12% superannuation contribution, and salary sacrificing options.

  • Access to Fitness Passport, a corporate health and fitness program providing access to over 50 gyms and pools throughout Tasmania.

title: Valve Technician (48279)
description:
Valve Technician — Industrial Process Controls & Relief Valves

💰 $21.00 - $37.00 / hr |📍 Floresville, TX | Full-Time

🏢 Precision Pump & Valve (PPV), an MCE Company

Do you take pride in hands-on precision work and feel the satisfaction of knowing a well-serviced valve is keeping a plant safe and running?

We are looking for a mechanically skilled Valve Technician who takes quality seriously and wants to build real expertise in process control equipment. As a VR-certified service center, we handle everything from safety relief valves and control valves to tank vents, regulators, and chemical injection pumps. When our customers in oil and gas, petrochemical, and refining cannot afford downtime, they call us.

If you have hands-on experience with process valves and a background in heavy industrial environments, we want to hear from you.

Compensation & Benefits

$21.00 - $37.00/hr based on experience. We take care of our team with a full benefits package:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Company-paid life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability insurance.
  • 401(k) with a generous company match.
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays.
  • Tuition reimbursement — we invest in your development.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
  • Voluntary benefit products.

What You'll Do

Valve Service and Repair

  • Perform maintenance, repair, testing, and remanufacturing of industrial valves including safety relief valves, control valves, tank vents, flame arresters, and regulators.
  • Conduct re-machining and lapping of critical valve components to manufacturer specifications.
  • Clean, blast, and paint valve components to prepare for service and final inspection.
  • Operate shop equipment including blasters, parts washers, torches, forklifts, and precision measurement tools.

Quality and Documentation

  • Follow all safety and quality procedures — our VR certification depends on it.
  • Accurately document and enter job data including test results, parts used, and work performed.
  • Read and interpret measuring devices to verify component tolerances and performance.

Field and Shop Support

  • Perform field service work at customer sites as needed to get equipment back online fast.
  • Collaborate with shop and service teams to deliver reliable, on-time turnarounds for customers.

title: Client Skills Training and Practice Management, US Private Bank, Design & Delivery, Vice President

title: Program Director
description:
JOB TITLE: PROGRAM DIRECTOR

EMPLOYEE STATUS: At Will, Salaried, Exempt

AGENCY: Central Valley Training Center

SUPERVISES: Program Manager, Case Manager Special Education Teacher, Job Procurement Specialist, Office Assistant, Licensed Vocational Nurse, Cultural Liaison for the Deaf, Specialized Communication Instructor

REPORTS TO: Regional Director of Operations

WORK TYPE: In-Person

STARTING SALARY: $87,795.00/year

BENEFITS OFFERED: Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance, 401k, Vacation, Sick, Holidays, and Personal Holidays

(This job description is not an implied contract for employment. It is a management tool for assigning work.)

STATEMENT OF JOB

The Program Director (PD) provides leadership and management to all aspects of the day program for adults with intellectual disabilities and/or dual diagnosis. The Program Director ensures that customer needs and quality services are attended to based on the organizations purpose and values. The PD ensures that the program is in compliance with applicable State and Federal regulations and guidelines. They are a member of the Corporate Management Team and Program Director forum and collaborates with other directors and administrative managers to set strategic priorities and to plan for their implementation. The PD works with program staff to provide the best customer service at the highest quality possible. They set program goals and targets to enhance customer satisfaction, improve quality, and maintain a healthful safe environment.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The Program Director is responsible for organizing and supervising the operation of the assigned service program. The PD oversees the areas of budgeting, program design and implementation, project planning, staff development and training, evaluation and direction of program services. She/he organizes and monitors the intake and continuing assessment process.

The Program Director performs the following duties:

Leadership

  • Set program goals and targets based on the company Mission, Vision and Purpose.
  • Promote actions based on the organizational values.
  • Promote programmatic commitment, alignment, and teamwork.
  • Participate as a team member of the Corporate Management Team and Program Director Forum.
  • Provide employees clear information of job duties, job performance, and job standards.
  • Implement all company initiatives.
  • Provide efficient communication practices.
  • Communicate questions to the appropriate individual.
  • Send referrals to the BCBA through the approved channels.
  • Maintain relationships and correspondence with Community Care Licensing.
  • Maintain relationships with assigned Regional Center liaison.
  • Establish relationships with the schools and network for services.
  • Advise employees of corporate activities and policies.
  • Oversee program services through direct regular observation, contact and interactions.
  • Provide direct service to participants on an intermittent and/or temporary basis.
  • Involve in program preparation functions which ensure employee preparedness and quality services for participants.
  • Rapid On-Call Rotation

Quality Services & Customer Satisfaction

  • Meet and exceed customer needs.
  • Promote and utilize a continuous improvement process for all aspects of program operations and services.
  • Ensure general conduct and program quality standards are met.
  • Ensure that programs for the care, treatment, training, and safety of clients are fully implemented and maintained including, but not limited to, assisting with feeding, toileting, and crisis intervention.

Supervision

  • Ensure a clean, organized and safe working environment for personnel.
  • Supervise assigned staff by directing and assigning duties; assuring adequate personnel coverage; and selecting, training, supervising, monitoring and evaluating the performance of employees consistent with personnel policies and procedures.
  • Evaluate the quality and efficiency of the Training Program; institute changes as may be required to insure that the highest possible operating standards are maintained.
  • Develop and present program's annual plan and budgetary requirements to the Administrative Director.
  • Ensure the client admission process is followed in accordance with policies and procedures and State guidelines; maintain client attendance levels and approve all admission proceedings.
  • Participate in program personnel decisions in accordance with policies and procedures.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.

Dependability and Work Habits

  • The Program Director demonstrates behaviors and decisions that reinforce CVTC’s Mission, Vision, Purpose and Policy and Procedures. She/he is punctual to work, meetings and other appointments and provides advanced notice of absence or changes in work schedule.
  • The Program Director effectively plans and manages tasks and job duties. She/he monitors participant admissions process; anticipate changing demands; adjust program and staffing operations accordingly; assist in program preparation functions; take on new responsibilities to assist coworkers, participants and, external professionals and assumes these responsibilities with an understanding of the time and effort required to meet obligations.
  • The Program Director can make effective judgment. She/he gathers and evaluates pertinent information to determine action(s) needed to resolve service contract obligations, personnel, operational and participant situations; take action(s) that comply with Company’s policy and state and federal law; maintain a safe work environment.
  • The Program Director interacts well with participants. She/he promotes participant choice and decision making; work with participants to review and/or develop IPP and ISP objectives to meet their needs; support participants with respect and dignity in all situations; support participants by listening, informing, and advising. Provides direct service on a temporary and/or intermittent basis. Communicate with and involve Interdisciplinary Team members in problem solving and staff accordingly to ensure for the health and safety of participants in daily activities.

Strategic Planning and Financial Control

  • The Program Director develops, implements and monitors approved program budget. She/he meets with other team members to identify and gather information for fiscal planning and budget development; assess previous spending patterns, impending laws, regulations, future expenditures and external service opportunities; develop and present program budget; implement approved program budget; monitor and approve spending that is consistent with budget allocations and revise approved program budget to accommodate changes in revenue or unanticipated program needs.

title: Director, Communications Technology
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Communications Technology to lead the technical direction of our satellite communications systems supporting defense and government customers. This role owns the technical strategy for ground gateways, direct to device cellular and space-based communications network infrastructure, drives architecture and trade study efforts, and serves as a senior technical voice with customers, partners, and internal leadership. The ideal candidate combines expert-level cellular and satellite communications systems knowledge with proven experience building and mentoring high-performing engineering teams. The candidate should understand mission requirements and translate this to architectures, CONOPS, and technical solutions. The candidate must be comfortable translating complex technical tradeoffs into clear guidance for both engineers and decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture and design of satellite gateway systems and direct-to-device cellular and space-based network infrastructure supporting defense communications missions, with special knowledge of cellular infrastructure including baseband units, core networks, and satellite gateways.
  • Direct trade studies to evaluate satellite, gateway, and handset architecture options, technology choices, and system tradeoffs against mission requirements, cost, schedule, and risk.
  • Provide expert-level RF analysis and guidance across link budgets, spectrum utilization, interference, and propagation considerations.
  • Own systems engineering rigor across requirements definition, functional allocation, verification, and integration for communications subsystems.
  • Drive CONOPS (Concept of Operations) development in partnership with mission stakeholders to ensure technical solutions align with operational needs.
  • Support mission development activities, translating customer mission objectives into technical requirements and system concepts.
  • Build, lead, and grow a team of communications and RF engineers, fostering technical excellence and professional development.
  • Mentor engineers at varying experience levels, cultivating technical judgment, ownership, and career growth.
  • Establish engineering best practices, review processes, and technical standards across the communications technology discipline.
  • Serve as a primary technical point of contact with government and defense customers, representing AST SpaceMobile Defense's technical capabilities and roadmap.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences, including customers, program leadership, and executive stakeholders.
  • Support proposal development, technical reviews, and customer down-selects with well-reasoned architecture and trade study documentation.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with program management, business development, and the broader AST SpaceMobile engineering organization.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree is preferred.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in communications development and technology.
  • Strong background in satellite gateway systems and architectures.
  • Strong background in cellular systems and network infrastructure (RAN, core network, and related standards).
  • Demonstrated experience leading architecture development and trade studies for complex communications systems.
  • Expert-level RF analysis skills (link budgets, spectrum/interference analysis, antenna and propagation considerations).
  • Proven systems engineering experience across the full lifecycle (requirements, design, integration, verification).
  • Experience developing CONOPS and supporting mission development for government or defense customers.
  • Track record of building, leading, and mentoring engineering teams.
  • Expert-level experience in communications engineering broadly, with the credibility to serve as a senior technical authority.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) for Direct-to-Device (D2D) architectures.
  • Prior experience supporting DoD, intelligence community, or other government/defense customers.
  • Familiarity with space-based communications, non-terrestrial networks (NTN), or hybrid satellite-cellular systems.
  • Active or ability to obtain a U.S. government security clearance.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to engage effectively with customers, partners, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive stakeholders.
  • Strong mentorship and team-building orientation, cultivating technical judgment, ownership, and career growth in engineers at all levels.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, working effectively with program management, business development, and the broader engineering organization.

Technology Stack:

  • Satellite gateway systems and architectures.
  • Cellular network infrastructure, including baseband units, RAN, and core networks.
  • RF link-budget, spectrum/interference, and propagation analysis tools.
  • Systems engineering and requirements management tooling for full-lifecycle communications subsystem development.
  • CONOPS development and mission-analysis frameworks.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.
  • Ability to use a computer for extended periods.
  • Ability to work in a standard office environment, with occasional exposure to lab or secure facility environments as required for customer engagements.
  • Ability to travel to support customer engagements, technical reviews, and program activities as needed.

The research interests of Dr. Michele Tagliati include the study of early and advanced therapeutics of Parkinson's disease, dystonia and other movement disorders. Dr. Tagliati pioneered the use of deep brain stimulation in Parkinson's and dystonia, and his work contributed advances in the definition of outcome predictors and therapeutic settings of DBS.

The Project Scientist works independently and in cooperation with the Principal Investigator to make significant and creative contributions to a research or creative project in any academic discipline. The Project Scientist may be an ongoing member of a research team or may be employed for a limited period of time to contribute high-level skills to a specific research or creative program. Doctorate (PhD) in an area directly related to field of research specialization, required.

  • Completion of postdoctoral appointment in area of specialization, as applicable.
  • Knowledge of PI’s area of research specialization.
  • Demonstrated technical proficiency in a variety of research techniques and protocols.

title: Creative Director, CPG
description:
Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As the Creative Director, you are the leader of your pod, a hybrid of senior individual contributor, people manager, and product leader for Creative within the division. Reporting to the Managing Director, you own two things above all else: the people on your pod, and the quality of the creative work that pod produces.

This is a player-coach role. You are the best generalist on your pod, earning the team's trust through judgment and craft, not title, and you lead from the front: explaining creative strategy directly to clients, and stepping into concepting, design, or production coverage at an exemplary standard on select high-priority accounts, and for escalations and pitches when needed.

You protect your pod from unreasonable client pressure while holding a high, non-negotiable creative bar, and you own the full creative vision for your book of business, from strategy through post-production. Beyond delivery, you push the creative product itself forward, partnering with the R&D team to pilot new tools, formats, and approaches, then translating those innovations into practical gains for your division. This role is on the roadmap to Managing Director, building the people leadership and product judgment that role demands while staying closer to the craft.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development: Maximize the Team’s Output & Trust

  • Lead and manage a pod of creative professionals (Strategists, Designers, Editors, ACDs), owning hiring, onboarding, and day-to-day leadership.
  • Build development plans, coaching cadences, and mentorship for each team member.
  • Own team retention through trust, positive sentiment, psychological safety, and clear growth paths.
  • Drive performance management using the ARC framework; deliver direct feedback and raise/promotion recommendations.
  • Oversee capacity planning and staffing alignment as client books shift.
  • Facilitate ongoing training and knowledge-sharing on industry trends and tools.

Client & Delivery Oversight: Senior Contributor - Lead From The Front

  • Able to meet directly with clients and explain strategy, performance, and channel nuance.
  • Able to get hands-on with coverage, meaning stepping into day-to-day execution on the channel, and do it at an exemplary standard.
  • Provide executive-level oversight for pod accounts, with hands-on support on the most complex or highest-priority clients.
  • Act as primary escalation point for client concerns within Creative.
  • Strengthen retention by delivering strong creative solutions and identifying expansion opportunities.
  • Track client churn trends within the pod's book and intervene early on risk signals.

Product Quality & Innovation: Own The Evolution of Your Service

  • Quality: Own product quality through consistent, accountable QA, ensuring no revenue-impacting errors.
  • Innovation: Lead creative product development through structured innovation, knowledge-sharing, and brainstorms; centralize learnings from betas and tests.
  • Partnership: Collaborate with the Service Lead and platform partners to stay ahead of creative trends.
  • Systems fluency: Maintain full working knowledge of the Power Circuit and nova ecosystem; adapt to evolving processes.
  • AI adoption: Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes and drive results.

Other

  • Has a genuine interest in how your service can expand and evolve, specifically for your division industry.
  • Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • 7–8 years of digital marketing/creative experience, with 5+ years in an agency setting.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on, expert-level experience across creative disciplines (copywriting, design, production, strategy, and/or post-production).
  • 5+ years of experience managing a team, including performance management and development planning.
  • A portfolio demonstrating a track record of conceptualizing, developing, and delivering creative campaigns across multiple channels at scale.
  • Demonstrated judgment and credibility that has earned the trust of a team of creative specialists.
  • Expert knowledge of how creative functions within the broader marketing funnel and business strategy.
  • Executive-level presentation and communication skills, with the ability to advise senior client stakeholders and internal leadership.
  • A visionary leader with a track record of building culture, inspiring teams, and pushing creative boundaries while delivering measurable business results.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • 96%+ Creative client retention rate
  • Closed Service Expansion Retainer for Creative to support Division 60% ETCR
  • 8 Average Client NPS
  • Hit Division P&L Goals (revenue and ebitda)
  • +90% Team Retention
  • 60% Creative Team contribution margin
  • Client Book Revenue per Employee (RPE): $15,000

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Effectively manage the pod to create a positive team member experience aligned with company objectives.
  • Deliver a top-tier, consistently excellent creative product for clients through the pod's work.
  • Own the growth and evolution of Creative's product and craft, not just its day-to-day delivery.
  • Oversee the growth and retention of both the team and its clients.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Prepaid Medicine Plan
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
