title: Executive Producer, Content & Storytelling
description:
Icarus was founded on the belief that the Stratosphere is the Forgotten Frontier and that reclaiming it will define the next era of aerospace and what is possible from the sky. We build solar-powered aircraft that fly at 60,000 ft for weeks at a time, delivering persistent, affordable, and scalable presence from this layer of the atmosphere.

Mission

Re-establish and maintain dominance in the Stratosphere.

Executive Producer, Content & Storytelling

Icarus is looking for an Executive Producer, Content & Storytelling to capture, build and share the Icarus story as it happens.

This is a hands-on Executive Producer role, not a traditional social media, marketing or production-management position. We want an exceptionally experienced, highly technical creator who can operate as a one-person production capability, from the factory floor to flight tests, remote airstrips, operational exercises and major company milestones.

You’ll own the full content lifecycle: concept, capture, direction, photography, production, editing, animation, original music, sound, livestreaming, publishing and archive.

The goal is simple: document the journey, build the Icarus brand and bring the mission to life.

What you’ll do

  • Document Icarus: Capture aircraft development, manufacturing, flight tests, launches, deployments, exercises, milestones, successes, challenges and the people behind them.
  • Create Across Formats: Produce everything from commercial-grade advertising, product sizzles and social content to episodic YouTube series and documentary-length productions.
  • Shape the Narrative: Find and develop stories, not simply capture footage, and turn complex technology, operations, industry and human moments into compelling visual narratives.
  • Own Social: Develop and execute content across platforms, with deep expertise in LinkedIn, YouTube and emerging channels, knowing when the moment calls for highly polished brand content versus raw, unfiltered or live field storytelling.
  • Own Production End-to-End: Concept, direct, shoot, light, photograph, record, edit, color, score, sound design, mix, create VFX, motion graphics and 3D animation, finish, version and deliver.
  • Create the Sound: Compose and produce original music, score to picture, cut picture to music, engineer audio, design sound and deliver professional-quality mixes. Audio is part of the storytelling, not an afterthought.
  • Go Live: Independently plan, produce and troubleshoot livestreams from launches, flight tests, demonstrations and events, including cameras, audio, networking, power, connectivity and technical infrastructure.
  • Build Experiences: Bring the Icarus brand to life through factory visits, demonstrations, conferences, launches and other physical, digital and interactive experiences.
  • Build the System: Own digital asset management and create a searchable, tagged and structured visual archive capable of supporting daily content, institutional memory, multi-platform distribution and future episodic or feature-length productions.
  • Use Modern Tools: Apply modern creative software, automation, AI and technical tools to accelerate production, organization and distribution. Build new workflows or tools when existing ones aren't good enough.
  • Move Fast: Manage multiple concurrent productions, incorporate rapid feedback and deliver at the pace of a high-velocity aerospace startup.
  • Protect the Mission: Exercise exceptional judgment around OPSEC, customer sensitivities, classification boundaries and competitive information.

What we’re looking for

  • Deep, proven experience as an end-to-end creator across commercial/advertising, social, episodic and long-form filmmaking
  • 7+ years of professional production experience preferred, with significant experience independently owning productions
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a solo or highly self-sufficient production presence for extended periods
  • Portfolio spanning commercial-grade work, documentary storytelling, high-energy content and authentic field production
  • Significant history producing YouTube content, including recurring episodic and long-form work
  • Strong command of LinkedIn and polished corporate/brand storytelling
  • Expert cinematography, still photography, lighting and audio capabilities
  • Expert editing, color, VFX, finishing and post-production capabilities
  • Strong 3D animation and motion graphics experience
  • Professional composition, music production, sound design, mixing and audio engineering capabilities
  • Deep familiarity with professional creative and design suites, including the ability to quickly master new or bespoke tools
  • Livestream production, networking and remote field-connectivity expertise
  • Ability to independently deploy, maintain and troubleshoot a complete professional production package
  • Experience operating in remote, extreme, unpredictable and high-tempo environments
  • Exceptional pre-production, logistics and operational planning skills
  • Experience managing digital assets, metadata, versioning and multi-platform delivery
  • Fluency with modern software, automation and AI-enabled creative workflows
  • Software engineering, networking, web development, interactive media or creative technology experience is a significant plus
  • Ability to create interactive digital experiences or tools that extend storytelling beyond traditional video is a plus
  • Comfortable building systems and workflows rather than simply using them
  • Strong interviewing skills across technical, operational and executive audiences
  • Experience earning and maintaining trusted access in sensitive working environments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Exceptional creative judgment, discretion and attention to detail
  • Understanding of OPSEC, responsible storytelling and information protection
  • Genuine passion for the Icarus mission, aviation, aerospace, technology and national security

Why Icarus

  1. A lot of equity
  2. Top market salary and bonuses
  3. Health, dental, and vision insurance
  4. Factory in El Segundo
  5. Real ownership, real hardware, real flight
  6. Small team, massive responsibility (but growing very fast)
  7. High signal (engineering) to noise (management) culture
  8. Dream desk setup
  9. Daily lunch
  10. Unlimited celsius

This is not a normal content creator job

  1. We are pioneers, not corporate managers.
  2. Icarus deliberately optimizes for high signal to noise. Engineering, manufacturing, flight, and execution matter more than process, politics, or management overhead.
  3. Your job is not to add bureaucracy. Your job is to make the company move faster.
  4. You will work side by side with the CEO and a small team of world-class builders. You will help build the company behind the aircraft: the factory, the team, the systems, the rhythm, the culture, and the operational backbone that lets us move faster than companies 10x our size.
  5. We expect full extreme ownership. This is a high-trust, no-BS team, and everyone pulls their weight.
  6. We want builders. No hand-holding. No fluff. No fake projects. No sitting in meetings all day. Just real execution, real hardware, real flight, and real company-building.
  7. You must thrive under pressure, learn fast, solve problems across functions, and push the company to operate at a higher level every week.
  8. We move fast. We go to Mojave at 4 am. We expect results and an obsession with quality and speed.

No tourists. No bystanders. Only builders.

US salary range

$180,000-210,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are considered part of Icarus' total compensation package.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all applicants without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Technical Program Manager, AWS DC Community-Availability Serviceability
description:
At AWS, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, driven people. The team is seeking a Technical Program Manager II (TPM II) to serve as the Global Process Owner (GPO) for one of our global maintenance programs — owning the standard end-to-end, from definition through global execution and continuous improvement. You will be a highly visible owner who drives the communication, coordination, cross-organizational consensus, and execution of a multi-year program vision, and who owns the decision and unblocks the path forward when consensus cannot be reached.
Our Serviceability team owns serviceability excellence across AWS's global data center fleet. We set and maintain the preventive-maintenance (PM) standards, critical-spares strategy, and operational readiness testing programs for the electrical, controls, mechanical, and generator infrastructure that keeps AWS data centers online. We operate on a Global Process Owner (GPO) model: each Technical Program Manager owns a global program end-to-end — defining the maintenance standard, driving it through a gated review-and-approval lifecycle, and stewarding it globally across every AWS region. We turn field data into standardized, data-driven maintenance decisions that reduce risk, extend asset life, and lower cost at fleet scale.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.
You'll join a diverse team of infrastructure, software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate is able to:
• Own operational relationships with support teams, internal operations business partners, and cross-organizational stakeholders to drive increased performance.
• Demonstrate analytical and quantitative skills and the ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions, develop business cases, and set program goals.
• Effectively interact and collaborate with customers, project sponsors, technical product managers, and multiple internal teams, and drive cross-organizational consensus to define and deliver complex solutions.
• Proactively recognize and drive opportunities to simplify and standardize processes across the program.
• Own the technical standard for your program and influence related technical designs.
• Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration, and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities.
• Lead the effective and efficient delivery of large, complex technical projects and programs.
• Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make tradeoffs, own the decision, and unblock the path forward when consensus cannot be reached.
• Identify, assess, track, and mitigate issues and risks across the program and its execution network.
• Create, maintain, and disseminate program information to stakeholders, and report program health to leadership on a regular cadence.
• Travel up to 25%.

A day in the life
On a typical day, you will:
• Work with partner teams to ensure High Voltage (HV) related program deliverables are developed, maintained and integrated into CMMS.
• Drive HV program through its full lifecycle — develop, execute, manage, and report.
• Own the HV program's annual goal and reporting cadence.
• Manage stop-work escalations and issues affecting HV execution; make the call and unblock the path when consensus cannot be reached.
• Partner with regional SMEs and vendors to scale HV execution while pursuing standardized solutions.

title: Math Mentor PT Online
description:
Math Mentor (Part-time; ONLINE)
American Heritage School is a mission-driven, faith-centered private school aligned with the teachings and values of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, seeking a part-time (5-10 hours a week) Math Mentor who is committed to academic excellence and student development in a faith-centered environment. AHS's math program is powered by Math Academy, an adaptive, mastery-based online platform that personalizes instruction for each student across five courses: Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, Algebra 2, Geometry, and Pre-Calculus. The Math Mentor supports students working through this platform by leading structured tutoring sessions, providing individualized guidance, and helping ensure steady progress toward mastery. This role is designed for an educator who is passionate about helping students grow intellectually, spiritually, and socially while supporting the school's mission and values. The ideal candidate will create a learning environment that inspires confidence in math, encourages personal growth, and reflects Christian principles in daily mentoring and interactions.

About Our Math Program
AHS's math curriculum is powered by Math Academy, an adaptive, mastery-based learning platform that customizes instruction to each student's pace and ability. Students progress through five sequential courses (Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, Algebra 2, Geometry, and Pre-Calculus), building a strong mathematical foundation through daily practice, targeted review, and continuous mastery checks. Rather than a traditional lecture-based classroom, the program blends independent, platform-guided learning with structured group tutoring and individualized mentoring, allowing each student to move at a pace suited to their needs while receiving consistent support and accountability from their mentor.

Nature of the Role
This position is considered a faith-forming role within the school community. In addition to providing strong academic instruction, the mentor is expected to actively support, model, and teach principles consistent with the Mission and values of AHS and the teachings of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The role requires a mentor who can positively influence students through both instruction and personal example, fostering a classroom culture grounded in faith, respect, and discipleship.

Qualifications
Qualified candidates should possess a bachelor's degree or equivalent, be comfortable with math through at least the Pre-Calculus level, and have at least two years of mentoring or tutoring experience, preferably within a formal educational setting. Successful applicants will demonstrate a genuine love for mentoring youth, strong organizational and communication skills, and the ability to explain math concepts clearly and adapt to each student's needs, as well as a commitment to actively participate in and contribute to a faith-based educational environment aligned with the teachings and values of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Candidates should also bring enthusiasm, consistency, and professionalism to their sessions while remaining committed to ongoing professional growth and comfortable using online, adaptive learning platforms such as Math Academy to support student learning.

Faith and Mission Responsibilities
In addition to academic responsibilities, mentors at AHS are expected to integrate faith-based principles and moral reasoning into classroom instruction where appropriate, serve as an example of Christian character and discipleship to students, support and uphold the spiritual mission of the school through daily interactions with students and colleagues, participate in school-wide devotionals, prayer, and other faith-centered activities, and respond thoughtfully to student questions related to faith, values, and moral decision-making in a manner consistent with the school's mission.

Professional Expectations
Candidates should be professional in appearance and demeanor and willing and able to serve as ambassadors for the AHS Mission, Honor Code, and Diversity Statement. Personal conduct, public statements, and online presence, both on and off campus, are expected to reflect and support the school's religious mission and educational purpose.

Mentoring Responsibilities
The Math Mentor should bring a warm, energetic, and engaging presence that helps students feel supported, challenged, and inspired. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong subject-matter knowledge across Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, Algebra 2, Geometry, and Pre-Calculus, along with the ability to explain concepts in a clear, organized, and encouraging way. The Math Mentor leads structured math tutoring sessions each Monday and Thursday and provides individualized, one-on-one math mentoring sessions with students throughout the week, helping them work through Math Academy's five courses at a pace suited to their needs. Mentors should foster confidence and persistence in math, help students work through misunderstandings as they arise, and monitor each student's progress within the platform to ensure steady advancement toward mastery.

Communication and Organization
Candidates should demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and maintain purposeful, well-organized tutoring and mentoring sessions that support effective learning. Responsibilities include grading student work when needed, monitoring student progress within the Math Academy platform, and maintaining collaborative, timely, and positive communication with students, parents, and staff regarding progress, concerns, and next steps. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential for supporting student success and keeping accurate records across all five courses. Experience working with students who have specific learning disabilities is considered beneficial but is not required.

Extracurricular Opportunities
Applicants are encouraged to share any interest or experience in supporting AHS extracurricular athletics programs. AHS prefers to fill coaching and activity roles with employees who have both the interest and skills to mentor students in these areas.

Position Details
This part-time position (5-10 hours a week) includes math tutoring sessions each Monday and Thursday, plus flexible one-on-one mentoring time throughout the week, and is available for the August 2026 through June 30, 2027 school year.

Important Note to Applicants
AHS is a mission-driven, faith-centered, and patriotic school. Employment at AHS requires alignment with and support of the school's religious mission and values. Individuals who are unable or unwilling to support these expectations should carefully consider whether this position is a good fit.

title: Sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundige bij Gebiedsteam Maarssen
description:
Wil jij als sociaal psychiatrisch verpleegkundige werken in de specialistische GGZ en echt iets betekenen voor mensen met ernstige psychiatrische aandoeningen (EPA)?

Bij Gebiedsteam Maarssen krijg je veel zelfstandigheid en ruimte om jouw SPV-expertise in te zetten. Je komt bij cliënten thuis, werkt nauw samen met een breed multidisciplinair team en hebt een afwisselende functie waarin geen dag hetzelfde is.

Wat ga je doen?
Gebiedsteam Maarssen is onderdeel van Altrecht en biedt specialistische GGZ aan volwassenen in Stichtse Vecht en De Ronde Venen. We werken volgens de F-ACT-methodiek en bieden onze zorg ambulant, outreachend en zoveel mogelijk in de eigen omgeving van de cliënt. Voor huisbezoeken en andere afspraken staan drie leaseauto’s voor het team klaar.

Als SPV heb je een eigen caseload en werk je met volwassenen met ernstige psychiatrische aandoeningen (EPA). Je voert intakes uit, stelt behandelplannen op en biedt herstelgerichte, systeem- en klachtgerichte behandeling. Daarbij heb je aandacht voor verschillende levensgebieden en werk je samen met de cliënt aan passende doelen. Ook speel je een belangrijke rol bij crisissituaties en bied je bemoeizorg wanneer contact of behandeling niet vanzelfsprekend tot stand komt.

Je werkt nauw samen met psychiaters, verpleegkundig specialisten, psychologen, GGZ-agogen, ervaringsdeskundigen en ketenpartners zoals huisartsen en woonbegeleiding. Je schakelt tussen cliëntcontact, overleg en onverwachte situaties.

Daarnaast draai je enkele keren per maand mee in de 24-uurs bereikbaarheids- en aanwezigheidsdiensten van de crisisdienst van Altrecht. Hiervoor ontvang je passende toeslagen en compensatie.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Ontwikkeling staat bij Altrecht centraal. In de zorg die we bieden, in onze aanpak en in jouw carrière. Bij ons krijg je de kans om te groeien en impact te maken. Vanuit een inspirerende omgeving, met bevlogen collega’s.

Als grote organisatie met diverse (TopGGZ) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht, denken we graag met je mee.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.000,- tot € 5.294,- (FWG 55 in de cao GGZ) op basis van 36 uur per week.

  • De diensten voor de crisisdienst worden in FWG 60 uitbetaald.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (volledige dertiende maand) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar op basis van 36 uur per week. Wil je nog extra tijd voor jezelf? Dan kun je extra verlof bijkopen, tot een maximum van 36 uur, afhankelijk van de omvang van je dienstverband.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget. Je kunt het bedrag uit laten betalen, extra verlof kopen of het bedrag verhogen tot € 1.400,- als je het inzet voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Een pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, een collectieve inkomensverzekering bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en korting op aanvullende ziektekostenverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea.

  • Alflex. Ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Hiermee kun je jouw salaris fiscaalvriendelijk inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld een fiets, een sportschoolabonnement of aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding.

  • De Altrecht Academie. Hier vind je een uitgebreid aanbod aan (online) scholingen voor de specialistische GGZ. En dankzij intervisie met je bevlogen collega´s groei je elke dag verder in je werk.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een zelfstandige professional die gemakkelijk contact maakt met cliënten en collega's. Je houdt van afwisseling, denkt in mogelijkheden en blijft rustig wanneer situaties complex worden. Je kunt goed zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op wanneer een situatie daarom vraagt.

Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde hbo opleiding Verpleegkunde, aangevuld met een geldige BIG registratie als SPV.

  • Een AGB code en registratie in het kwaliteitsregister V&VN.

  • Ervaring met herstelgericht werken binnen de GGZ.

  • Affiniteit met de doelgroep volwassenen met een Ernstige Psychiatrische Aandoening.

  • Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden.

  • Een flexibele en zelfstandige werkhouding.

  • Bereidheid om mee te draaien in de bereikbaarheids- en aanwezigheidsdiensten.

  • Een rijbewijs, zodat je ook ambulante zorg buiten de locatie kunt bieden.

Wie zijn wij?

We zijn een betrokken en gezellig team waarin we elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. We denken met elkaar mee bij ingewikkelde situaties, maar er is ook ruimte voor humor en gezelligheid. Nieuwe ideeën zijn welkom en je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Af en toe doen we ook iets leuks met elkaar buiten het werk, zoals samen uit eten gaan of een andere gezellige teamactiviteit.

Enthousiast en nu?

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de onderstaande button! Wil je eerst meer weten? Stuur gerust een berichtje naar Peter Hopman, teammanager via 06-82682157 of p.hopman@altrecht.nl.

Je bent ook van harte welkom voor een oriënterend gesprek, zodat je de sfeer bij ons kunt ervaren. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

  • Solliciteer rechtstreeks via. Zo weten we zeker dat jouw sollicitatie goed bij ons binnenkomt.

title: Head of Strategy and Product Consulting
description:
Head of Strategy and Product Consulting


A leading global provider of new generation IT solutions to the global Travel, Transportation and Logistics industries is looking for a Head of Strategy and Product Consulting for their Loyalty software product Line of Business.


The Head of Strategy and Product Consulting is the company’s loyalty strategy expert. This role operates at the intersection of platform strategy, commercial positioning and market-facing expertise and leads the Strategic Product Consulting group. The role is shaping how the product is positioned and monetised today and how it will be designed for the future.


Areas of Responsibility


Product Line Strategy

Own the product strategy. This is the central intellectual and commercial output of the role — a living strategic direction that is coherent, differentiated, and operationally grounded. The Head of Strategic Product Consulting synthesises four distinct streams of intelligence into a single, authoritative strategic direction for the platform:

  • Competitive intelligence.
  • Technology outlook.
  • Account signals.
  • Pipeline data.

Market Positioning & Competitive Narrative

Define the target market segments and total addressable market (TAM) based on the defined product strategy and construct and own the competitive positioning within these segments.

  • Define target market segments and potential and maintain a quantitative assessment of the addressable market.
  • Maintain a competitive map: for each relevant competitor and capability dimension, document the product’s honest position (lead, parity, or gap) and keep it current as the market moves.
  • Construct win themes and differentiation narratives for the product’s current (and future) core market segments: airline loyalty programmes, cruise loyalty, hospitality loyalty and travel group multi-brand programmes.
  • Ensure narrative consistency across Sales, Presales, Consulting and Marketing.
  • Develop and publish points of view on the future of travel loyalty in conference keynotes, white papers, analyst briefings and executive roundtables. This thought leadership is a positioning instrument, not a content marketing exercise.


Monetisation & Commercial Model

Own the commercial model. Pricing and packaging decisions directly determine the revenue potential, competitive positioning and the value customers believe they are receiving. The Head of Strategic Product Consulting is the decision-maker on these questions — not a contributor to them.

  • Pricing model.
  • Module packaging.
  • Expansion path design.
  • Deal structuring.
  • Pricing guidelines for Sales.


Strategic Customer Engagement & Presales Authority

Lead high-value customer consulting engagements and act as the senior product authority in major pursuit cycles. Embed directly in customer environments to surface loyalty strategy gaps, map their operating model against best-practice configuration and deliver transformation blueprints that drive commercial outcomes. Operate at CxO level (Chief Loyalty Officers, CMOs, and CEOs) as the advisor who bridges a customer's strategic ambitions and what the platform makes possible. In presales, provide the expert voice that converts a platform evaluation into a strategic partnership decision, contributing to RFI and RFP responses, leading senior client presentations and ensuring competitive positioning reflects the current state of the narrative.


Function Leadership & Team Development

Establish and develop the Strategic Product Consulting team (comprising of roles of Product Consultants and Product Specialists) with a mandate to grow the function in line with commercial demand. Set standards for how the group operates, define its methodology, and integrate it effectively with Sales, Product Management and the broader organisation. Recruiting and developing the right team is an enabler of the four responsibilities above; it is not the primary output of this role.


Qualifications


Must have:

  • 10+years loyalty domain expertise in travel and/or transportation including programme design, accrual and redemption mechanics, tier strategy, partner ecosystem management, member lifecycle and commercial loyalty economics. Airline loyalty depth is particularly valued.
  • Demonstrable product strategy experience: ability to synthesise competitive, technology and commercial signals into a coherent multi-year platform direction. Prior product management or product strategy ownership is strongly preferred.
  • Commercial model fluency: direct experience with SaaS and AI pricing design, packaging decisions or enterprise commercial governance. The ability to construct and defend a pricing rationale to both Finance and the customer is essential.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence at CxO level in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments across both customer advisory and internal alignment.
  • Strong content and narrative development: executive-grade strategy documents, competitive assessments and positioning frameworks. Work samples will be requested at interview.
  • Comfort building from first principles in a high-ambiguity environment. This is a role that defines its own operating model.
  • Profound team player with the ability to collaborate with peers and across roles and functions to drive for the joint success.


Good to have

  • Prior experience at a loyalty platform vendor in a product strategy, presales or commercial capacity.
  • Consulting background from a consulting firm with a dedicated loyalty or travel practice
  • Familiarity with the broader IT travel ecosystem and how loyalty intersects with airline or travel operator commercial strategy.
  • Experience with AI-augmented product and analytical tools and a genuine interest in how AI changes both platform capabilities and consulting delivery.
  • Familiarity with competitive intelligence frameworks, win/loss analysis methodologies or analyst relations in enterprise SaaS.
  • Additional languages skills beyond English (Spanish, German, French preferred)


Practicalities

- Flexible Location.

- Competitive Package.

- International travel required.

title: Credit Originator – Commercial Real Estate, Cash Flow and Derivative Lending - Vice President
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Vice President to join our cash flow-based and unsecured credit products team within Commercial Real Estate. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing national platform focused on delivering financing solutions to a diverse client base, including asset-light operating companies, institutional asset managers, closed-end investment funds, and real estate investment trusts. Transaction scope is highly varied, including working capital facilities for property management and real estate services companies, unencumbered asset pool financings for large private real estate funds, derivative facilities for private equity sponsors and investment managers, and in select situations, leveraged lending opportunities for real estate operators associated with acquisition and buy-out financing.

As a Vice President within the cash flow-based and unsecured credit products team within Commercial Real Estate, you will play a leading role in the origination, structuring, underwriting, and execution of corporate credit transactions. You will coordinate across internal and external stakeholders, including coverage, syndications, credit, legal, and client teams. You will be responsible for managing transactions throughout the full lifecycle, from initial client engagement and financial analysis through credit approval, documentation, and closing.

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze corporate financial statements, business models, cash flow generation, and collateral profiles to assess debt capacity and recommend appropriate financing structures.
  • Lead and participate in client due diligence activities, including meetings with management teams, sponsors, investors, advisors, and other transaction stakeholders.
  • Prepare and oversee pitch materials, financial analyses, credit underwriting memoranda, investment committee presentations, and client-facing deliverables.
  • Structure and execute a broad range of cash flow-based and unsecured credit facilities in partnership with coverage, syndications, credit, legal, treasury, and product teams.
  • Evaluate ancillary business opportunities and broader client relationship potential associated with lending transactions.
  • Negotiate term sheets, credit agreements, and related legal documentation to ensure transaction economics, structure, and risk parameters align with client objectives and firm standards.
  • Manage the transaction closing process, including coordination of due diligence, internal approvals, external advisors, and legal counsel.
  • Mentor, develop, and provide guidance to junior team members while fostering a collaborative and high-performance team environment.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives, process enhancements, and platform development efforts

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Minimum 5 years of commercial/corporate banking lending experience including extensive credit, structuring, and marketing
  • Advanced understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, cash flow modeling, and credit risk assessment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, counsel, product partners, credit officers, and senior management.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and professionalism.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating corporate credit agreements and related loan documentation.
  • Familiarity with derivative products and related documentation, including ISDA and Credit Support Annex (CSA) agreements.
  • Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

  • Experience with diversified cash flow industries, syndicated credit facilities, and/or leveraged finance
  • Experience working within a regulated banking environment and familiarity with bank credit, risk, and approval processes.
  • Familiarity with large language models, artificial intelligence tools, and emerging technologies that enhance productivity, analysis, and execution capabilities.

title: DevOps Team Lead
description:
The DevOps Team Lead owns the delivery, reliability, and day-to-day operation of our AWS cloud platform, an extensive multi-account cloud environment managed as code and expanding toward globally distributed, multi-region workloads.

This is a highly hands-on technical leadership role. You'll be one of the strongest technical contributors on the team while also helping shape and prioritize the work. You'll translate product and engineering needs into infrastructure requirements, guide the team's delivery, and ensure what we build is automated, secure, documented, cost-conscious, and operationally reliable.

The role is approximately 60% hands-on engineering and 40% technical leadership, including requirements, planning, review, coordination, and coaching.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, review, and operate our Infrastructure-as-Code estate across a multi-account AWS environment, including reusable modules, environment configurations, state management, and account provisioning.

  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes, including automated validation, security and compliance controls, and keyless cloud authentication.

  • Build and maintain the core AWS services supporting our products, including networking, containers, databases, storage, messaging, systems management, backup, monitoring, and cost controls.

  • Establish and reinforce practical engineering standards around IaC, IAM, resource tagging, state management, versioning, security, documentation, and operational readiness.

  • Translate ambiguous requests from product, engineering, security, and data teams into clear requirements, milestones, estimates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

  • Own and refine the DevOps backlog and facilitate the team's Scrum cadence, including planning, stand-ups, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Strengthen platform reliability through observability, SLOs, actionable alerting, runbooks, disaster recovery, backup and restore practices, and continuous reduction of operational toil.

  • Participate in a rotating night and weekend on-call schedule and provide technical leadership during platform incidents, including incident coordination and post-incident follow-through. Rotation frequency will depend on team size and coverage needs but is shared equitably across the team.

  • Partner with security to embed identity, least-privilege access, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and compliance requirements into the platform.

  • Lead cloud cost visibility and optimization, including tagging, right-sizing, commitment planning, anomaly response, and the cost implications of multi-region architecture.

  • Help evolve the platform toward globally distributed workloads, including regional rollout, data residency and replication, latency-aware routing, cross-region failover, and associated operational tradeoffs.

  • Use AI tools effectively in engineering workflows and help design and operate the cloud infrastructure needed to support emerging AI capabilities.

  • Set technical direction in partnership with architecture and coach engineers through code review, pairing, design discussions, documentation, and shared platform ownership.

What You'll Bring

  • Extensive experience in software engineering, infrastructure, or DevOps, with demonstrated experience operating at a senior or technical lead level in complex cloud environments.

  • Expert-level, current hands-on experience with Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure as Code, including managing large-scale cloud environments through IaC.

  • Experience with IaC at scale, including reusable module design and versioning, state architecture, safe refactoring, upgrades, drift detection and remediation, and bringing legacy infrastructure under IaC management.

  • Deep hands-on AWS experience across compute, storage, networking, IAM, and security, ideally within a multi-account AWS Organization.

  • Proven ownership of infrastructure CI/CD pipelines, including automated policy, validation, and security controls.

  • Experience designing and operating containerized or distributed production workloads with appropriate networking, security, and observability.

  • Scripting proficiency and a track record of automating operational work.

  • Demonstrated ownership of production operations, including on-call, incident response, runbook development, and the ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve platform issues.

  • Experience leading Agile/Scrum practices, including backlog ownership, refinement, estimation, planning, and stakeholder negotiation.

  • Strong ability to turn ambiguous needs into thorough, actionable technical plans that account for requirements, dependencies, risks, milestones, and estimates.

  • Strong understanding of cloud security, compliance, and risk management, including least privilege, zero trust, encryption, and appropriate exception management.

  • Excellent written communication, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • A self-directed, collaborative approach with a focus on improving systems rather than repeatedly working around problems.

  • Willingness and ability to participate in a rotating night and weekend on-call schedule and independently manage production incidents while on call.

Preferred Experience

  • Microsoft Azure experience, particularly Azure Cloud Adoption Framework concepts, landing zones, governance, policy, cost management, and IaC tooling.

  • Experience operating globally distributed or multi-region applications, including data replication, global routing, failover, data residency, and regional compliance considerations.

  • Experience with monorepo IaC environments, policy-as-code, IaC security tooling, or automated code-quality platforms.

  • FinOps experience, including tagging-based cost allocation, commitment planning, anomaly detection, and multi-region cost analysis.

  • SRE practices, including SLOs, error budgets, observability, and structured incident management.

  • Experience supporting analytics, data engineering, database, or integration workloads as a platform provider.

  • AWS certification such as Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, or Security Specialty.

  • Experience with hybrid connectivity to on-premises environments or improving software development lifecycle practices.

  • Experience provisioning or operating infrastructure for AI/ML platforms, including model serving, vector stores, accelerated compute, or supporting data pipelines.

title: Barback FT- The Americano
description:

The Barback supports the bartending and Food & Beverage team by ensuring the bar is fully stocked, clean, organized, and ready to provide exceptional guest service. This position works closely with bartenders and supervisors to maintain smooth and efficient bar operations while upholding the service standards of InterContinental Hotels & Resorts.

  • Assist bartenders with daily bar setup, service, and closing procedures.

  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull items weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to frequently bend, reach, stoop, and move throughout the bar and hotel.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment for extended periods.

The Barback works in a fast-paced, high-energy Food & Beverage environment and plays an important role in supporting the bartending team. The ideal candidate is dependable, hardworking, team-oriented, and committed to maintaining the high standards of service expected at InterContinental Hotels & Resorts.

title: Sr. SAP Commerce Platform Engineer
description:
Legrand North America has a remote opportunity for a Senior SAP Commerce Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Digital Systems team. This is a deep platform engineering role (not a maintenance role).
You will build and extend the SAP Commerce backend, integrate it with upstream enterprise systems through middleware, and own problems end to end — from the storefront request down through the service and persistence layers to the integration boundary. The platform serves multiple brands and storefronts and is evolving toward a composable, headless architecture, so your work at the core is consumed by every team that builds on top of it.
We are seeking engineer who can operate independently inside the platform: reason through the full stack, diagnose production issues by working directly through SAP Commerce and Dynatrace logs, and resolve them at the root.
At a Glance
  • Work inside a centralized SAP Commerce backend that powers multiple brand storefronts. Some storefronts are owned by the platform team; others are owned by business-unit teams who consume what you build. Decisions you make in the core propagate outward to all of them.
  • Hands-on backend engineering: building and maintaining custom SAP Commerce extensions — type system, service layer, interceptors, cron jobs, ImpEx, integration logic — and on the integrations that connect commerce to upstream enterprise systems (ERP, PIM/Stibo, CRM) through middleware.
  • Independent troubleshooting through SAP Commerce Cloud and Dynatrace is a daily expectation. You should be the person who can take an ambiguous production symptom and trace it through logs, traces, and code to a root cause without escalation.
  • The platform is moving toward headless / composable (OCC APIs, headless content, search). Sound API and contract judgment matters and is valued — but it sits on top of, and depends on, real depth in the backend itself.
  • This role reports into Platform Engineering and partners with the platform architect on design and estimate validation. You'll be expected to operate with independent technical direction and full ownership of outcomes in your domain.
Build and extend the SAP Commerce backend
  • Design, build, and maintain custom SAP Commerce extensions — data models, service layer, facades, interceptors, cron jobs, and platform logic — following sound architecture for a multi-brand, multi-storefront environment.
  • Work fluently across the SAP Commerce stack: type system and persistence, the Spring-based service layer, ImpEx, FlexibleSearch, and the build/deploy model on Commerce Cloud.
  • Develop new platform capabilities against business requirements, and maintain and refactor the existing codebase, including the accelerator-based storefront that runs today.
Integrate with upstream systems
  • Build and maintain integrations between SAP Commerce and upstream enterprise systems (ERP, PIM/Stibo, CRM) — through middleware where appropriate — using standard, resilient integration patterns.
  • Reason clearly about data ownership and authority: which system is the source of truth under which conditions, and how the platform behaves when an upstream system is slow, stale, or unavailable.
  • Where the architecture calls for it, design and build OCC / commerce APIs with consistent semantics and stable versioning so downstream storefronts can integrate without bespoke work.
Diagnose and resolve — independently
  • Take ownership of production issues and drive them to permanent resolution: reproduce, isolate, root-cause, fix, and verify.
  • Work directly through SAP Commerce Cloud logs and the Dynatrace observability stack — traces, service flow, log analysis, performance metrics — to diagnose issues across a multi-layered, integrated architecture. This is a core, daily skill, not an occasional one.
  • Communicate root cause and impact clearly to the team and to stakeholders and follow through on action items to closure.
Raise the floor of the team
  • Conduct PR reviews for domain correctness and architectural adherence — and use review as a mechanism to grow other developers, not just to gate merges.
  • Produce documentation that is ahead of the team's needs. Knowledge, you hold must be transferable, not tribal — the platform should not stall when any one person is unavailable.
  • Be present at the solutioning and design stage, catching design risks before they enter a sprint as defects.
Operate in delivery
  • Participate in requirements and scope definition, providing credible estimates grounded in real platform constraints.
  • Work in an Agile delivery model (Kanban / sprint-based) with disciplined feature flagging, fallback logic, error handling, and test coverage on all new code.
Required:
  • Backend depth: strong, demonstrable SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) backend experience — typically 6+ years — with full, independent ownership of non-trivial extension and platform work. Evaluated on the scope you have owned.
  • Extension development: you build extensions confidently across the type system, persistence layer, Spring service layer, interceptors, ImpEx, and FlexibleSearch, and apply sound design patterns and OOD principles in a layered architecture.
  • Full-stack reasoning: you can reason through the full stack — from a storefront or API request, through the service and persistence layers, to the integration boundary — and locate a problem without being walked to it.
  • Observability & troubleshooting: you are highly comfortable diagnosing issues directly through SAP Commerce Cloud logs and Dynatrace. Given an ambiguous production symptom, you can trace it to root cause independently.
  • Integration: you have built and maintained integrations between SAP Commerce and upstream systems (ERP, PIM, CRM), including through middleware, and can reason about authority, resilience, and failure behavior across system boundaries.
  • Independence: you own outcomes end to end can work idependently while making consistent progress. You communicate root cause and impact clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred:
  • Data & search: strong SQL and Solr; comfort with the data and search layers underneath commerce.
  • Headless mindset: experience with, or clear ability to reason about, a headless / composable model where the storefront is decoupled from the backend (OCC consumed by Spartacus/Composable Storefront or a custom React frontend).
  • Engineering leadership: a track record of making the engineers around you more capable through documentation, design input, and review.
    Familiarity with composable / MACH architecture, Contentful (or another headless CMS), Algolia, and Cloudinary.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience.

title: Firmwide Analysis Team - Financial Control Associate
description:
Are you a detail-oriented finance professional ready to make an impact on a global stage? JPMorganChase's Firmwide Financial Control team offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of financial integrity and innovation, partnering with teams across EMEA, North America, and Asia. This is your chance to grow your career while driving meaningful change through automation and advanced analytics.

As a Financial Control Associate within the Firmwide Financial Control team, you will partner with line of business controllers, product control, and external reporting teams to ensure the integrity of the Firm's reported financial results. You will perform balance sheet, revenue, expense, and NII yield analysis procedures while supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities across global operations. You will also leverage machine learning capabilities and automation tools to refine processes, enhance controls, and mobilize change across the organization.

Job Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with line of business controllers, financial control, product control, and external reporting teams on financial integrity initiatives
  • Partner with Firmwide Financial Control teams globally to support cross-regional deliverables and priorities
  • Support month end, quarter end, and year end activities as they relate to the Firm’s balance sheet and income statement
  • Perform various balance sheet, revenue, and expense analysis procedures to ensure the integrity of reported financial results
  • Perform various NII yield analysis procedures to ensure the integrity of reported financial results
  • Lead monthly yield calls with line of business controllers and financial control to review product-level yield results
  • Support ad-hoc requests for financial information received from teams across the Firm

  • Excellent interpersonal skills needed for working within a team environment as well as communicating across departments

title: Program Manager, Defence, Worldwide Public Sector
description:
The Program Manager supports the delivery of cloud transformation and priority initiatives for Australia's Defence Organisation, helping keep them on schedule and aligned to customer outcomes. This role coordinates day-to-day project activities, tracks progress across workstreams, maintains visibility of risks and dependencies, and supports the planning and execution of Think Big initiatives and priority engagements that demonstrate how AWS can address Defence's most pressing capability challenges.

You will support a portfolio of initiatives designed to deepen AWS's partnership with Defence. This includes Think Big engagements that help Defence leaders envision how cloud can address their strategic challenges, as well as priority delivery programs that demonstrate tangible value. You will be the connective tissue that keeps these initiatives moving: coordinating across internal teams, maintaining stakeholder engagement rhythms, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. More information regarding security clearances can be found at https://www.agsva.gov.au/.

In this role, you can expect to travel interstate approximately 10% of the time.

Key job responsibilities
Program Management: Support the end-to-end coordination of priority Defence initiatives from concept through delivery, including tracking dependencies across AWS teams (Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, Partners), maintaining initiative timelines, and ensuring deliverables are on track and aligned to customer outcomes.

Project Support: Support the delivery of cloud and transformation projects, maintaining schedule adherence and quality standards across assigned workstreams.

Stakeholder Engagement: Support customer engagement activities with Defence stakeholders, coordinating logistics, tracking actions, and maintaining alignment on project milestones. Prepare briefing materials, maintain stakeholder maps, and support the rhythm of engagement across Defence Groups and Services.

Program Coordination: Prepare materials for and support facilitation of weekly alignment meetings, program updates, and cross-team coordination sessions to keep delivery teams synchronised. Support the planning and coordination of Think Big events, executive briefings, and priority initiative workshops with Defence customers.

Milestone Tracking: Coordinate with technical delivery teams, solutions architects, and operations to track milestone progress, flag dependencies, and maintain accurate schedule documentation.

Tracking & Reporting: Maintain project trackers, dashboards, and status reports; provide regular updates on progress, risks, and blockers.

Risk Monitoring: Monitor and report on milestone-level risks and issues impacting project schedules; escalate per established protocols and support development of mitigation strategies.

Process Improvement: Contribute to process improvement initiatives, using data and metrics to support efficiency and delivery quality.

About the team

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you don't meet all of the qualifications listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path or includes non-linear experiences, that's something we value — don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture.

title: Surgical Tech Certified- Labor and Delivery
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Under the supervision of Management, the Surgical Technologist prepares for scheduled procedures and arranges sterile set up of instrument tables according to established protocol. He/she assists surgeons by passing instruments and supplies, holding retractors, and anticipating surgeons' needs during course of procedure. The surgical tech is also responsible for assisting with the processing of instrumentation, cleaning of the operating room suite and for proper storage placement of the equipment and supplies.

Shift: Full Time Nights 12 hr.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Service:

  • Supports and maintains the Mission. Core Values and expected customer service behaviors of St. Joseph Medical Center.
  • Follows the St. Joseph Medical Center guidelines related to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), designed to prevent, or detect unauthorized disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI).
  • Promotes a culture of safety for patients and Associates through proper identification, proper reporting, documentation, and prevention of medical error in a non-punitive environment
  • Assists the RN in prioritizing implementation of physician orders according to patient need physician requests, and interdepartmental procedures.
  • Scrubs for cases according to established sterile procedures: dons' sterile gown and gloves and assist surgeons as needed.
  • Prepares for scheduled operative procedure by arranging sterile set up of instrument table with supplies. instruments and sutures required for specific procedures according to surgeons' preference.
  • Assists during procedures, handles flexible scopes, acts to anticipate, and respond to Physicians' needs during course: procedure.
  • Pass instrument, sponges, sutures and other sterile supplies and equipment to surgeons and assistants during procedures, holds retraction devices and acts to anticipate and respond to surgeons' needs during course of surgery.
  • Counts sponges, needles, and instruments according to established policy and assists with sterile dressing of operative site following procedure. Responsible for cleaning of operating room and/or endo suite according to established procedures following each case by removing drapes, replacing hamper and trash bags, disposing of used supplies, cleaning, and returning equipment to appropriate storage areas, and so forth.
  • Cleans procedure room following each case by disposing of used supplies, cleaning, and retuning equipment to appropriate storage areas.
  • Cleans and stores equipment including flexible scopes.
  • Receives surgical specimens, places same in preservative solutions and notifies circulating nurse of type of specimen.
  • Performs related clerical and service duties such as answering telephones, relaying messages, scheduling cases, transporting patients to and from surgery, requisitioning supplies and so forth.
  • Participates as assigned in operating room services on call schedule and arrives on site within 45 minutes.

People:

  • Assists in orienting and training new associated.
  • Sets an example to all staff in their daily activities.

Quality:

  • Supportive of the compliance program set forth by SJMC and demonstrated by:
  • Upholds the rode of Ethics and Corporate Compliance.
  • Adheres to and helps to enforce all compliance policies relevant to area.
  • Assures timely compliance education as requested by the Compliance Officer and/or through corporate initiatives.

Growth:

  • Keeps current regarding developments in surgical equipment, trends, and techniques through in-service programs.

Finance:

  • Promotes stewardship of hospital resources while ensuring quality customer service and risk promotion.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Interpersonal skills necessary to interact with patients, surgeons, and other patient care personnel, often during emergency or stressful situations.
  • Analytical skills necessary to organize and prepare the operating room according to standards of methods and procedures.
  • Ability to concentrate and pay close attention to detail for up to 80% of work time when performing technical tasks and anticipating surgeons' needs.
  • Ability to stand for prolonged periods (more than 80% of work time) and to occasionally lift and position patients when preparing patients for operative procedures; and manual dexterity necessary to grasp and hold firmly retractors and delicate surgical instruments.

Education, Training, and Certifications

  • Candidate is a graduate of an accredited educational program for surgical technologists and holds and maintains certification as a surgical technologist.
  • American Heart Association BLS is required.

Welcome to St. Joseph Medical Center (SJMC), Houston's first and only downtown hospital delivering world-class care for the last 137 years and looking forward to the next century of exceptional care to Houstonians when they need us most.

Whether it's for a scheduled surgery, the birth of a baby, an unexpected emergency, or an outpatient visit, we have staff available around the clock to provide you access to immediate, quality health care. SJMC has been providing health care services to Greater Houston residents for over 130 years, which should give you great comfort in knowing that we have a great tradition of caring for our community. We strive to meet our patients' expectations and encourage our patients to provide us with feedback on how we can help them have the best experience possible while they're in our care.

Over the last years we have expanded our services to include the Advanced Wound Care Center, Comprehensive Cardiac and Vascular Services, the Women's Center, the St. Joseph Maternal Fetal Medicine Center, and a Weight Loss Surgery Program, just to name a few. As you work with our physicians, nurses, case managers, educators, and other staff, you will be guided through your health care journey, from diagnosis to treatment, with compassion every step of the way.

Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are at the foundation of the care St Joseph Medical Center provides to our community we are privileged to support in all of our employment practices. We do not discriminate on the grounds of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression or any other non-job-related characteristic.

title: Senior Product Manager, Commerce
location: Bellevue, Washington, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join Flexport's product team and own a critical part of how we serve clients and operators across global logistics. You'll define the vision and roadmap for your product area, ship features that drive measurable business outcomes, and collaborate with engineering, design, commercial, and operations teams to solve hard problems at scale.

Flexport's platform powers every stage of global freight, from booking and pricing to visibility, customs, and delivery. The products you build will be used daily by logistics managers, supply chain leaders, freight operators, and internal teams who keep goods moving around the world. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong product instincts with deep analytical skills and comfort navigating complex domains.

The team:

The Commerce team owns the end-to-end quality, automation, and profitability of Flexport’s commerce domain. We build intelligent agents to automate critical commerce workflows, including quoting, billing, and invoicing, while driving cost intelligence across every shipment process gate to optimize profitability. Additionally, our team expands the marketplace catalog for new offerings and develops next-generation, client-facing commerce products and payments technology.

You will:

  • Define and deliver product features that improve key commerce workflows for internal operators and clients across Flexport's platform
  • Own your product area end-to-end, building and executing product roadmaps spanning 12 to 18 months
  • Build intelligent AI agents to automate core commerce operations, including quoting, billing, and invoicing
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to translate complex logistics workflows into clear, intuitive experiences
  • Collaborate closely across a global footprint with engineering teams in the West Coast US and China, participating in regular cross-border syncs
  • Use data to guide prioritization, measure impact, and identify opportunities
  • Develop analytics frameworks to track product health, user engagement, and business outcomes
  • Contribute to medium- and long-term product strategy, with opportunities to shape the future of the platform

You should have:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, or other domain-relevant experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead product roadmaps spanning 12 to 18 months working closely with an engineering team and cross-functional partners
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills. You are comfortable working with complex datasets, building metrics frameworks, and using data to make decisions. SQL proficiency required
  • A track record of shipping intuitive UX in data-dense, complex domains
  • Experience building user-facing or operator-facing features that simplify multi-step workflows
  • Ability to collaborate deeply with designers, engineers, and commercial or operations teams

title: Sr Product Manager, Amazon Customer Service
description:
Amazon Customer Service (CS) organization is seeking a Sr Product Manager to own the end-to-end customer service design across Fire Tablet, Amazon Kids and Emerging products.

This role owns customer experiences with major scope and strategic importance where the problem, opportunity, and strategy may not yet be defined. You will work backwards from customer pain points to define product vision, write strategy documents (PRFAQs, narratives, roadmaps), and drive execution across product, engineering, design, and operations teams. You will define success through measurable outcomes, distinguishing between output metrics like defects eliminated and effort reduction, and outcome metrics like customer satisfaction, engagement, and quality of experience.

As the critical intersection point for customer needs, business goals, and technical possibilities, you will lead cross-organizational initiatives with potential P&L impact. You will apply one-way and two-way door judgment to high-stakes decisions, challenge assumptions, and establish strategic frameworks adoptable by other teams. You will also identify emerging technology shifts, including AI and agentic systems, and drive multi-year investments that reshape the CS landscape.

This leader earns trust and influences without authority at the Director and VP levels across Product, Marketing, Engineering, Finance, Legal, PR and Operations teams by consistently delivering results that raise the bar.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the 3 to 5 year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Fire Tablet, Amazon Kids and Emerging CS. Drive clarity where strategy is undefined, and create frameworks that enable organizational action. Leverage CS data to identify breakthrough opportunities, lead customer research across segments, and establish experience standards adopted by other teams.
- Demonstrate deep technical curiosity. Evaluate engineering proposals, ask the right questions, and ensure sound trade-offs. Understand key architecture decisions, the assumptions behind them, and whether those assumptions still hold. Bring performance, scale, and flexibility perspectives into engineering conversations early.
- Identify technology shifts, including AI, before they become obvious. Drive multi-year technology investments and evaluate complex technical proposals. Apply AI and agentic capabilities to accelerate development, improve decisions, and unlock innovation. Distinguish genuine need from hype and reshape product strategy through effective adoption of emerging technologies.
- Champion exceptional customer experiences grounded in utility, intuitiveness, and simplicity. Partner with design on mockups and prototypes, scrutinizing details while aligning with strategic goals. Ensure customer validation reflects diverse perspectives and drive strategic CX conversations across your area.
- Influence without authority across CS and other VP organizations, building alignment across teams with different priorities. Present regularly to Directors and VPs, align on OP1/OP2/goals, and own executive engagement for critical issues. Amplify impact by developing others and actively recruiting PM talent.
- Serve as the recognized CS Voice of the Customer in product design, ideation, and launch readiness. Engage senior decision-makers to uncover non-obvious insights. Define CS requirements, hold launches to a high experience bar, and own cross-org launches. Take calculated risks in pursuit of breakthrough results where consequences are significant.

A day in the life
On any given day, you will drive strategic conversations with senior leaders to align on multi-year CS product direction for Fire Tablet, Amazon Kids and Emerging products. You serve as the connective tissue between CS service design, operations, product line stakeholders, and partner organizations, setting priorities and driving alignment across teams with different objectives.

You will present investment narratives in Director and VP level product reviews, fielding questions on customer impact, scalability, business sustainability, and competitive positioning. You will balance setting the 3 to 5 year vision with near-term execution: defining cross-org launch requirements, authoring OP1/OP2 narratives, building consensus on bold bets, and measuring impact across your portfolio.

You will drive multi-year technology investment decisions, evaluating how agentic capabilities could reshape the CS experience, forming views on ROI and market timing, and determining when to make bold bets versus invest in further validation. You will define investment areas within operational planning cycles, build cross-functional consensus on long-term strategic direction, and establish the metrics frameworks and measurement strategies that other teams adopt.


About the team
D2SD (Digital and Devices Service Design) is part of the Customer Service Experience (CSX) team within Amazon CS, and owns the end-to-end customer service experience across Amazon's Digital and Device portfolio. We are the advocates for the CS experience for customers using our device and digital products, and relentlessly work to remove customer facing defects, improving quality and shaping how millions of customers use our products and get help. Our insights drive product improvements upstream, and our mechanisms set the standard for Customer Obsession within Amazon Customer Service.

title: AIML Software Engineer, On-Device Audio Intelligence, Sensing & Connectivity
description:
In Sensing & Connectivity, we use on-device sensors and wireless technologies to understand user context — combining sensor data with machine learning to create intelligent, ambient experiences across Apple platforms. As a Software Engineer on the Location & Motion team, you will design and build the frameworks and system services that enable on-device sensing at scale. You will create algorithms that process real-time signals, extract meaningful context, and deliver those insights to users through platform-level frameworks and integrations with Apple Intelligence. You'll work closely with CoreLocation, CoreMotion, Audio Understanding, and AIML colleagues to tackle open-ended, research-like problems — prototyping novel sensing capabilities and bringing them to production on Apple platforms.

This role is for the platform-level work: daemons, frameworks, and ML inference pipelines beneath the UI layer, continuously interpreting the environment efficiently, privately, and deeply integrated with the OS. You will collaborate with ML researchers to translate models into production systems. Problems span low-level signal capture to high-level context modeling to APIs surfacing capabilities to developers and features across Apple platforms.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • 6+ years experience on client-side / platform-level development on Apple platforms
  • Swift and Objective-C; production-quality frameworks, daemons, or system APIs
  • Systems expertise: concurrency, multithreading, memory management, performance tuning
  • CoreML or equivalent on-device ML inference experience
  • Strong communication; operates well in ambiguity

Preferred Qualifications

  • Real-time audio processing (capture pipelines, buffering, signal handling on iOS/macOS)
  • REST API / cloud service integration
  • Audio feature extraction or classification pipelines for on-device ML
  • Experience training/fine-tuning ML models or collaborating with ML researchers to productionize them
  • Deep OS stack debugging (frameworks, daemons, services)
  • Energy efficiency and resource constraint optimization on mobile
  • Privacy-preserving sensing (on-device inference, data minimization)
  • CloudKit or distributed data sync
  • Public or internal API/SDK design and delivery
  • Mentorship and technical direction track record

title: Guest Experience Agent
description:
First impressions count. To get our guests’ memorable experiences off to an unforgettable start, we’re looking for a Front Desk Agent who can make transactions feel seamless, offer exceptional local insights, and anticipate every request to make our guests feel right at home.

A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:
● Kicking off truly memorable guest experiences with the warmest of welcomes
● Acknowledging IHG Rewards Club members and returning guests in person or over the phone
● Taking, managing, and receiving payments for guest bookings
