title: Associate Director, Strategic Operations
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Job Title: Associate Director, Strategic Operations

Team: Insights & Strategic Planning

Location: Hybrid in Chicago (IL) strongly preferred, Atlanta (GA), Newark (NJ), or New York (NYC)

Employment Type: Full-time

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Start Date: ASAP

About Braven

Braven is a national nonprofit that prepares promising college students to secure a strong first opportunity after college graduation through a career-accelerating program.

We work with higher education and employer partners to offer a life-changing experience that begins with a semester-long course for college students, followed by support that lasts through graduation.

Together, our ambition is to help rebuild the middle class and revitalize the American Dream.

To learn more, take a look at Braven’s Jobs.

About the Role

In order to achieve its ambition of serving 80,000-100,000 Fellows over the next decade, Braven is hiring an Associate Director, Strategic Operations, who will serve as the operational engine for the Insights & Strategy team and lead the process to report on priorities and goals at the organizational level. This role will own the Braven-wide rhythm and content of how we communicate progress on our goals to staff, leaders, and our national and regional boards; play a key role in the Insights & Strategy team’s work to strengthen cross-functional coordination and partnership; and drive the internal operational rhythm of the Insights & Strategy team. You will be a designer of process, an expert on our priorities, and a trusted voice on our progress.

This is a role for someone who excels at communication and writing, creating and owning high-quality operations and processes, and collaborating cross-functionally. You read context well, operate comfortably in ambiguity, demonstrate utmost discretion, and know how and when to take the next step without waiting to be asked.

This role is on the Insights & Strategy team and reports directly to the Head of Insights & Strategy.

What You’ll Do

Organizational Progress Monitoring & Reporting (40%)

  • Design, own, and continuously improve the infrastructure to prepare progress updates for stakeholders. Regular deliverables include but are not limited to:
  • Project managing and packaging quarterly progress-to-goal (PTG) memos for Braven’s national board, leadership, and staff
  • Drafting region-specific progress updates on priorities for regional board meetings
  • Preparing regular updates to Braven leadership and staff on organizational priorities and goals
  • Pull, analyze, and/or visualize data independently to support progress monitoring
  • Build relationships with relevant partners for this work (e.g., executive owners of priorities)
  • Establish expertise and serve as a thought partner on questions and situations related to org-wide progress monitoring

Cross-Functional Partnership & Coordination (30%)

  • Act as trusted liaison to the leaders of the Product, Systems, and External Affairs teams in changing the operating model for how they work together.
  • Design and help execute a regular central team <> regional team feedback structure at the Alignment Team level (Braven’s leadership team)
  • Support the Head of Insights & Strategy to lead two internal councils (Data Governance Council and AI Advisory Council) and one external council (Labor Market & Economic Advisory Council)

Insights & Strategy Team Operations and Coordination (30%)

  • Own the coordinated operational rhythm of the two halves of the team (Insights and Strategy), including annual planning and goal-setting, quarterly alignment, and weekly coordination
  • Design and plan team stepbacks and other meetings in support of the Head of Insights & Strategy and the Senior Director of Insights, from creating the agenda through post-meeting follow-up
  • Own knowledge management for the Strategy half of the team, maintaining shared and organized documentation and ensuring process clarity
  • Lead or support capacity-building and systems/process-building projects for primarily the Strategy half of the team

For all of the above responsibilities, use AI in responsible, smart, and human-valuing ways to continuously improve the effectiveness and efficiency of your work.

Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • BA/BS in a quantitative field or work experience that demonstrates expertise in quantitative analysis
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience
  • Extensive experience writing and presenting compelling data-driven narratives for internal and external audiences
  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience using AI effectively and responsibly to make an actual impact on outcomes
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Experience designing and building dashboards and visualizations (Tableau preferred)
  • Strong strategic thinking skills, including a proven ability to bring clarity to ambiguous solutions
  • Ability to take initiative to solve challenges and tap into opportunities; ability to make complex tasks simple by applying clear logic and processes to component steps
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills, which allow you to manage your own time and energy and seek the right help to complete multiple projects well and on time.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail, known for checking and double-checking your work
  • Learner’s mindset, which you use to master new tools, software, and ways of working.
  • Strong collaboration skills. You seek to understand others’ problems and use your own perspective to solve problems together.
  • You have the following technical skills and knowledge:
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Slack, and Jira
  • Proficiency in Salesforce
  • Proficiency in Python or R
  • Your experiences have informed your belief in Braven’s mission and have prepared you to work with or for Braven’s student Fellow population.

Please know that no one ever meets 100% of the preferred qualifications. If much of this describes you, we encourage you to apply.

Work Demands

  • Ability to work in-person in Atlanta (GA), Chicago (IL), Newark (NJ), or New York City (NYC)
  • Travel roughly 5 times per year for team convenings and to visit regions in your portfolio

Additional Requirements

  • Authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Braven doesn’t offer employment visa sponsorship

Application & Interview Process

While the interview process may vary slightly, the general process will be:

  • Phone screen with Talent Team member
  • Performance Task
  • Interview with Hiring Manager
  • Panel Interview with Key Partners
  • Reference Checks

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits

Braven offers competitive base salaries based on the midpoint of the market among not-for-profit organizations of similar size, with opportunities for salary growth over time. We believe in compensating staff members fairly in relation to each other, their qualifications, and their impact on behalf of the organization, and take internal and external equity seriously. Given our commitment to equity, Braven does not negotiate salary offers; instead, each salary offer is determined carefully using external and internal benchmarking.

Starting salary within the range is determined by role scope and qualifications, with new hires starting at the lower end to allow for growth with performance. Braven does not base compensation on individual candidate salary expectations and is committed to maintaining internal equity. The salary ranges, by geographic market, for this role are set forth $87,200-$108,900 in Atlanta, $92,000-$114,900 in Chicago, and $101,200-$126,400 in Newark and New York City. This is based on a 50-hour work week at an hourly rate. This is a full-time, regular, exempt, and benefits-eligible position where you will be working at 100% capacity.

Braven also provides competitive, comprehensive benefits, recognition, and career development. While Braven reserves the right to change benefits at any time, current benefits include:

  • Unlimited vacation time in addition to org-wide holidays and week-long shutdowns in July and the end of the calendar year (this is a minimum of 19 days per year)
  • Braven supports your path to parenthood and beyond with $25,000 in lifetime Carrot benefits for fertility, family-building, and hormonal health
  • Match of your 401K contribution up to 5% of your base annual salary, starting your first full month
  • Coverage of 85% of health insurance premium for employee and dependents

title: AI Data Specialist - Tokyo
description:
Scopely Explore is seeking a highly motivated AI Data Specialist/ Engineer to join our Tokyo Studio, supporting Monster Hunter Now and Pikmin Bloom. This role will sit at the intersection of data engineering, AI tooling, marketing, live game operations, and product strategy.

Scopely Explore’s Tokyo Studio builds games that inspire people to explore the real world together. Monster Hunter Now brings players outside to hunt, craft, and grow stronger together, while Pikmin Bloom helps people find joy in everyday walking and real-world memories. As an AI Data Engineer, you will build the trusted data pipelines, AI-native tools, and automation systems that help our teams operate these games with more speed, rigor, and creativity.

What You'll Do

  • Partner cross-functionally with stakeholders across Product, LiveOps, Marketing, User Acquisition (UA), CRM, and Game Operations (including product managers, marketers, analysts, data scientists, engineers, and studio leadership) to identify and prioritize high-impact data and automation opportunities and translate ambiguous business needs into reliable AI-native technical systems.
  • Build and operate scalable data models, pipelines, semantic layers, and self-service data products using BigQuery, dbt, Looker, Airflow, and related cloud technologies.
  • Develop production-quality AI-enabled workflows using technologies such as LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) knowledge systems, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop review patterns to help teams investigate performance, detect anomalies, prepare decision briefs, and plan and evaluate campaigns.
  • Partner with Marketing to improve and automate workflows for audience segmentation, campaign performance, UA governance and execution, reactivation, event planning, and post-launch analysis.
  • Safeguard data quality and metric consistency across game, marketing, and executive reporting while promoting responsible AI use through appropriate evaluation, oversight, and human review.
  • Create reusable internal tools, patterns, and documentation that make AI accessible to non-technical teams while preserving trust, reviewability, and clear source-of-truth data. Contribute hands-on to Tokyo Studio’s broader AI operating model and help teams adopt effective AI-enabled workflows.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly by validating generated code and analysis through rigorous review, automated testing, and established quality gates (including linting, type checking, and CI) before production.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, machine learning engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Deep expertise designing, building, deploying, and operating production data platforms across cloud data warehousing (e.g., BigQuery or Snowflake), data transformation and modeling (e.g., dbt), business intelligence and semantic layers (e.g., Looker), and workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow), with demonstrated ownership of reliability, observability, data quality, performance, cost efficiency, and production troubleshooting.
  • Exceptional SQL skills and strong data-modeling fundamentals, including dimensional modeling, metric design, semantic layers, and scalable analytical data products, along with strong ability to write clean, maintainable production code for pipelines, automation, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Hands-on experience building AI solutions for real business workflows, including LLM applications, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-integration layers, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt and tool orchestration, and model evaluation.
  • Strong judgment and hands-on experience establishing data-quality controls, consistent metric definitions, and responsible AI practices across data and AI-enabled systems (including reliability, privacy, access control, explainability, evaluation, and human review) and validating AI-generated code and analysis through code review and automated testing.
  • Experience building tools for and working directly with Product, LiveOps, Marketing, User Acquisition (UA), CRM, or Game Operations teams, with the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities and translate ambiguous business and operational needs into durable technical systems that teams can trust and reuse.
  • Experience building reusable internal data and AI tools and driving adoption among technical and non-technical users through documentation, training, and hands-on enablement, while contributing to AI operating models through shared standards, governance, ownership, and review practices across functions and regions.
  • Excellent business-level verbal and written communication in both English and Japanese.
  • Ability to work from Scopely Explore’s Tokyo office three days per week.

Plus If...

  • You enjoy helping teams become more capable by building practical systems that combine better tools, trusted data, and thoughtful automation to support faster, better-informed decisions.
  • You are passionate about games and player behavior, have experience with free-to-play mobile, live-service, or location-based products, and are familiar with real-world or social mobile games such as Monster Hunter Now, Pikmin Bloom, or Pokémon GO.
  • You have experience modernizing prototype or locally operated data workflows into reliable, scalable, cloud-managed production systems.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

title: Quality Inspection Technician
description:
West Coast Magnetics is a world-leading custom manufacturer of precision electronic components used in the medical and aerospace industries. For over 30 years, our mission is to meet or exceed our customer's expectations for product conformance to specification, on-time delivery, service, and value through continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.

We have an immediate opening for a Quality Inspection Technician.

Function:

The function of the Quality Inspection Technician is to ensure the high quality of parts being sent to our customers and to ensure compliance with WCM work instructions and procedures. Advice for the purpose of improving quality and reducing time and cost to manufacture.

Reporting Relationships:

The Quality Inspection Technician reports to the Quality Inspection Supervisor. The Quality Inspection Technician interfaces with all Leads, Engineering, Testing, Mark and Pack, Material Control, and Personnel.

Authority:

The Quality Inspection Technician has the authority to:

1. Reject parts that do not meet specifications on the customer drawings.

2. Recommend redline changes to production drawings.

3. Suggest methods to improve product and quality, reduce time and cost to manufacture.

4. Perform audits to verify compliance with approved work instructions and procedures.

Responsibility:

The Quality Inspection Technician has the responsibility and duty to:

  • QC all parts, verifying that all parts meet all customer specifications including electrical specifications.
  • Perform periodic internal audits to verify that approved work instructions and procedures are being followed.
  • Verify that customer P.O. #, ship dates, part numbers and revision level, quantity of parts is consistent throughout all documentation accompanying each order.
  • Verify that all parts are built 100% to specification prior to release for shipment to the customer.
  • Maintain IPC 610 certification.
  • Ensure that workmanship meets WCM and customer standards.
  • Sign off all orders and certificates of compliance.
  • Ensure Manufacturing compliance with the Standard Procedure Manual.
  • Keep the work area clean.
  • Follow all applicable company Standard Procedures.
  • Ensure defective parts are clearly labeled and identified in accordance with the company Quality Policy.
  • Maintain a final inspection discrepancy log.

Performance Measurements:

The Quality Inspection Technician will be deemed to be performing in a satisfactory manner when the following is accomplished:

  • A productive working relationship with other personnel is maintained.
  • A minimum number of reworks are received from customers.
  • The Inspection team is adhering to the company safety program and a minimal number of workplace accidents occur.
  • Accurate record-keeping.
  • Professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Degree of closeness to a goal of zero customer rejects resulting from Final Inspector discrepancies.

Minimum Requirements:

1. High school diploma or equivalent

2. Good communication skills

3. A minimum of two years of experience working in quality inspection role in electronic industry.

Organizational Values & Culture

  • WCM members are passionate about growth, innovation, and collaboration. We are constantly striving to improve and better ourselves so that we can better support our clients. If you have a growth mindset and thrive under pressure, you are probably a great fit for our team!

title: Research Fellow - School of Chemistry - 107855 - Grade 7
description:
Position Details

School of Chemistry

Location: University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham UK

Full time starting salary is normally in the range £36,636 to £46,049 with potential progression once in post to £48,822

Grade: 7

Full Time, Fixed Term contract up to May 2027

Closing date: 2nd September 2026

Background

To create and contribute to the creation of knowledge by undertaking a specified range of activities within an established research programme and/or specific research project.

About the School of Chemistry

The School of Chemistry seeks to attract outstanding, inspirational and talented people, supporting them to succeed and celebrating their success. We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community. The School of Chemistry holds an Athena SWAN Bronze Award, in recognition of its work in promoting women’s careers in higher education. The University of Birmingham is a member institution of the Race Equality Charter, a Disability Confident Employer and contributes to the Stonewall Workplace Equality Index. We support flexible working and studying.

Our research is driven by four core themes —Energy, Sustainability, Environment, and Health—complemented by interdisciplinary Interest Groups, serving as catalysts for emerging ideas. This dynamic structure makes our School an exciting place to work and collaborate.

Major University investment in our subject enabled the 2024 opening of our state-of-the-art Molecular Sciences Building. We recently completed the strategic expansion of our academic staff, and we continue to invest in teaching and learning excellence.

As part of our collegiate community, you will demonstrate academic citizenship by cultivating generous, respectful, and supportive working relationships. You will positively influence how others succeed, reinforcing the collaborative spirit that defines our culture.

Role Summary

  • Work within specified research grants and projects and contribute to writing bids
  • Operate within area of specialism
  • Analyse and interpret research findings and results
  • Contribute to generating funding
  • Contribute to licensing or spin out deals with demonstrated commercial success (such as revenues, asset or company sales, IP generated) and/or public understanding of the discipline or similar

Main Duties

The responsibilities may include some but not all of the responsibilities outlined below.

  • Develop research objectives and proposals for own or joint research, with assistance of a mentor if required
  • Contribute to writing bids for research funding
  • Analyse and interpret data
  • Apply knowledge in a way which develops new intellectual understanding
  • Disseminate research findings for publication, research seminars etc
  • Supervise students on research related work and provide guidance to PhD students where appropriate to the discipline
  • Contribute to developing new models, techniques and methods
  • Undertake management/administration arising from research
  • Contribute to Departmental/School research-related activities and research-related administration
  • Contribute to enterprise, business development and/or public engagement activities of manifest benefit to the College and the University, often under supervision of a project leader
  • Collect research data; this may be through a variety of research methods, such as scientific experimentation, literature reviews, and research interviews
  • Present research outputs, including drafting academic publications or parts thereof, for example at seminars and as posters
  • Provide guidance, as required, to support staff and any students who may be assisting with the research
  • Deal with problems that may affect the achievement of research objectives and deadlines
  • Promotes equality and values diversity acting as a role model and fostering an inclusive working culture.

Person Specification

  • First degree in area of specialism and normally, a higher degree relevant to research area or equivalent qualifications
  • High level analytical capability
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly
  • Fluency in relevant models, techniques or methods and ability to contribute to developing new ones
  • Ability to assess resource requirements and use resources effectively
  • Understanding of and ability to contribute to broader management/administration processes
  • Contribute to the planning and organising of the research programme and/or specific research project
  • Co-ordinate own work with others to avoid conflict or duplication of effort
  • Knowledge of the protected characteristics of the Equality Act 2010, and how to actively ensure in day to day activity in own area that those with protected characteristics are treated equally and fairly

Informal enquiries to Peter Slater, email: p.r.slater@bham.ac.uk

View our staff values and behaviours here

Use of AI in applications: We want to understand your genuine interest in the role and for the written elements of your application to accurately reflect your own communication style. Applications that rely too heavily on AI tools can appear generic and lack the detail we need to assess your skills and experience. Such applications will unlikely be progressed to interview.

We believe there is no such thing as a 'typical' member of University of Birmingham staff and that diversity in its many forms is a strength that underpins the exchange of ideas, innovation and debate at the heart of University life. We are committed to proactively addressing the barriers experienced by some groups in our community and are proud to hold Athena SWAN, Race Equality Charter and Disability Confident accreditations. We have an Equality Diversity and Inclusion Centre that focuses on continuously improving the University as a fair and inclusive place to work where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We are also committed to sustainability, which is a key part of our strategy. You can find out more about our work to create a fairer university for everyone on our website.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Mission Software

title: FIELD SERVICE TECH
description:
Hugg and Hall Equipment Company is looking for someone with mechanical knowledge and customer service skills to join our team as an Equipment Service Mechanic in the field. We are a full-service equipment company specializing in industrial and construction equipment since 1956.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As field service technician at Hugg and Hall, you will repair various types of material handling equipment including forklifts, aerial lifts, and more.

In this role, you will:

  • Travel to various locations to troubleshoot, perform in field diagnostic assessments, and repair a wide range of construction equipment and components
  • Use your in-depth mechanical knowledge and expertise to ensure customer satisfaction and equipment functionality.
  • Continuously communicate in a courteous and effective manner with customers and co-workers including Salespeople, Coordinators, and Managers regarding job progress and general updates
  • Operate in a safe, efficient manner with minimal supervision to decrease equipment downtime while also maintaining safe working standards both on-site and during the operation of company vehicles.

Advanced mechanical aptitude, strong customer service skills, a professional demeanor, and a safety-first mentality are all key.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive pay + quarterly incentives and bonus programs = very strong earning potential
  • Company provided vehicle, phone, and tablet
  • Ongoing paid training, manufacturer certifications, and career advancement opportunities
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement with company match
  • Generous paid time off and holidays

REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum of 1-year hands-on experience as a service technician repairing and maintaining material handling equipment or in a related industry
  • Must own a complete line of tools including specialized tools needed to complete the job at the customer site
  • Basic computer skills
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record
  • Minimum 21 years of age
  • High school diploma or equivalent

OTHER SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

  • Strong technical skills in hydraulic, electrical, and mechanical systems.
  • Familiarity with equipment operation
  • Familiarity with diagnostic tools and equipment
  • Ability to read or be trained in reading schematics
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

This position:

  • will be working in operating facilities and outdoors, traveling to customer locations. The employee will encounter varying weather conditions and temperatures. The normal auto hazards will apply.
  • will be frequently working on equipment with potential hazards where appropriate safety equipment and practices are required.
  • must be able to lift 50 pounds. Occasionally may be required to lift items weighing up to 100 pounds. Must be able to push/pull up to 100 pounds.
  • requires standing, walking, twisting, climbing, and crawling.
  • requires bending, stooping, kneeling, or squatting handling/fingering on a daily basis.
  • requires driving a van/truck to and from customer locations
  • must be able to wear safety glasses and safety shoes.
  • must be medically capable of performing all aspects of the job with the maximum amount of safety.

[This position is deemed a Safety Sensitive job for purposes of the Arkansas Medical Marijuana Amendment, the Oklahoma Medical Marijuana and Patient Protection Act and the Louisiana Therapeutic Marijuana Act.]

ABOUT US:

For 70 years, Hugg and Hall Equipment has been the industry leading, full-service industrial and construction equipment dealership in the South. With locations throughout Arkansas, Louisiana, and Oklahoma, we take pride in providing best in class customer service and an environment where each of our employees feel valued and supported.

title: CHIEF COMMUNITY HEALTH OFFICER
company: NAVAJO HEALTH FOUNDATION - SAGE MEMORIAL HOSPITAL, INC.
description:
Position Summary:
The Chief Community Health Officer (CCHO) at Sage Memorial Hospital is responsible for leading the Community Health Division in developing culturally attuned, community-based health programs aimed at disease prevention, health promotion, and addressing the unique health needs of Tribal and surrounding native populations. The CCHO has overall responsibility for Community Health Services, which includes the Mobile Unit Program, the Diabetes Grant Program, the P-4 Grant Program, and collaboration with medical staff providing diagnostic and therapeutic services in a primary care specialty. This executive position will guide strategic initiatives to improve health outcomes, reduce disparities, and advocate for health resources tailored to Tribal communities. The CCHO will develop policies and foster partnerships that empower individuals and families, ensuring accessibility and support for holistic, community-centered health care.

This list of duties and responsibilities is illustrative only of the tasks performed by this position and is not all-inclusive.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • An individual in this role must be able to perform the following functions with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Develop and lead a comprehensive community health strategy that aligns with Tribal health needs and Sage Memorial Hospital’s mission.
  • Collaborate with Tribal leadership, CEO, and hospital executives to set community health goals, benchmarks, and policies.
  • Guide the creation of policies and procedures that support accessible and sustainable community health services.
  • Design and manage community health programs focused on disease prevention, wellness, mental health, health literacy, and culturally responsive care.
  • Ensures development of Population Health initiatives to improve patient satisfaction and family-centered care; develops and implements measures for quality improvement.
  • Ensure programs reflect evidence-based practices and are tailored to meet the unique needs of Tribal and surrounding native communities.
  • Oversee the Public Health Nursing, Wellness Program, Mobile Unit program, Elder Services, and other community grant programs (i.e., P-4, SDPI).
  • Oversees the supervision of personnel, which includes work allocation, schedules, time approval, hiring, training, orientation, and problem resolution; evaluates performance and makes recommendations for personnel actions; motivates employees to achieve peak productivity and performance.
  • Leads the completion of the community health needs assessment, using the community health needs assessment data to make recommendations for new services or programs.
  • Works to promote an understanding of the population health programs with a focus on diabetes prevention and treatment; individually, and as a member of a group, participates in planning, implementing, and evaluating the population health programs and policies to meet the SMH strategic plan in conjunction with the organization’s mission, vision, and values.
  • Provides support and guidance on clinical and community health needs for the primary care providers, complementing Patient Care Medical Home (PCMH).
  • Recommends public and community health initiatives, policy implementation, and best practices, and identifies program-related grant funding.
  • Leads community mobilization, sensitization, and facilitation of community health promotion activities.
  • Collaborates with tribal, federal, state, and community health, chapters, schools, and social service agencies to achieve a broad base for activities; orients and trains staff of such agencies as required.
  • Collaborate with Emergency Management on planning, organizing, and coordinating all-hazard disaster preparedness response.
  • Manage program budgets, resources, and team members to ensure effective and efficient program operations.
  • Completes data collection to show program achievements – evidenced by metrics and/or dashboards.
  • Act as a primary advocate for health equity and reducing disparities affecting Tribal and native populations.
  • Supports policy development that improves healthcare access and preventative services for Tribal communities.
  • Identify funding sources and lead the development of grant proposals to support community health programs.
  • Supports and implements process improvement activities that enhance clinical outcomes, improve patient satisfaction, as evidenced by QAPI, and/or PDSA, for community-based health programs; in collaboration with the Chief Medical Officer (CMO).
  • Maintain relationships with governmental and non-profit organizations for resource expansion and collaborative opportunities.
  • Manage grant-funded projects to ensure compliance with requirements and effective use of resources.
  • Recruit, train, and supervise Community Health Division staff, promoting a respectful and community-focused workplace.
  • Provide professional development for staff in areas of cultural competency, public health, and community engagement.
  • Uphold ethical standards, including HIPAA compliance and strict client confidentiality.
  • Actively engage with Tribal members, leadership, and families to foster trust and identify health needs.
  • Represent the hospital in community forums, build partnerships, and communicate with stakeholders about community health programs.
  • Support community health staff in facilitating health education and assisting community members in accessing health resources.
  • Oversee data collection, analysis, and reporting for community health initiatives to evaluate impact and inform program improvements.
  • Prepare regular reports for the CEO and Board of Directors to communicate achievements, challenges, and impact.
  • Serve as a practitioner in the mobile unit, comply with the Medical Staff Bylaws, and rules and regulations.
  • Maintains regular attendance and punctuality.
  • Other duties as assigned by the CEO.

title: Skilled Septic Installer Mr Browns
description:
We are seeking an experienced Skilled Septic Installer to install, repair, and replace residential and commercial septic systems. This position requires hands-on experience with septic system installation, excavation, grading, piping, tanks, and drain fields. The ideal candidate can work independently, safely operate equipment, and complete installations according to plans, local codes, and company standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Install new septic systems, including septic tanks, distribution boxes, piping, drain fields, and related components.
  • Perform septic system replacements, repairs, and upgrades.
  • Excavate and prepare sites for septic system installation.
  • Set and level septic tanks accurately according to plans and specifications.
  • Install and properly pitch PVC piping for inlet, outlet, and distribution lines.
  • Build and install conventional and alternative drain field systems.
  • Read and understand septic plans, site plans, elevations, and system layouts.
  • Perform grading, trenching, backfilling, and site restoration.
  • Operate excavators, skid steers, backhoes, loaders, and other construction equipment.
  • Identify existing underground utilities and maintain safe excavation practices.
  • Troubleshoot septic system issues and determine appropriate repairs.
  • Assist with septic inspections, testing, and system startups as required.
  • Coordinate with supervisors, inspectors, homeowners, builders, and other contractors.
  • Maintain tools, equipment, trucks, and jobsite materials.
  • Complete required job documentation accurately and on time.
  • Follow all OSHA, environmental, company, and local safety requirements.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe jobsites.
Requirements
  • 3+ years of hands-on septic installation experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of septic tanks, drain fields, distribution systems, and underground piping.
  • Experience operating excavation and earthmoving equipment.
  • Ability to read site plans, elevations, and septic system designs.
  • Knowledge of proper grading, elevations, pipe pitch, and drainage.
  • Understanding of local septic installation codes and inspection requirements.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair existing septic systems.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • CDL is a plus.
  • Septic installer, wastewater, or equipment operator licenses/certifications are a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a crew.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift and carry 50+ pounds.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, climb, dig, and perform physically demanding work.
  • Comfortable working around excavation equipment, trenches, wastewater systems, and construction environments.
What We're Looking For

title: Supplier Quality Engineer, Powertrain
description:
About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Job Overview:

We are looking for Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for Powertrain commodity who will be responsible for ensuring the quality of powertrain components supplied to the organization. This role involves collaborating with suppliers, engineering teams, and production teams to establish and maintain quality standards, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvement. The SQE will act as a liaison between the company and its suppliers to ensure components meet all technical specifications, quality standards, and customer requirements.
Responsibilities include defining quality standards, inspecting materials, equipment, processes, and products, developing quality control systems, supplier selection, PPAP, leading APQP, and determining corrective actions. A successful SQE should have excellent troubleshooting skills
and be able to ensure that processes and products consistently meet established quality standards.

What You'll Do:
• Collaborate with suppliers to ensure compliance with company and industry quality standards.
• Conduct supplier audits, including process, product, and system audits, to assess and qualify new and existing suppliers.
• Develop and implement supplier performance metrics, including defect rates, response times, and process improvements.
• Work closely with suppliers to develop corrective and preventive action plans for nonconformance issues.
• Establish and validate supplier processes for, including tool trials, gauge design and approvals, first article inspection (FAI) and production part approval process (PPAP).
• Conduct incoming inspections and quality checks of powertrain components as needed.
• Review and approve supplier documentation, such as control plans, FMEAs, Deviations and inspection reports.
• Ensure compliance with specifications, drawings, and industry standards such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, or AS9100 as applicable.
• Participate in the supplier selection process by providing quality-related input.
• Lead weekly calls with suppliers to ensure parts are on track to meet quality and timing requirements for various build stages of the production line.
• Participate in design reviews with the design engineering and manufacturing team to mitigate risk for manufacturing and assembly.
• Monitor and report on supplier performance metrics, such as defect rates, delivery times, and compliance with specifications.
• Investigate and resolve quality issues related to supplier materials and components.
• Collaborate with suppliers to determine root causes of defects and implement corrective and preventive actions.
• Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supplier quality and performance.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of supplier quality performance, audits, and corrective actions.
• Lead MRB meetings and act as a quality representative for the engineering change control board.

Who You Are:
Education/Certifications/Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing) or a similar technical field required.
• At least 3 to 7 years of experience in manufacturing quality or supplier quality engineering in the automotive or aerospace industry or equivalent manufacturing environment.
• Knowledge of castings, forgings, gears, welding, assembly, tooling, materials, and associated quality requirements.
• ASQ Certifications such as Certified Quality Engineer, Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Quality Manager, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or higher preferred.

Skills/Abilities and Attributes
• Knowledge of ISO-9001:2018 or IATF 16949 standard strongly desired.
• Understanding of basic quality core tools such as Quality Management Systems, Supplier and Internal Audits, APQP, SPC, PPAP, FMEA, and MSA.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills.
• Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects.
• Strong understanding of mechanical components (forgings, castings, sheet metal, plastic injection molding) and assembly processes.
• Ability to travel (domestic and international) up to 30 to 50%.

Additional Qualifications
• Proven experience in a quality engineering role, preferably within a manufacturing or production environment.
• Strong knowledge of quality assurance methodologies, tools, and techniques.
• Experience with supplier quality management, including auditing and performance evaluation.
• Proficiency in quality management systems (QMS) and relevant software applications.
• Certification in quality management (e.g., ASQ Certified Quality Engineer) is a plus

Key Benefits & Perks:
  • Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision (HDV) – 100% employee covered
  • Early-stage Stock Options
  • Robust Retirement Savings (401k, HSA, FSA)
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) & Parental Leave
  • Annual Vacation Bonus
  • Wellness & Fertility Benefits

  • Complimentary Meals & Stocked Kitchens

$100,000—$160,000 USD

title: Product Manager, Search
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own our search experience that millions of customers land on when they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo, and the single biggest lever we have on what they find.

The role sits in our Core Consumer organisation in the Search domain, which is responsible for the in-app experience. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA markets, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

Search is where customers tell us exactly what they want. Getting it right across restaurants, grocery, and retail - in every language we operate in - is one of the highest-intent and hardest problems in the app.

What you'll work on

  • Query understanding, Autosuggestions and AI/ML problems in the Search domain
  • Where conversational and agentic search changes how customers get to a decision.
  • Making search work across three brands, multiple languages, and query behaviour that differs market by market.

Our humble expectations

We're looking for a product leader more than a feature owner. Someone who can find the problems that matter most, for customers and for the business, and make the case for solving them.

  • You bring proven experience as a Product Manager in Consumer, or on another relevance- or ranking-driven consumer experience.
  • You demonstrate fluency with search measurement and know how to actually move it.
  • You show strong product judgment, backed by data literacy and customer insight.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and you can weigh that against the most urgent business problems at the same time, rather than treating it as a side you have to pick.
  • You think strategically: you can zoom out to where the domain should be in two years, then zoom back in on what we should ship next quarter.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible. This industry is changing fast, AI most of all, and the plan we write in January won't be the plan in June.
  • You work deeply with ML and engineering on relevance and ranking, without needing to be an ML expert yourself.
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and you can tell real value from hype.
  • You build a case and bring people with you: engineering, design, analytics, and local market teams across three brands and many markets.
  • You do your best work with range: global platform thinking one week, a specific market's reality the next.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Kia Warranty Administrator
description:
Patterson Autos – Kia Warranty Administrator

Tustin Kia & Mission Viejo Kia

About Patterson Autos

• Join an established, award-winning Orange County automotive organization with a 15-year history of Best Place to Work recognition.

• Our dealerships have earned significant manufacturer recognition, including President’s Awards and Dealer of the Year honors.

• We believe strongly in Kaizen — continuous improvement — and in developing people who want to learn, grow and become exceptional at what they do.

• Our culture emphasizes teamwork, accountability, professionalism and doing things the right way.

Position Overview

• The Kia Warranty Administrator will support warranty administration for both Tustin Kia and Mission Viejo Kia, helping ensure warranty claims are processed accurately, completely and promptly.

• The position works closely with Service Advisors, Technicians, Parts personnel, Service Managers, dealership leadership and Kia representatives.

• The individual may work between both Kia locations as business needs require.

Primary Responsibilities

• Review repair orders for accuracy, completeness and proper supporting documentation.

• Prepare, process and submit Kia manufacturer warranty claims in accordance with current policies and procedures.

• Identify missing or incomplete documentation and work with dealership team members to correct it.

• Monitor pending, rejected, returned or unpaid claims and follow through aggressively until resolution.

• Maintain accurate, organized and audit-ready warranty records and assist with monitoring claim aging and receivables.

• Stay current with Kia warranty policies, recalls, campaigns and procedural changes.

• Communicate professionally with Kia representatives and dealership leadership regarding warranty questions or claim issues.

• Support both Kia dealerships in developing consistent, efficient warranty processes and continually look for ways to improve accuracy and productivity.

The Person We Are Looking For

• Highly Organized – Exceptional attention to detail; able to manage significant information, deadlines and outstanding items while maintaining strong systems and processes.

• Mature & Professional – Comfortable communicating constructively with Technicians, Service Advisors, managers and manufacturer representatives; handles challenges calmly and respectfully.

• Tenacious – Will research issues, ask questions and follow through until an answer or resolution is obtained; takes ownership of the process.

• Strong Learner – Able to absorb manufacturer policies, procedures and technical information; comfortable learning new systems and adapting as requirements change.

• Kaizen Mindset – Believes in continuous improvement, welcomes coaching and training, and consistently asks, “How can we do this better?”

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous automotive dealership experience is helpful, particularly in Service, Parts, Accounting or Warranty Administration.

• Kia or other manufacturer warranty experience is a plus, but is not required for the right candidate.

• Light automotive technical knowledge is preferred; curiosity and the ability to learn are more important than knowing everything on day one.

• Strong computer, data-entry, administrative, written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of two dealership teams.

Our Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is mature, organized, tenacious and eager to learn. We can teach the right individual Kia warranty processes and help develop automotive technical knowledge. What matters most is character, organization, follow-through, curiosity and a genuine desire to continuously improve. For the right person, this is an opportunity to become an important part of the Patterson Autos team while developing specialized expertise supporting Tustin Kia and Mission Viejo Kia.

How to Apply

Submit your resume to the Patterson Autos hiring manager at LeticiaC@Pattersonautos.com or apply through the dealership’s employment page TUSTINMAZDA.COM

The preparation and completion of activities to suit the child's stage of development:

Personal Qualities

  • have the ability to attend for work punctually and be well presented

  • have a high level of patience

  • enjoy working with children

  • have the commitment to provide the highest standards of childcare

  • have the ability to multi-task

  • have the willingness to learn, and undergo further appropriate training

  • be flexible, positive, friendly and have a supportive approach to work

  • have a pleasant disposition with a capability to respond positively under pressure

  • have a sense of fun and understanding with other adults.

Desirable:

Working at The Lodge Day Nursey - your hours of work, salary and benefits

You will join a friendly and supportive team, we offer plenty of opportunities for further professional development, working in a high achieving school in a fantastic area, with excellent facilities for both children and staff.

What you need to know:

We currently have full-time roles available in our nursery team, ideally for qualified people (or those who have relevant experience of working with young children and babies). You will work for 3.5 hours each day, 17.5 hours each week, on Mondays – Fridays throughout the year, to help us make sure we maintain our staffing ratios during the busy nursery lunchtime period.

  • your starting salary will be between £26,084.86 - £25,272.88 per annum, for the actual hours outlined above, and will depend on your skills, qualifications and experience

  • all our appointments are subject to the satisfactory completion of a 5-month probationary period

  • you will have 28 days paid holiday each year (including bank holidays) and a further 5 days as paid time off when the nursery is closed in August (one day) and at Christmas (4 days). Giving a total of 33 days paid time off each year. We should let you know that holiday (usually 4 days) must be taken during the week each year when the nursery is closed in August, and we will let you know the dates well in advance each year

  • you will be entitled to join our defined contribution pension scheme for support staff (the employer contribution rate is an attractive 10% of your gross pay), and you will receive three times your salary as death in service life cover. You will also join Smart Health, a wellbeing scheme for staff offering 24/7 online GP and mental health support

  • you will be able to use the school’s swimming pool and fitness gym free of charge and you will have a free freshly prepared lunch each day in School (when the school is in session). We also have (limited) free parking available for staff

Candidates shortlisted for interview will be advised as soon as possible after the closing date. If we have not been in touch with you by 4 September 2026, then we regret that your application will have been unsuccessful, but we would like to thank you for your interest.

Please note

Ipswich School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Applicants must be willing to undergo child protection screening, including checks with past employers and the Disclosure and Barring Service. Having a criminal record will not necessarily be a bar to obtaining the position. The Ipswich School policy on the recruitment of ex-offenders and the Code of Practice relating to the Disclosure and Barring Service are available on request.

Ipswich School’s employees are responsible for promoting and safeguarding the welfare of children and young people they are responsible for or come into contact with. The post holder must adhere to and ensure compliance with the School’s Child Protection and Safeguarding Children Policy at all times. If, in the course of carrying out his/her duties, the post holder becomes aware of any actual or potential risks to the safety or welfare of children in the school he/she must report any concerns to the Designated Safeguarding Lead, The Manager of The Lodge Day Nursery.

title: Quality Review & Compliance Director
description:
The Quality Review & Compliance Director provides strategic leadership and oversight for underwriting quality, compliance, and risk management across Commercial Insurance portfolios. This role is responsible for ensuring underwriting decisions are reviewed consistently and alignment with underwriting guidelines, service standards, and regulatory requirements. The Director leads the Quality Review function, establishing governance frameworks, reporting standards, and performance oversight to promote underwriting excellence, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement across the organization.

In addition, the Director oversees key compliance and operational risk programs, including regulatory reporting, operational risk management, business continuity planning, and customer fairness requirements.   • Develop and present executive reporting, dashboards, and recommendations to senior leadership and governance committees.
  • Lead compliance and risk management activities, including LOR, ORE, FTC, Ethidex, and Risk Control Matrix reporting.
  • Oversee Commercial Insurance Business Continuity Planning, testing, and operational resilience initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, governance standards, and customer fairness obligations.
  • Partner with business leaders to drive continuous improvement, process optimization, training, and system enhancements.

  • Provide leadership and strategic direction, fostering a culture of accountability, underwriting excellence, and risk awareness across the organization.

What you Bring:

  • Strong understanding of Commercial Insurance underwriting principles, portfolio management, risk controls, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience managing enterprise reporting, audit programs, compliance processes, and operational risk initiatives.

title: Systems and Network Administrator
description:
We’re Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers – farmers, construction crews, and foresters - to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff – pixel-by-pixel and task-by-task - leads to big gains.

Blue River Technology aligns with John Deere’s vision to “innovate on behalf of humanity” by quickly identifying and solving high-value, high-uncertainty challenges in AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but also new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT and Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs in industries like agriculture and construction.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration, this mission-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out. We won’t give up until we’ve made a tangible and positive impact on the planet!

Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA.

Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Systems & Network Administrator to join Blue River Technology's IT Infrastructure team and help build the technology foundation that powers the future of robotics and autonomy. As a Systems & Network Administrator, you'll work across a modern IT environment spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, cloud identity, endpoint management, networking, and SaaS platforms. You'll play a key role in scaling and automating our infrastructure while supporting the engineers building next-generation autonomous machines.

This role offers the opportunity to work with a diverse, modern technology stack rather than being limited to a single discipline. You'll collaborate across infrastructure, security, and engineering teams, take ownership of projects that improve reliability and automation, and continue growing your technical expertise in identity management, endpoint management, networking, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Work Location: Santa Clara, CA (min. 2 days per week in the office)
  • Visa sponsorship: Not available.

Job Responsibilities

A combination, not necessarily all-inclusive, of the following:

  • Configure and maintain network infrastructure.
  • Configure and maintain Linux and Windows servers.
  • Support cloud and on-premises directories (Active Directory, Entra ID, FreeIPA, Okta).
  • Manage our fleet of Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoint devices.
  • Manage Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms and applications.
  • Assist with escalated support issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation.

Required Experience and Skills

  • 3+ years of experience as a Systems & Network Administrator, Systems Administrator, or similar IT Infrastructure role.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems.
  • Experience administering Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms, including Jamf and Intune.
  • Strong experience managing cloud and on-premises identity platforms, including Active Directory, Entra ID, and Okta.
  • Experience administering SaaS applications using an Identity Provider (IdP).
  • Experience administering Zscaler security products, specifically ZPA and ZIA.
  • Ability to write, review, and troubleshoot scripts using Bash, PowerShell, and/or Python.
  • Track record of producing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation.
  • Ability to work onsite several days per week and provide occasional after-hours support when needed.

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience administering cloud infrastructure and services in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience automating infrastructure using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or similar configuration management technologies.
  • Experience supporting engineering organizations or technical users in software, robotics, AI/ML, or other technology-focused environments.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup or high-growth technology company where broad technical ownership is expected.
  • Experience implementing enterprise security and identity best practices, including SSO, SCIM provisioning, SAML, or OIDC.

title: Insurance Property Inspector
description:
Ready to turn your eye for detail into a rewarding, flexible career with a company that trusts you to own your day? If you enjoy working on the road, managing your own time, and making a real impact, this opportunity is calling your name. Apply today and take control of your workday!

As our Insurance Property Inspector, you'll earn $20–$28 per billable hour.

What Makes You a Great Fit

We're looking for motivated individuals who enjoy working independently, solving problems, and spending time in the field. Previous experience in any of the following areas is highly valued:

  • Insurance inspections
  • Real estate or property appraisal
  • Home inspections
  • Insurance claims adjusting
  • Construction or commercial contracting

No specific degree is required. We're looking for dependable, self-motivated professionals with a strong work ethic and a commitment to delivering quality work.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY AS AN INSURANCE PROPERTY INSPECTOR

This is a 1099 position with flexible hours. Field Operating Hours: Normal operating hours are from 8:00AM until 8:00PM, or dusk, whichever is earlier, Monday through Saturday. As our Insurance Property Inspector, you'll conduct on-site inspections of homes and businesses, capturing detailed photographs and documenting key features that matter to underwriting decisions. As you walk each property, you'll assess conditions, identify potential hazards or concerns, and gather accurate data that tells the full story. Back at your workspace, you'll compile thorough, high-quality underwriting survey reports, ensuring every detail supports informed risk evaluation.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY

At Information Providers Inc. (IPI), we believe great work starts with great people. Since 1996, we've established ourselves as a leader in Property & Casualty and Premium Audit information services, serving insurance companies nationwide through innovative technology and experienced professionals. With over 430 employees and a unique field force supported by regional offices, we deliver accurate, high-quality information. Our core values, service, reliability, flexibility, timeliness, and innovation, drive our growth and foster a supportive workplace. At IPI, your ideas matter, your growth is supported through mentorship and opportunity, and your contributions make a meaningful impact every day. Join us and be part of a team that values its people as much as its purpose!

TAKE THE NEXT STEP

If you're ready for a flexible, rewarding 1099 role where your skills make a difference, apply now! Our initial application process is quick, easy, and mobile-friendly, so you can take the next step in minutes.

Essential Job Functions

The essential functions below are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties that may be assigned to this position, nor does it restrict the duties which may be assigned to this position if such duties reasonably relate to the position.

  • Performs and records instrument preventive procedures. Documents daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance procedures as determined by department protocol. Performs and records quality control results as determined by established protocol. Verifies all requirements of test samples to include labeling accuracy and/or tube containers prior to testing. Performs all test procedures as outlined in the department’s procedure manual. Crosschecks results for appropriate correlations and reports testing results with accuracy. Identifies and troubleshoots issues that may adversely affect test performance or reporting of test results and either corrects the problems or immediately notifies the Director/Manager/Supervisor. Accurately processes specimens for send-out according to appropriate procedures ensuring timely processing/dispatch.

Engages in caring behaviors, taking conscious ownership for work and takes deliberate/thoughtful actions regarding how to best carry out interactions with the patient, families, physicians, and co-workers.

Delivers lab supplies as appropriate. Picks-up and delivers all laboratory samples/specimens to the departments for testing as appropriate. Prints and delivers/faxes lab reports in a timely manner.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain HL7 interfaces between healthcare systems including EHR, LIS, RIS, billing, and third-party platforms

  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Apply strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex integration issues

  • Work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to healthcare compliance and data security

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Health Informatics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 7–10 years of experience in software engineering or healthcare system integration
  • Experience working with HL7 messaging standards (v2.x), including message types such as ADT, ORM, ORU, and SIU
  • Hands-on experience with integration engines or middleware platforms
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, Python, C#, or JavaScript

  • Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards, data transformation, and integration architecture
  • Awareness of HIPAA and healthcare security compliance requirements

title: QA Engineer Functional - End-to-End
description:
About Trajan Wealth

With over $3 billion in assets under management and advisement, Trajan® Wealth is one of the fastest-growing Registered Investment Advisor firms in the country.

What sets us apart is our fully integrated, in-house model - combining fee-only wealth management, estate planning through Trajan Estate, and tax strategy through Trajan Tax.

We don't refer out critical components of a client's financial life. We bring them together under one fiduciary standard - the Family Office.

Role Overview

We're looking for a functional QA engineer who tests the whole system, not just the change in front of them. The right person thinks critically about edge cases, actively looks for the boundaries of the system, and understands how a change ripples from source systems through to reporting and other downstream systems.

This role would be 100% onsite at our Scottsdale corporate headquarters.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Test applications end to end, validating full workflows rather than isolated changes
  • Test across web applications, our mobile app, and client-facing customer portals, ensuring a consistent experience across all channels
  • Validate data integrity in Snowflake, reconciling data from source systems through transformations to reporting and downstream consumers
  • Incorporate basic security testing into functional workflows, validating authentication, authorization, and access controls, and flagging data-exposure risks (especially important in a financial services context)
  • Think critically about edge cases and probe the system's boundaries and failure points
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, comprehensive test cases
  • Analyze the impact of changes and new features across the full data path, from source system through reporting and any downstream systems
  • Perform standard QA duties for web-based applications (test planning, execution, defect tracking, regression)

Required Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with SQL and Snowflake, including writing queries to validate and reconcile data
  • Proficiency with Chrome DevTools
  • Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman)
  • Experience testing mobile applications (iOS/Android) and web-based customer portals
  • Experience with a test management / defect tracking tool (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr)
  • Experience in the financial services industry

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with core technologies such as Java and Selenium
  • Awareness of common application security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience in wealth management specifically
  • Exposure to reporting/BI validation and data reconciliation

Benefits

  • $113,000 to $142,000 base salary plus bonus
  • 401(k) with a matching contribution up to 13%.
  • United Healthcare PPO medical coverage for employees, paid by the company.
  • Delta Dental PPO, United Healthcare Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, and many more voluntary options.
  • Generous holidays and PTO.
  • Future career growth opportunity.

Come and join a team that is making a difference in their clients and employee's lives!

title: Certified Surgical Tech (PRN)  - Advanced Surgical Center
description:

Advanced Surgical Center, a growing 3-room ambulatory surgery center in Las Vegas, is seeking a dependable and experienced Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) to join our team on a per diem/PRN basis. The Surgical Technologist will play a critical role in supporting safe, efficient, and high-quality surgical care throughout the perioperative process.   • Excellent communication, teamwork, and organizational skills

title: Systems Engr II (DCS Infrastructure, Networking & TSI)
description:
As a Systems Engineer II, you will design, configure, integrate, test, implement and support industrial networking and Telecom and Security Integrated Solutions for Process Automation projects. The role is intended for an engineer who already has practical DCS or Experion PKS experience and is motivated to develop deeper specialization in industrial networking, virtualization, telecom and industrial security solutions.

You will work at the interface between DCS and TSI, helping ensure that Experion PKS, network infrastructure, virtualized system nodes and integrated telecom and security subsystems operate as a coordinated solution. You will collaborate with project engineers, Application Engineers, systems engineers, hardware engineers, cybersecurity specialists, global subject-matter experts, customers and third-party suppliers.

You will report directly to the Mexico Projects & Automation Solutions Global Project Execution Leader. This position is based in Mexico City, Mexico, and will support projects and customer industrial sites primarily across the Americas region. The role follows a hybrid work arrangement when the engineer is not travelling or working at a customer site.

  • Design and document network and system architectures supporting Experion PKS, DCS servers and stations, virtualized nodes, TSI subsystems and associated OT infrastructure.
    Configure and support industrial Ethernet networks, switches, routers, VLANs, redundant network topologies, domain services, time synchronization and network management components within the assigned project scope.
    Support DCS system infrastructure, including Experion servers and stations, Windows domains, virtualization platforms (Nutanix & VMWare), engineering workstations and interfaces to third-party systems.
    Design and integrate applicable TSI subsystems such as access control, intrusion detection, perimeter intrusion detection, CCTV or process video, public address and general alarm, telephony, radio, network management and related industrial communications solutions.
    Prepare and maintain engineering documents such as system architectures, network diagrams, functional design specifications, detailed design documents, interface descriptions, bills of materials, I/O or point lists, test procedures and as-built records.
    Participate in technical reviews with customers, EPCs, project teams, suppliers and global subject-matter experts to clarify requirements, interfaces, responsibilities and acceptance criteria.
    Perform or support system configuration, staging, integration testing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, troubleshooting and optimization at Honeywell facilities, remote environments and customer industrial sites.
    Analyze network, virtualization, DCS and subsystem issues using a structured troubleshooting approach and document findings, corrective actions and lessons learned.
    Coordinate third-party subsystem information and confirm alignment with the overall ICSS architecture and project requirements.
    Follow Honeywell quality processes, cybersecurity requirements, Global Project Methodology, Project Engineering Modernization practices and project document-control expectations.
    Use Internal tools where applicable, Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, Microsoft Visio and approved Artificial Intelligence tools to prepare, review and control engineering work products.
    Build reusable knowledge, templates and technical guidance and share lessons learned with the local team and global engineering community.
    Travel to industrial customer sites across the Americas for project implementation, testing, commissioning and technical support, subject to project needs.


YOU MUST HAVE


  • Bachelor's degree in Control Engineering, Automation, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
    4+ years of practical experience with a DCS or industrial control platform, including system architecture, servers and stations, system integration, testing, commissioning or troubleshooting.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English and Spanish in technical and project environments.
    Demonstrated interest in developing a primary specialization in industrial networking and Telecom and Security Integrated Solutions.
    Demonstrated understanding of Ethernet and IP networking, including switching, routing, VLANs, addressing, redundancy, and structured troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read and develop technical specifications, architecture drawings, network diagrams, interface documents and test procedures.
    Availability to travel to customer industrial sites for short- or extended-duration assignments according to project requirements.
    Strong self-learning behavior, collaboration skills and commitment to high-quality engineering results.

WE VALUE


  • Experion PKS experience with servers, stations, FTE, domains, virtualization, system integration or third-party interfaces.
    Experience with industrial switches, routers, firewalls, wireless infrastructure, network monitoring or OT cybersecurity practices.
    Experience with virtualization platforms and virtualized DCS or industrial application deployments.
    Experience with one or more TSI domains: CCTV or process video, access control, intrusion detection, perimeter detection, public address and general alarm, telephony, radio or network management systems.
    Experience integrating industrial security solutions with DCS, fire and gas, safety or other ICSS subsystems.
    Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, virtualization, cybersecurity or equivalent vendor credentials.
    Experience working with EPC contractors, customers, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
    Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning, startup and troubleshooting at industrial facilities.
    Knowledge of Modbus TCP, OPC UA, IEC 61850, SNMP or other industrial and infrastructure protocols.
    Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, AutoCAD and Microsoft Visio for engineering delivery.
    Ability to transform project experience into reusable standards, templates, lessons learned and technical coaching.
